610.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸੁ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ. ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੮॥
610.e: Says Nanak, one unto whom the Lord becomes Merciful, does not forget the Lord from his mind. ||4||8||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

610.g: ਤਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ. ਧਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ; ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
610.e: My body belongs to the Saints, my wealth belongs to the Saints, and my mind belongs to the Saints.

610.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਤਬ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥
610.e: By the Grace of the Saints, I meditate on the Lord's Name, and then, all comforts come to me. ||1||

610.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ; ਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਬੀਆ ॥
610.e: Without the Saints, there are no other givers.

610.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ; ਸੋ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ਕੀਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
610.e: Whoever takes to the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints, is carried across. ||Pause||

610.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
610.e: Millions of sins are erased by serving the humble Saints, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with love.

610.g: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ. ਆਗੈ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ; ਜਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
610.e: One finds peace in this world, and one's face is radiant in the next world, by associating with the humble Saints, through great good fortune. ||2||

610.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਏਕ. ਅਨੇਕ ਗੁਣ ਪੂਰਨ; ਜਨ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
610.e: I have only one tongue, and the Lord's humble servant is filled with countless virtues; how can I sing his praises?

610.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸਦ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
610.e: The inaccessible, unapproachable and eternally unchanging Lord is obtained in the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||3||

610.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਨੀਚ ਅਨਾਥ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ; ਓਟ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਆਹੀ ॥
610.e: I am worthless, lowly, without friends or support, and full of sins; I long for the Shelter of the Saints.

610.g: ਬੂਡਤ ਮੋਹ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਲੇਹੁ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੭॥
610.e: I am drowning in the deep, dark pit of household attachments - please save me, Lord! ||4||7||
TOMAR STANZA
When he conquered the whole world, his pride was extremely increased
He also forgot the unmanifested Brahmin and said this583
“There is no second except me and the same is accepted at all the place
I have conquered the whole world and made it my slave and have caused everyone to repeat my name.584.
I have given life again to the traditional and have swung the canopy over my head
All the people consider me as their own and none other comes to their sight.585.
No one the repeats the name of the Lord-God or the name of any other God goddess
” Seeing this the Unamanifested Brahma created another purusha.586.
Mehdi Mir was created, who was very angry and persistent one
He killed the Kalki incarnation within himself again.587.
Those who conquered, the made it there possession they are all under the control of KAL (death) in the end
In this way, with complete improvement the description of twenty-fourth incarnation is completed.588.

610.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਿਸਤਿ ਕਲਕੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬਰਨਨੰ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥
610.e: End of the description of twenty-fourth incarnation in Bachittar natak.
(Now being the description of the killing of Mehdi Mir)
TOMAR STANZA
In the way, destroying him, the age of the truth was manifested
The whole of Iron Age had passed away and the light manifested itself everywhere consistently .1
Then Mir Mehdi, conquering the whole world, was filled with pride
He also got the canopy swung over his head and caused the whole world to bow at his feet.2.
Expect himself, he did not have faith in anyone
He who did not comprehend One Lord-God, he ultimately could not save himself from KAL(death).3.
There is not one other in all colours and forms except one God
The Lord killed these innumerable enemies and obtained approbation in the world.581.
The Lord is most powerful with indestructible arms and his pure light looks splendid
He is removing the sins by performing the hom-yajna.582.

610.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ; ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
610.e: Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru; all his sorrows have been dispelled. ||4||5||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

610.g: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ. ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ; ਕਬ ਊਚੇ. ਕਬ ਨੀਚੇ ॥
610.e: The whole creation is engrossed in emotional attachment; sometimes, one is high, and at other times, low.

610.g: ਸੁਧੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਤਨਾ; ਓੜਕਿ. ਕੋ ਨ ਪਹੂਚੇ ॥੧॥
610.e: No one can be purified by any rituals or devices; they cannot reach their goal. ||1||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

610.g: ਸੁਖੀਏ ਕਉ ਪੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਸੁਖੀਆ; ਰੋਗੀ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਰੋਗੀ ॥
610.e: To the happy person, everyone seems happy; to the sick person, everyone seems sick.

610.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਆਪਨ ਹਾਥਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥੧॥
610.e: The Lord and Master acts, and causes us to act; union is in His Hands. ||1||

610.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਤਾ ॥
610.e: O my mind, no one appears to be mistaken, to one who has dispelled his own doubts;

610.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਭੂਲਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
610.e: He realizes that everyone is God. ||Pause||

610.g: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ; ਓਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਠਾਂਢੀ ॥
610.e: One whose mind is comforted in the Society of the Saints, believes that all are joyful.

610.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਆਪਿਤ; ਓਹੁ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
610.e: One whose mind is afflicted by the disease of egotism, cries out in birth and death. ||2||

610.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ. ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਪੜਿਆ; ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
610.e: Everything is clear to one whose eyes are blessed with the ointment of spiritual wisdom.

610.g: ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਅੰਧੇਰੈ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਭਰਮਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
610.e: In the darkness of spiritual ignorance, he sees nothing at all; he wanders around in reincarnation, over and over again. ||3||

610.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
610.e: Hear my prayer, O Lord and Master; Nanak begs for this happiness:

610.g: ਜਹ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਤਹ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੬॥
610.e: whereever Your Holy Saints sing the Kirtan of Your Praises, let my mind be attached to that place. ||4||6||

611.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

611.g: ਏਕੁ ਪਿਤਾ. ਏਕਸ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ; ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਹਾਈ ॥
611.e: The One God is our father; we are the children of the One God. You are our Guru.

611.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ. ਜੀਉ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
611.e: Listen, friends: my soul is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You; O Lord, reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||
The Lord is One and He can be attained through the grace of the true Guru.
Now being the description of Brahma Incarnation
TOMAR STANZA
The age the truth was established again and all the new creation appeared
The kings of all the countries because religious.1.
O the Lord of breadful fury! there is none else except thee,
Who created the Iron Age and its fires burning the word, everyone should repeat His Name.2.
Those who will remember the Name of the Lord in the Iron Age, all their tasks will be fulfilled
They will never experience suffering, hunger and anxiety and will always remain happy.3.
There is none else except the One Lord pervanding all the colours and forms
He helps those who repeat His Name.4.
Those who remember His Name, never run away
They do not fear the enemies and wearing their arms and weapons, they conquer all the direction.5.
Their houses are filled with wealth and all their tasks are fulfilled
Those who remember the Name of one Lord, they are not entrapped in the noose of death.6.
That One Lord is pervading all the created beings and the whole world should know that there is none else except Him.7.
The One Lord is the creator as well as the Destroyer of the whole world and there is one other in all the colours and forms.8.
Many indras are in His service, many Brahmas recite the Vedas, many Shivas sit at His Gate and many Sheshnagas remain present in order to become His bed.9.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

611.g: ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ. ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਅਰੋਗਾ ॥
611.e: After taking your cleansing bath, remember your God in meditation, and your mind and body shall be free of disease.

611.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਘਨ ਲਾਥੇ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾ; ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗਾ ॥੧॥
611.e: Millions of obstacles are removed, in the Sanctuary of God, and good fortune dawns. ||1||
The Word of God's Bani, and His Shabad, are the best utterances.

611.g: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ. ਪੜਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
611.e: So constantly sing them, listen to them, and read them, O Siblings of Destiny, and the Perfect Guru shall save you. ||Pause||

611.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਮਿਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
611.e: The glorious greatness of the True Lord is immeasurable; the Merciful Lord is the Lover of His devotees.

611.g: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ; ਆਦਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
611.e: He has preserved the honor of His Saints; from the very beginning of time, His Nature is to cherish them. ||2||

611.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ; ਸਰਬ ਵੇਲਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
611.e: So eat the Ambrosial Name of the Lord as your food; put it into your mouth at all times.

611.g: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਤਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਾਠਾ; ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥੩॥
611.e: The pains of old age and death shall all depart, when you constantly sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||3||

611.g: ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੈ; ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
611.e: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer, and all my affairs have been resolved.

611.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
611.e: The glorious greatness of Guru Nanak is manifest, throughout all the ages. ||4||11||
He, who has not recognized that one Lord, he wasted his birth.4.
Expect that one Lord, there is none other in water, on plain and all the places
He who had not recognized the One Reality, he only roamed away amongst the Yogis.5.
He who leaving the one, believed in another one, in my view, he is devoid of wisdom
He will be surrounded by suffering, hunger, thirst and anxiety throughout day and night.6.
He will never get peace and will always be surrounded by ailments
He will always suffer death on account of suffering and hunger, he will always remain restless.7.
The leprosy will prevail in his body and all his body will rot
His body will not remain health and his foundness for sons and grandson will always afflict him.8.
His family will be destroyed and at the and, his body will not be redeemed also
He will always be engrossed in disease and sorrow, ultimately, he will die the death of a dog .9.
Reflecting over the egoistic state of Mir Mehdi the Unmanifested Brahman thought of killing him
He created an insect, which entered the ear of Mir Mehdi.10.
Entering his ear, that insect conquered that base fellow, and
Giving him various types of suffering, killed him in this way.11.

611.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਮਹਿਦੀ ਮੀਰ ਬਧ ॥
611.e: End of the description of twenty-fourth incarnation in Bachittar natak.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

611.g: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
611.e: I have searched and searched and searched, and found that the Lord's Name is the most sublime reality.

611.g: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
611.e: Contemplating it for even an instant, sins are erased; the Gurmukh is carried across and saved. ||1||
Drink in the sublime essence of the Lord's Name, O man of spiritual wisdom.

611.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਹਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ. ਮਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ; ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
611.e: Listening to the Ambrosial Words of the Holy Saints, the mind finds absolute fulfillment and satisfaction. ||Pause||

611.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ. ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
611.e: Liberation, pleasures, and the true way of life are obtained from the Lord, the Giver of all peace.

611.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ; ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥
611.e: The Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny, blesses His slave with the gift of devotional worship. ||2||

611.g: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੀਐ. ਰਸਨਾ ਗਾਈਐ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੋਈ ॥
611.e: Hear with your ears, and sing with your tongue, and meditate within your heart on Him.

611.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
611.e: The Lord and Master is all-powerful, the Cause of causes; without Him, there is nothing at all. ||3||

611.g: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
611.e: By great good fortune, I have obtained the jewel of human life; have mercy on me, O Merciful Lord.

611.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
611.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and contemplates Him forever in meditation. ||4||10||
O my mind, emancipation is attained in the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints.

611.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ. ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ, ਨ ਰਹਈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਤ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
611.e: Without the Perfect Guru, births and deaths do not cease, and one comes and goes, over and over again. ||Pause||

611.g: ਓਹੁ ਜੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਕਹੀਅਤ; ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
611.e: The whole world is entangled in what is called the delusion of doubt.

611.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਤੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾ; ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਤੇ ਨਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
611.e: The perfect devotee of the Primal Lord God remains detached from everything. ||2||

611.g: ਨਿੰਦਉ ਨਾਹੀ. ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤੈ; ਏਹੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
611.e: Don't indulge in slander for any reason, for everything is the creation of the Lord and Master.

611.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਰੈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਉ ਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
611.e: One who is blessed with the Mercy of my God, dwells on the Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

611.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਤ ਉਧਾਰਾ ॥
611.e: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, the True Guru, saves all.

611.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ, ਨਹੀ ਤਰੀਐ; ਇਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੯॥
611.e: Says Nanak, without the Guru, no one crosses over; this is the perfect essence of all contemplation. ||4||9||

612.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ. ਧੂਰੀ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
612.e: Listen, friends: I am a sacrifice to the dust of Your feet.
This mind is yours, O Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||

612.g: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਾ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੈ ਕੂ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
612.e: I wash your feet, I massage and clean them; I give this mind to you.

612.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ. ਹਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ ॥੨॥
612.e: Listen, friends: I have come to Your Sanctuary; teach me, that I might unite with God. ||2||

612.g: ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ. ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ; ਕਰੈ. ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਈਐ ॥
612.e: Do not be proud; seek His Sanctuary, and accept as good all that He does.

612.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ. ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀਜੈ; ਇਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
612.e: Listen, friends: dedicate your soul, body and your whole being to Him; thus you shall receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||3||

612.g: ਭਇਓ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
612.e: He has shown mercy to me, by the Grace of the Saints; the Lord's Name is sweet to me.

612.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ; ਸਭੁ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥
612.e: The Guru has shown mercy to servant Nanak; I see the casteless, immaculate Lord everywhere. ||4||1||12||
Many kings like Surya, Chandra and Indra and many Indras, upendras, great sages, the Fish incarnation, the Tortoise incarnation and sheshnagas remain ever present before Him.10.
Many Krishna and Rama incarnation sweep His Door many Fish and Tortoise incarnations are seen standing at His special gate.11.
There are many Shukras, Brahaspatis, Datts, Gorakhs, Rama Krishnas, Rasult ect, but none is acceptable at His gate wightout the remembrance of His Name.12.
No other work is appropriate except the support of the one Name
Those who will believe in the one Guru-Lord, they will only comprehend His myself.13.
We should not know anyone else except Him and none other should be kept in mind
Only one Lord should be worshipped, so that we may be redeemed at the end.14.
O being! You may consider that without Him you cannot be redeemed
If you adore anyone else, then you will get away from that Lord.15.
Only that Lord should be adored consistently, who is beyond attachment, colours and form
None other except the One Lord should be kept in view .16.
He who creates this and the next word and merges them within himself, if you want the salvation of your body, then worship only that One Lord.17.
He who has created the nine regions, all the worlds and the universe, why do you not meditate on him and how do you fall in the well deliberately? 18.
O foolish being! you should adore Him who was established all the fourteen worlds
With His meditation all the wishes are fulfilled.19.
All the twenty-four incarnations have been enumerated in detail and now I am going to enumerate the smaller incarnations how the Lord assumed the other forms.20.
Those forms which Brahma assumed, I have narrated them in poetry and not after reflection, I narrated the incarnation of Rudra (Shiva).21.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

612.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ; ਸੇ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
612.e: Those whose minds are attached to the lotus feet of the Lord - those humble beings are satisfied and fulfilled.

612.g: ਗੁਣ ਅਮੋਲ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ, ਨ ਵਸਿਆ; ਤੇ ਨਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
612.e: But those, within whose hearts the priceless virtue does not abide - those men remain thirsty and unsatisfied. ||1||
Worshipping the Lord in adoration, one becomes happy, and free of disease.

612.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ. ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਲਾਖ ਬੇਦਨ ਜਣੁ ਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
612.e: But one who forgets my Dear Lord - know him to be afflicted with tens of thousands of illnesses. ||Pause||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

612.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਬਾਤ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਰੋ; ਤੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
612.e: Those things, which caused me such anxiety, have all vanished.

612.g: ਸਹਜ ਸੈਨ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਨਾਰੀ; ਊਧ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਸਇਆ ॥੧॥
612.e: Now, I sleep in peace and tranquility, and my mind is in a state of deep and profound peace; the inverted lotus of my heart has blossomed forth. ||1||
Behold, a wondrous miracle has happened!

612.g: ਜਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਸੁਨਤ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ; ਸੋ ਰਿਦੈ. ਗੁਰਿ ਦਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
612.e: That Lord and Master, whose wisdom is said to be unfathomable, has been enshrined within my heart, by the Guru. ||Pause||

612.g: ਜੋਇ ਦੂਤ. ਮੋਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸੰਤਾਵਤ; ਤੇ ਭਇਆਨਕ ਭਇਆ ॥
612.e: The demons which tormented me so much, have themselves become terrified.

612.g: ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ. ਰਾਖੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇ; ਹਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਇਆ ॥੨॥
612.e: They pray: please, save us from your Lord Master; we seek your protection. ||2||

612.g: ਜਹ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ. ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਖੁਲਿਆ; ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਹ ਲਇਆ ॥
612.e: When the treasure of the Lord of the Universe is opened, those who are pre-destined, receive it.

612.g: ਏਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਥਿਆ ॥੩॥
612.e: The Guru has given me the one jewel, and my mind and body have become peaceful and tranquil. ||3||

612.g: ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ. ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੀਨੋ; ਤਾ ਅਟਲੁ ਅਮਰੁ. ਨ ਮੁਆ ॥
612.e: The Guru has blessed me with the one drop of Ambrosial Nectar, and so I have become stable, unmoving and immortal - I shall not die.

612.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਸਉਪੇ; ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ. ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਲਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪॥
612.e: The Lord blessed Guru Nanak with the treasure of devotional worship, and did not call him to account again. ||4||3||14||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

612.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਰੇ ॥
612.e: God is the Lord and Master of millions of universes; He is the Giver of all beings.

612.g: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੈ; ਇਕੁ ਗੁਨੁ. ਨਹੀ ਮੂਰਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
612.e: He ever cherishes and cares for all beings, but the fool does not appreciate any of His virtues. ||1||
I do not know how to worship the Lord in adoration.

612.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ; ਕਰਤਾ ਰੇ ॥
612.e: I can only repeat, "Lord, Lord, Guru, Guru."

612.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
612.e: O Dear Lord, I go by the name of the Lord's slave. ||Pause||

612.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ; ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੀ ਰੇ ॥
612.e: The Compassionate Lord is Merciful to the meek, the ocean of peace; He fills all hearts.

612.g: ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸੰਗੇ; ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ. ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦੂਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
612.e: He sees, hears, and is always with me; but I am a fool, and I think that He is far away. ||2||

612.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ. ਹਉ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਨਉ; ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੋ ਰੇ ॥
612.e: The Lord is limitless, but I can only describe Him within my limitations; what do I know, about what He is like?

612.g: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ. ਦੇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੋ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
612.e: I offer my prayer to my True Guru; I am so foolish - please, teach me! ||3||

612.g: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੀ. ਕੇਤਕ ਬਾਤ ਹੈ; ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧੀ ਤਰਿਆ ਰੇ ॥
612.e: I am just a fool, but millions of sinners just like me have been saved.

612.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਜਿਨ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਪੇਖਿਆ; ਸੇ ਫਿਰਿ. ਗਰਭਾਸਿ, ਨ ਪਰਿਆ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩॥
612.e: Those who have heard, and seen Guru Nanak, do not descend into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||2||13||

613.e: When the Lord commended, then Brahma preprared the Vedas
At that time his pride was increased and he did not consider anyone else like himself.22.
He thought that there was none other like him and there was no other poet like him
On the Lord-God because unhappay and threw him on the ground like the Vajra of Indra.23.
When Brahma, the ocean of four Vedas fell upon the earth,
He began to worship with the fullness of his heart the mysterious Lord, who is beyond the ken of gods.24.
He worshipped the Lord for ten Lakh years and he to the Lord of gods to redeem him in any in any way.25.

613.g: ਜਿਹ ਜਨ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ; ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੇ ॥
613.e: Those who hold tightly to Your Support, God, are happy in Your Sanctuary.

613.g: ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ; ਤੇ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਗਨਣੇ ॥੨॥
613.e: But those humble beings who forget the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, are counted among the most miserable beings. ||2||

613.g: ਜਿਹ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਨਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ; ਤਿਹ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
613.e: One who has faith in the Guru, and who is lovingly attached to God, enjoys the delights of supreme ecstasy.

613.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ. ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਈ; ਤੇ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
613.e: One who forgets God and forsakes the Guru, falls into the most horrible hell. ||3||

613.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ. ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ; ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
613.e: As the Lord engages someone, so he is engaged, and so does he perform.

613.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਹ ਪਕਰੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ; ਰਿਦੈ ਭਏ ਮਗਨ ਚਰਨਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥
613.e: Nanak has taken to the Shelter of the Saints; his heart is absorbed in the Lord's feet. ||4||4||15||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

613.g: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ. ਆਪਨ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਦੇ; ਤਹ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
613.e: In our mother's womb, You blessed us with Your meditative remembrance, and You preserved us there.

613.g: ਪਾਵਕ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਲਹਰਿ ਮਹਿ; ਤਾਰਹੁ ਤਾਰਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
613.e: Through the countless waves of the ocean of fire, please, carry us across and save us, O Savior Lord! ||1||
O Lord, You are the Master above my head.
Here and hereafter, You alone are my Support. ||Pause||

613.g: ਕੀਤੇ ਕਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਮਾਨੈ; ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
613.e: He looks upon the creation like a mountain of gold, and sees the Creator as a blade of grass.

613.g: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ. ਮਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਸਗਲੀ; ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
613.e: You are the Great Giver, and we are all mere beggars; O God, You give gifts according to Your Will. ||2||

613.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਵਰੁ. ਖਿਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਅਵਰਾ; ਅਚਰਜ ਚਲਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
613.e: In an instant, You are one thing, and in another instant, You are another. Wondrous are Your ways!

613.g: ਰੂੜੋ ਗੂੜੋ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੋ; ਊਚੌ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
613.e: You are beautiful, mysterious, profound, unfathomable, lofty, inaccessible and infinite. ||3||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

613.g: ਰਾਜਨ ਮਹਿ. ਰਾਜਾ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ; ਮਾਨਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
613.e: As the king is entangled in kingly affairs, and the egotist in his own egotism,

613.g: ਲੋਭਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਲੋਭਾਇਓ; ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਚੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
613.e: and the greedy man is enticed by greed, so is the spiritually enlightened being absorbed in the Love of the Lord. ||1||
This is what befits the Lord's servant.

613.g: ਪੇਖਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
613.e: Beholding the Lord near at hand, he serves the True Guru, and he is satisfied through the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||Pause||

613.g: ਅਮਲਨ ਸਿਉ ਅਮਲੀ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ; ਭੂਮਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
613.e: The addict is addicted to his drug, and the landlord is in love with his land.

613.g: ਖੀਰ ਸੰਗਿ. ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਹੈ ਲੀਨਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤ ਐਸੇ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
613.e: As the baby is attached to his milk, so the Saint is in love with God. ||2||

613.g: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਮਹਿ. ਬਿਦੁਅੰਸੀ ਰਚਿਆ; ਨੈਨ ਦੇਖਿ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
613.e: The scholar is absorbed in scholarship, and the eyes are happy to see.

613.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੁਭਾਨੀ; ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥੩॥
613.e: As the tongue savors the tastes, so does the humble servant of the Lord sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

613.g: ਜੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ. ਤੈਸੀ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਕੁ; ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
613.e: As is the hunger, so is the fulfiller; He is the Lord and Master of all hearts.

613.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਿਆਸ ਲਗੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬॥
613.e: Nanak thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; he has met God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||5||16||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

613.g: ਹਮ ਮੈਲੇ. ਤੁਮ ਊਜਲ ਕਰਤੇ; ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ. ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
613.e: We are filthy, and You are immaculate, O Creator Lord; we are worthless, and You are the Great Giver.

613.g: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ. ਤੁਮ ਚਤੁਰ ਸਿਆਣੇ; ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਾ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੧॥
613.e: We are fools, and You are wise and all-knowing. You are the knower of all things. ||1||
O Lord, this is what we are, and this is what You are.

613.g: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ. ਤੁਮ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨ; ਨੀਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੇਸਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
613.e: We are sinners, and You are the Destroyer of sins. Your abode is so beautiful, O Lord and Master. ||Pause||

613.g: ਤੁਮ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੇ. ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ; ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
613.e: You fashion all, and having fashioned them, You bless them. You bestow upon them soul, body and the breath of life.

613.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ. ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ; ਤੁਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
613.e: We are worthless - we have no virtue at all; please, bless us with Your gift, O Merciful Lordand Master. ||2||

613.g: ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਭਲਾ. ਹਮ ਭਲੋ, ਨ ਜਾਨਹ; ਤੁਮ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
613.e: You do good for us, but we do not see it as good; You are kind and compassionate, forever and ever.

613.g: ਤੁਮ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ; ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
613.e: You are the Giver of peace, the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny; please, save us, Your children! ||3||

613.g: ਤੁਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਟਲ ਸੁਲਿਤਾਨ; ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਚੈ ॥
613.e: You are the treasure, eternal Lord King; all beings and creatures beg of You.

613.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਮ ਇਹੈ ਹਵਾਲਾ; ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੭॥
613.e: Says Nanak, such is our condition; please, Lord, keep us on the Path of the Saints. ||4||6||17||
SPEECH OF THE GOD
(Vishnu said) “When you will adore Lord-God with the fullness of your heart, then the Lord who is the support of the helpless, will fulfill you wish.”26.
Hearing this Brahma began to worship and make offerings exactly in the same way, as Vishnu had suggested.27.
Vishnu also said this, that the powerful Chandika, the destroyer of the tyrants should also be adored, who had killed the demons like Jawalaksha and Dhumar Lochan.28
“When you will worship all of them, then the curse on you will terminte
Worship the unmanifested Brahman and abandoning your persistence, you may go under his shelter.29.
“Blessed are they, on the earth, who go under His refuge
They do not fear anyone and all their tasks are fulfilled.30.
For ten Lack years Brahma stood on one leg and when he served the Lord with the singleness of his heart, then the Guru-Lord was pleased.31.
When with the goddess explained the myself, then Brahma served with fullness of his mind, and the unmanifested Bharma was pleased with him.32.
Then there was such-like voice from heaven,”I am the masher of pride and I have subjugated all.33.
“You had been puffed up with pride, therefore I did not like you
Now I sea this and tell you as to how you will be redeemed.34.
“You may now assume seven incarnation on the earth for your redemption
” Brahma accepted all this and assumed new births in the world.35.
“Never forget from your mind my slander and praise
O Brahma! Also listen to one thing more36
“A god named Vishnu has also meditated on me and greatly pleased me
He has also asked for a boon from me, which I have bestowed on him.37.
“There is no difference between me and him, all the people know this
The people consider him the creator of this and the next world and their destroyer.38.

614.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
614.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

614.g: ਹਮ. ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਹਮ. ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
614.e: I am the dust of the feet of the Beloved Saints; I seek the Protection of their Sanctuary.

614.g: ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ; ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
614.e: The Saints are my all-powerful Support; the Saints are my ornament and decoration. ||1||

614.g: ਹਮ; ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
614.e: I am hand and glove with the Saints.

614.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈ ॥
614.e: I have realized my pre-ordained destiny.

614.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
614.e: This mind is yours, O Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||

614.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਲੇਵਾ ਦੇਵੀ; ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥
614.e: My dealings are with the Saints, and my business is with the Saints.

614.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਹਮ ਲਾਹਾ ਖਾਟਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
614.e: I have earned the profit with the Saints, and the treasure filled to over-flowing with devotion to the Lord. ||2||

614.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਉਪੀ; ਤਉ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਧੋਖਾ ॥
614.e: The Saints entrusted to me the capital, and my mind's delusion was dispelled.

614.g: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਅਬ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈਗੋ; ਜਉ ਫਾਟਿਓ ਸਗਲੋ ਲੇਖਾ ॥੩॥
614.e: What can the Righteous Judge of Dharma do now? All my accounts have been torn up. ||3||

614.g: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਭਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦੇ ॥
614.e: I have found the greatest bliss, and I am at peace, by the Grace of the Saints.

614.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੯॥
614.e: Says Nanak, my mind is reconciled with the Lord; it is imbued with the wondrous Love of the Lord. ||4||8||19||

614.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
614.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

614.g: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ. ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰੇ ਨਰ; ਤੇਤੀ ਹੀ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
614.e: All the things that you see, O man, you shall have to leave behind.

614.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ; ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
614.e: Let your dealings be with the Lord's Name, and you shall attain the state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||

614.g: ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
614.e: O my Beloved, You are the Giver of peace.

614.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ; ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
614.e: The Perfect Guru has given me these Teachings, and I am attuned to You. ||Pause||

614.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ; ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
614.e: In sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit, peace is not to be found.

614.g: ਹੋਹੁ ਰੇਨ ਤੂ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ. ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਤਉ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
614.e: So be the dust of the feet of all, O my mind, and then you shall find bliss, joy and peace. ||2||

614.g: ਘਾਲ ਨ ਭਾਨੈ. ਅੰਤਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੈ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
614.e: He knows the condition of your inner self, and He will not let your work go in vain - serve Him, O mind.

614.g: ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਮਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ; ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
614.e: Worship Him, and dedicate this mind unto Him, the Image of the Undying Lord, the Divine Guru. ||3||

614.g: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਮਾਧਵੇ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
614.e: He is the Lord of the Universe, the Compassionate Lord, the Supreme Lord God, the Formless Lord.

614.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤਣਿ. ਨਾਮੋ ਵਾਲੇਵਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੦॥
614.e: The Naam is my merchandise, the Naam is my nourishment; the Naam, O Nanak, is the Support of my breath of life. ||4||9||20||

614.g: ਦੁਤੀਯਾ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਕਸਪ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
614.e: Description of Kashyap, the second incarnation of Brahma

614.g: ਪਾਧੜੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
614.e: PAADHARI STANZA

614.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਧਰਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਸਪ ਵਤਾਰ ॥
ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਪਾਠ ਤ੍ਰੀਅ ਬਰੀ ਚਾਰ ॥
ਮਥਨੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
ਉਪਜਾਇ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਸੁ ਬਾਸ ॥੭॥
614.e: The Brahma assuming the Kashyap incarnation, recited shrutis (Vedas) and married four women, after that he created the whole world, when both gods and demons were created.7.

614.g: ਜੋ ਭਏ ਰਿਖਿ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਗੇ ਵਤਾਰ ॥
ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕਿਨੋ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਅਰੁ ਧਰੇ ਅਰਥ ॥
ਕਰ ਦਏ ਦੂਰ ਭੂਅ ਕੇ ਅਨਰਥ ॥੮॥
614.e: Those who because sages, he though about them, he interpreted the Vedas and removed the misfortune from the earth.8.

614.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਕੀਨ ਦੂਸ੍ਰ ਵਤਾਰ ॥
ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
614.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

614.g: ਰਤਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ. ਕਉਡੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੇ; ਜਾ ਤੇ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
614.e: Forsaking the jewel, he is attached to the shell; nothing will come of it.

614.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ. ਜਉ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ; ਤਉ ਸੁਨੀ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
614.e: When You brought me to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, then I heard the Bani of Your Word.

614.g: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ; ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੮॥
614.e: Nanak is in ecstasy, beholding the Glory of the Primal Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||4||7||18||

614.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
614.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

614.g: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਉ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸਾ; ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
614.e: He infuses the breath into the dead bodies, and he reunited the separated ones.

614.g: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਭਏ ਸ੍ਰੋਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
614.e: Even beasts, demons and fools become attentive listeners, when He sings the Praises of the Lord's Name. ||1||

614.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ; ਦੇਖੁ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
614.e: Behold the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru.

614.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
614.e: His worth cannot be described. ||Pause||

614.g: ਦੂਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਢਾਹਿਓ ਡੇਰਾ; ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਬਿਸਰਾਮਾ ॥
614.e: He has demolished the abode of sorrow and disease, and brought bliss, joy and happiness.

614.g: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
614.e: He effortlessly awards the fruits of the mind's desire, and all works are brought to perfection. ||2||

614.g: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ. ਆਗੈ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ; ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
614.e: He finds peace in this world, and his face is radiant in the world hereafter; his comings and goings are finished.

614.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ. ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ; ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
614.e: He becomes fearless, and his heart is filled with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; his mind is pleasing to the True Guru. ||3||

614.g: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
614.e: Standing up and sitting down, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; his pain, sorrow and doubt are dispelled.

614.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਾ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੨੧॥
614.e: Says Nanak, his karma is perfect; his mind is attached to the Guru's feet. ||4||10||21||

614.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥੩੯॥
614.e: “Whenever we will assume the incarnations and whatever he will do. O Brahma! You may describe team.”39.

614.g: ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
614.e: NARAAJ STANZA

614.g: ਸੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਾਨੁਖੀ ਬਪੁੰ; ਸੰਭਾਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
614.e: “You may assume the human form and take up the story of Ram

614.g: ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰਣੰ; ਜੁਝਾਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਭਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
614.e: The enemies will run away, abandoning their arms and weapons, before the glory of Ram

614.g: ਬਿਚਾਰ ਜੌਨ ਜੌਨ ਭਯੋ; ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਭਾਖੀਯੋ ॥
ਹਜਾਰ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਕਿਯੋ ਕਰੋ; ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਸਬਦ ਰਾਖੀਯੋ ॥੪੦॥
614.e: Whatever he will do, reform and describe them and inspire of the though of difficulties present the same in poetry arranging the thoughtful worlds.”40.

614.g: ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਬੈਣ ਵਾਕਿਸੰ; ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਬਾਲਮੀਕ ਭਯੋ ॥
ਜੁਝਾਰ ਰਾਮਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਚਾਰੁ ਉਚਰ︀ਯੋ ॥
614.e: Obeying the saying of the Lord, Brahma assumed the form of Valmiki and manifested himself and he composed in poetry the actions performed by Ramchandra, the most powerful one

614.g: ਸੁ ਸਪਤ ਕਾਡਣੋ ਕਥ︀ਯੋ ਅਸਕਤ ਲੋਕੁ ਹੁਇ ਰਹ︀ਯੋ ॥
ਉਤਾਰ ਚਤ੍ਰਆਨਨੋ ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ਐਸ ਕੈ ਕਹ︀ਯੋ ॥੪੧॥
614.e: He composed in a reformed way the Ramayana, of seven chapters for helpless people.41.

614.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥
614.e: End of the description containing command for Brahma.

614.g: ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
614.e: NARAAJ STANZA

614.g: ਸੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕੋ; ਬਿਚਾਰ ਦੂਜ ਭਾਖਿ ਹੈ ॥
ਬਿਸੇਖ ਚਤ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੇ; ਅਸੇਖ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਚਾਖਿ ਹੈ ॥
614.e: After assuming the incarnation, Brahma, with the fullness of his heart and in a special way, presented his thoughts

614.g: ਅਕਰਖ ਦੇਵਿ ਕਾਲਿਕਾ; ਅਨਿਰਖ ਸਬਦ ਉਚਰੋ ॥
ਸੁ ਬੀਨ ਬੀਨ ਕੈ ਬਡੇ; ਪ੍ਰਾਬੀਨ ਅਛ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਧਰੋ ॥੧॥
614.e: He remembered the Lord and composed the songs and prepared the epic skillfully arranging the selected words.1.

614.g: ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਈਸ੍ਵਰੀ; ਅਪਾਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥
ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਾਲ ਕੀ; ਜੁ ਚਾਹੀਐ, ਸੁ ਭਾਖੀਐ ॥
614.e: For the divine thoughts, he created the word `Brahm` and by remembering the Lord and with His grace, he narrated whatever he wanted

614.g: ਨ ਸੰਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਨੀਐ; ਬਨਾਇ ਆਪ ਲੇਹਗੇ ॥
ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਬਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੀ; ਕਬੀਸ ਔਰ ਦੇਹਗੇ ॥੨॥
614.e: He unhesitatingly, composed in this way the, fine epic Ramayana, which none else will be able to do.2.

614.g: ਸਮਾਨ ਗੁੰਗ ਕੇ ਕਵਿ; ਸੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਕਾਬਿ ਭਾਖ ਹੈ ॥
ਅਕਾਲ ਕਾਲ ਕੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ; ਬਨਾਇ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਰਾਖਿ ਹੈ ॥
614.e: All the poets are dumb before him, how will they compose poetry? He composed this granth by the Grace of the Lord

614.g: ਸੁ ਭਾਖ︀ਯ ਕਉਮਦੀ ਪੜੇ ਗੁਨੀ ਅਸੇਖ ਰੀਝ ਹੈ ॥
ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਆਪਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ; ਬਿਸੇਖ ਚਿਤਿ ਖੀਝਿ ਹੈ ॥੩॥
614.e: The erudite scholars of language and and literature read it with pleasure, and while comparing with their own works, they get angry in their minds.3.

614.g: ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਾਬ੍ਰਯ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ; ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਆਜ ਭਾਖੀਐ ॥
ਸੁ ਸਿਧ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਦਾਇਨੀ; ਸਮ੍ਰਿਧ ਬੈਨ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥
614.e: The story of his immaculate poem which is really wonderful accomplished and powerful, this story is

614.g: ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ ਮਹਾ; ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਾਬ੍ਰਯ ਕਥੀਐ ॥
ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਬਦ ਊਪਜੈ; ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੌ ਨ ਕਿਜੀਐ ॥੪॥
614.e: His poem is said to be extremly pure and each of its episodies is spotless, sanctified and marvelous.4.

614.g: ਸੁ ਸੇਵ ਕਾਲ ਦੇਵ ਕੀ; ਅਭੇਵ ਜਾਨਿ ਕੀਜੀਐ ॥
614.e: According to the instructions given in Ramayana, we should ever be in the service of the Lord

614.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤ ਉਠਿ ਤਾਸੁ ਕੋ; ਮਹਾਤ ਨਾਮ ਲੀਜੀਐ ॥
614.e: We should get up early In the morning and remember His Name

614.g: ਅਸੰਖ ਦਾਨ ਦੇਹਿਗੋ; ਦੁਰੰਤ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਘਾਇ ਹੈ ॥
614.e: Through the glory of His Name, many mighty enemies are killed and the charities of innumerable types are bestowed

614.g: ਸੁ ਪਾਨ ਰਾਖਿ ਆਪਨੋ; ਅਜਾਨ ਕੋ ਬਚਾਇ ਹੈ ॥੫॥
614.e: That Lord, also keeping his name on our heads, protects the ignorant people like us.5.

614.g: ਨ ਸੰਤ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਕਿ ਹੈ; ਅਸੰਤ ਜੂਝਿ ਹੈ ਬਲੀ ॥
ਬਿਸੇਖ ਸੈਨ ਭਾਜ ਹੈ; ਸਿਤੰਸ ਰੇਣ ਨਿਰਦਲੀ ॥
614.e: Even after the fighting of many mighty warriors, the saints remain unharmed and before the forces of agony and before the white arrows of His Grace and tranquility, the forces of agony and affliction fly away

614.g: ਕਿ ਆਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਹਾਥ ਦੈ; ਬਚਾਇ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੇਹਿੰਗੇ ॥
ਦੁਰੰਤ ਘਾਟ ਅਉਘਟੇ; ਕਿ ਦੇਖਨੈ ਨ ਦੇਹਿੰਗੇ ॥੬॥
614.e: That Lord with His Grace will save me and I shall never pass through any condition of suffering and hardship.6.

614.g: ਇਤਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬਾਲਮੀਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੧॥
614.e: End of the first incarnation of Valmiki.

615.g: ਅਥ ਪੰਚਮੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਆਸ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
615.e: Now being the description of Vyas, the fifth incarnation of Brahma and the description of the rule of king menu.
PAADHARI STANZA
Treat age passed and Dwapar age came, when Krishna manifested himself and performed various kinds of sports, then Vyas was born

615.g: ਤਬ ਭਏ ਬ︀ਯਾਸ ਮੁਖ ਆਨਿ ਚਾਰ ॥੫॥
615.e: He had a charming face.5.

615.g: ਜੇ ਜੇ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੀਅ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਦੇਵ ॥
ਤੇ ਤੇ ਭਨੇ ਸੁ ਸਾਰਦਾ ਤੇਵ ॥
615.e: Whatever sports Krishna performed, he described them with the halp of Saraswati the godess of learning
Now I describe them in brief, all the works, which Vyas executed.6.

615.g: ਤਿਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਾਬਿ ਕਥਿ ਹੈ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
615.e: The manner in which he propagated his writings, in the same manner, I relate the same here thoughtfully
The poetry that Vyas composed, I now relate here same type of glorious sayings.7.

615.g: ਜੇ ਭਏ ਭੂਪ ਭੂਅ ਮੋ ਮਹਾਨ ॥

615.e: The scholars describe the stories of all the great kings, who ruled over the earth
To what extent, they may be narrated, O my fried! Listen to the same in brief.8.

615.g: ਜੇ ਭਏ ਭੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਹੇ ਬ︀ਯਾਸ ॥

615.e: Vayas narrated the exploits of the erstwhile kings, we gather this from the Puranas

615.g: ਮਨੁ ਭਯੋ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਕੋ ਭੂਆਰ ॥

615.e: There had been one mighty and glorious king named manu.9.
He brought to the human words and extending his approbation his greatness?

615.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਰਹੈ ਮਉਨ ॥੧੦॥
615.e: And listening to his praise one can only remain mute.10.
He was ocean of eighteen sciences and he got his trumpets sounded after conquering his enemies
He made many person kings, and those who resisted, he killed them, the ghosts and fiends also used to dance in his battlefield.11.
He conquered many countries of opponents and destroyed many to the status of royalty
He snatched the countries of many and exiled them.12.
He killed many dreadful Kshatriyas and suppressed many corrupt and tyrannical warriors
Many stable and invincible fighter fled before him and me destroyed many powerful warriors.13.
He subdued many mighty kshatriyas and established many new kings,

615.g: ਮਾਨੀ ਸੁ ਮਾਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਇ ॥੧੪॥
615.e: In the countries of opposing kings, in the way, the king menu was hououred throughout the bravery.14.

615.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਦੀਹ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਸ ਰਾਜ ॥
ਬਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਿ ਅਰੁ ਹੋਮ ਸਾਜ ॥
615.e: In this way, after conquering many kings, manu performed many hom-yajnas,

615.g: ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਸ੍ਵਰਣ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੁ ਦਾਨ ॥

615.e: He bestowed different typed of charities of gold and cows and took bath at various pilgrim-satations.15.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

615.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ. ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਲਾਥੇ; ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
615.e: In God's Sanctuary, all fears depart, suffering disappears, and peace is obtained.

615.g: ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
615.e: When the Supreme Lord God and Master becomes merciful, we meditate on the Perfect True Guru. ||1||

615.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ; ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
615.e: O Dear God, You are my Lord Master and Great Giver.

615.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
615.e: By Your Mercy, O God, Merciful to the meek, imbue me with Your Love, that I might sing Your Glorious Praises. ||Pause||

615.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ; ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
615.e: The True Guru has implanted the treasure of the Naam within me, and all my anxieties have been dispelled.
In this way the second incarnation manifested himself and now I am describing the third one thoughtfully

615.g: ਜਿਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਧਰ︀ਯੋ ਬਪੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰਾਇ ॥

615.e: The manner in which Brahma assumed his body, I now describe it nicely.9.

615.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਦੁਤੀਯ ਅਵਤਾਰੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਕਸਪ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੨॥
615.e: End of the description of Kashyap the second incarnation of Brahma, in Bachittar Natak.

615.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ. ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
615.e: O my mind, meditate forever on the Perfect, Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord. ||1||
Meditate in remembrance on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O mortal.
Your frail body shall perish, you ignorant fool. ||Pause||

615.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ; ਤਾ ਕੀ. ਕਛੁ ਨ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
615.e: Illusions and dream-objects possess nothing of greatness.

615.g: ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ. ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ; ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
615.e: Without meditating on the Lord, nothing succeeds, and nothing will go along with you. ||2||

615.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ. ਬਿਹਾਇ ਅਵਰਦਾ; ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਕਾਮੁ. ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
615.e: Acting in egotism and pride, his life passes away, and he does nothing for his soul.

615.g: ਧਾਵਤ ਧਾਵਤ. ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
615.e: Wandering and wandering all around, he is never satisfied; he does not remember the Name of the Lord. ||3||

615.g: ਸਾਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੋ; ਅਸੰਖ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਫੇਰੇ ॥
615.e: Intoxicated with the taste of corruption, cruel pleasures and countless sins, he is consigned to the cycle of reincarnation.

615.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਹਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ; ਕਾਟਹੁ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੨॥
615.e: Nanak offers his prayer to God, to eradicate his demerits. ||4||11||22||
Now being the description about the third incarnation Shukra
PAADHARI STANZA

615.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਧਰਾ ਤੀਸਰ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਰੂਪ ॥
ਜਗਿ ਭਯੋ ਆਨ ਕਰਿ ਦੈਤ ਭੂਪ ॥
615.e: The third from that Brahma assumed was this king, that he because the king (Guru) of the demons
At that time, the clan of demons increased enormously and they ruled over the earth.1.
Considering him as him eldest son Brahma helped him In the from of the a Guru and this way Shukracharya became the third incarnation of Brahma

615.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗੰਥੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਤੀਆ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਸੁਕ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੩॥
615.e: His fame spread further because of the slander of gods, seeing which the gods became weak.2.
End of the description of shukra, the third incarnation of Brahma.
PAADARI STANZA :Now begins the description about Baches the fourth incarnation of Brahma
The lowly gods served the Lord for a hundred years, when he (the Guru-Lord) was pleased
Then Brahma assumed the from of Baches, when Indra, the king of gods became the conqueror and the demons were defeated.3.
In way, the fourth incarnation manifested himself, on account of which Indra, conquered and the demons were defeated

615.g: ਉਠਿ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਸੁ ਸਰਬ ॥
ਧਰਿ ਨੀਚ ਨੈਨ ਕਰਿ ਦੂਰ ਗਰਬ ॥੪॥
615.e: Then all the gods relinquished their pried and served with him bowed eyes.4.

615.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਚਤੁਰਥ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਚੇਸ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੪॥
615.e: End of the description of Baches, the fourth incarnation of Brahma.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

615.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਰਾਵਣਹਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
615.e: God is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Great Giver; God is the Supreme Lord and Master.

615.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੀਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
615.e: The Merciful Lord created all beings; God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||
My Guru is Himself my friend and support.

615.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ; ਅਚਰਜ ਭਈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
615.e: I am in celestial peace, bliss, joy, pleasure and wondrous glory. ||Pause||

615.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਏ. ਭੈ ਨਾਸੇ; ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
615.e: Seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru, my fears have been dispelled, and I am accepted in the Court of the True Lord.

615.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ. ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ; ਆਏ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਥਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
615.e: Singing His Glorious Praises, and worshipping in adoration the Name of the Lord, I have reached my destination. ||2||

615.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਭ ਉਸਤਤਿ; ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
615.e: Everyone applauds and congratulates me; the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is dear to me.

615.g: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
615.e: I am forever a sacrifice to my God, who has totally protected and preserved my honor. ||3||

615.g: ਗੋਸਟਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਉਧਰੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
615.e: They are saved, who receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; they listen to the spiritual dialogue of the Naam.

615.g: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ; ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੪॥
615.e: Nanak's God has become Merciful to him; he has arrived home in ecstasy. ||4||13||24||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

615.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
615.e: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect, Imperishable Lord, and the poison of sexual desire and anger shall be burnt away.

615.g: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੋ ਸਾਗਰੁ; ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
615.e: You shall cross over the awesome, arduous ocean of fire, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
The Perfect Guru has dispelled the darkness of doubt.

615.g: ਭਜੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
615.e: Remember God with love and devotion; He is near at hand. ||Pause||

615.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ; ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
615.e: Drink in the sublime essence, the treasure of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and your mind and body shall remain satisfied.

615.g: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
615.e: The Transcendent Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere; where would He come from, and where would He go? ||2||

615.g: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤ ਬੇਤਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
615.e: One whose mind is filled with the Lord, is a person of meditation, penance, self-restraint and spiritual wisdom, and a knower of reality.

615.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
615.e: The Gurmukh obtains the jewel of the Naam; his efforts come to perfect fruition. ||3||

615.g: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਗਲੇ; ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
615.e: All his struggles, sufferings and pains are dispelled, and the noose of death is cut away from him.

615.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ; ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੩॥
615.e: Says Nanak, God has extended His Mercy, and so his mind and body blossom forth. ||4||12||23||

616.g: ਜੋ ਹੁਤੀ ਜਗ ਅਰੁ ਬੇਦ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
ਸੋ ਕਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
616.e: He performed all the Vedic traditions with devotion
He also gave various types of charities concerning lands, jewels ect.16.

616.g: ਕਰਿ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਇਮਿ ਨੀਤਿ ਰਾਜ ॥
ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਦਾਨ ਦੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਜ ॥
616.e: He promulgated his policies in all the countries, and donated gifts of various type
He donated elephants ect. And performed various types of ashvamedha yajnas (horse-sacrifices). 17.
He donated many decorated horses to those Brahmins, who had the knowledge of eighteen sciences, who were the reciters of six Shastr ect.
And also those who were skilful in playing various types of musical instruments.18.
At that time the Sandal and roses were rubbed and the liquor of musk was prepared
During the reign of that king, the abodes of all the people gave out the fragrance of Kashmiri grass.19.

616.g: ਅਥ ਪ੍ਰਿਥੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
616.e: Now begins the description of the rule of king Prithu.
TOTAK STANZA

616.g: ਕਹੰ ਲਾਗ ਗਨੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਜੌਨ ਭਏ ॥

616.e: How many kings were there and how many of them were merged by the Lord in his light? To what extent should I describe them.
Then there was Prithu, the Lord of the earth, who donated enormous gifts to the Brahmins.23.

616.g: ਦਲੁ ਲੈ ਦਿਨ ਏਕ ਸਿਕਾਰ ਚੜੇ ॥
ਬਨਿ ਨਿਰਜਨ ਮੋ ਲਖਿ ਬਾਘ ਬੜੇ ॥
616.e: One day, in a desolate forest, seeing huge lions, he went hunting, along with his army, in order to attack them

616.g: ਸਸਿ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੀ ਲਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੨੪॥
616.e: There a women named Shakuntala, whose light bedimmed even the luster of the sun.24.

616.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਅਪੁਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ; ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
616.e: By His Mercy, He has made me His own, and the imperishable Lord has come to dwell within my mind. ||2||

616.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ; ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
616.e: No misfortune afflicts one who is protected by the True Guru.

616.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
616.e: The Lotus Feet of God come to abide within his heart, and he savors the sublime essence of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

616.g: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥
616.e: So, as a servant, serve your God, who fulfills your mind's desires.

616.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ. ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੨੫॥
616.e: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to the Perfect Lord, who has protected and preserved his honor. ||4||14||25||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Panch-Padhay:

616.g: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
616.e: May my emotional attachment, my sense of mine and yours, and my self-conceit be dispelled. ||1||
O Saints, show me such a way,
by which my egotism and pride might be eliminated. ||1||Pause||

616.g: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਹੋਵਾਂ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਨਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
616.e: I see the Supreme Lord God in all beings, and I am the dust of all. ||2||

616.g: ਪੇਖਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਸੰਗੇ; ਚੂਕੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
616.e: I see God always with me, and the wall of doubt has been shattered. ||3||

616.g: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ; ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥੪॥
616.e: The medicine of the Naam, and the Immaculate Water of Ambrosial Nectar, are obtained through the Guru's Gate. ||4||

616.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਦਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੧੭॥੨੮॥
616.e: Says Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, meets with the Guru, and his diseases are cured. ||5||17||28||
SANGET PADRI STANZA
The tunes of Iyer, drum etc. were heard
The pleasing sounds of tabors, clarions, clarionets ect. Were also heard.2o.
Somewhere there wes tune of drum, lyer etc. and somewhere the sound of tabor, anklet, drum,musical glasses ect. Was heard

616.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੁਬਾਸ ॥

616.e: There was feeling of fragrance everywhere and with this rising odour,all the abodes seemed fragrant.21.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

616.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨੁ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ; ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
616.e: Infatuated with the darkness of emotional attachment to Maya, he does not know the Lord, the Great Giver.

616.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ; ਬਲੁ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
616.e: The Lord created his body and fashioned his soul, but he claims that his power is his own. ||1||

616.g: ਮਨ ਮੂੜੇ; ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
616.e: O foolish mind, God, your Lord and Master is watching over you.

616.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ; ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਛਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
616.e: Whatever you do, He knows; nothing can remain concealed from Him. ||Pause||

616.g: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੁਆਦ ਲੋਭ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤੋ; ਉਪਜੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
616.e: You are intoxicated with the tastes of the tongue, with greed and pride; countless sins spring from these.

616.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਰਮਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੇ ਭਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
616.e: You wandered in pain through countless incarnations, weighed down by the chains of egotism. ||2||

616.g: ਦੇਇ ਕਿਵਾੜ ਅਨਿਕ ਪੜਦੇ ਮਹਿ; ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਫਾਕੈ ॥
616.e: Behind closed doors, hidden by many screens, the man takes his pleasure with another man's wife.

616.g: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗਹਿ; ਤਬ ਕਉਣੁ. ਪੜਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਢਾਕੈ ॥੩॥
616.e: When Chitr and Gupt, the celestial accountants of the conscious and subconscious, call for your account, who will screen you then? ||3||

616.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ; ਤੁਮ ਬਿਨੁ. ਓਟ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
616.e: O Perfect Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pain, without You, I have no shelter at all.

616.g: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੬॥
616.e: Please, lift me up out of the world-ocean; O God, I have come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||15||26||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

616.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਹਾਈ; ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
616.e: The Supreme Lord God has become my helper and friend; His sermon and the Kirtan of His Praises have brought me peace.

616.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ; ਜਪਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
616.e: Chant the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani, and be ever in bliss, O mortal. ||1||
Remember the True Lord in meditation, O Siblings of Destiny.

616.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿ. ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
616.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, eternal peace is obtained, and the Lord is never forgotten. ||Pause||

616.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
616.e: Your Name, O Transcendent Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar; whoever meditates on it, lives.

616.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥੀਵੈ ॥੨॥
616.e: One who is blessed with God's Grace - that humble servant becomes immaculate and pure. ||2||

616.g: ਬਿਘਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਨ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
616.e: Obstacles are removed, and all pains are eliminated; my mind is attached to the Guru's feet.

616.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ. ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
616.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the immovable and imperishable Lord, one remains awake to the Lord's Love, day and night. ||3||

616.g: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥
616.e: He obtains the fruits of his mind's desires, listening to the comforting sermon of the Lord.

616.g: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਬੇਲੀ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੭॥
616.e: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, God is Nanak's best friend. ||4||16||27||
HARIBOLMANA STANZA
After killing a deer and seeing a desolate cottage, the king reached there.25.
HARIBOLMANA STANZA
When manu ruled, he removed the suffering of the people and he was so good that even the gods felt shy after listening to his approbation.22.

616.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੧॥੫॥
616.e: End of the description of the rule of king Manu in Bachitar Natak.

617.e: Speech of the king addressed to the woman
You may tell me some sign or saying, otherwise I shall not wed You; O woman! Do not forsake your shyness 42.
Speech of the woman addressed to the king:
HARIBOLMANA STANZA
“O king! I am the same woman, with whom you had had sexual enjoyment in the forest-cottage.38.
“Then you had given your word now you have forgotten, O king! remember that promise and now own me.39.
“If now you are forsaking me, then why did you own me at that time? O king! I am saying the truth that he is your son.40.
“If you will not wed me, then I shall curse you, therefore now do not forsake me and do not feel shy.”41.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

617.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਬਿਰਥੀ ਘਾਲ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
617.e: Meditating in remembrance on Him, all things are obtained, and one's efforts shall not be in vain.

617.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ. ਅਵਰ ਕਤ ਰਾਚਹੁ; ਜੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
617.e: Forsaking God, why do you attach yourself to another? He is contained in everything. ||1||
O Saints, meditate in remembrance on the World-Lord, Har, Har.

617.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
617.e: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; your efforts shall be rewarded. ||1||Pause||

617.g: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਨਿਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
617.e: He ever preserves and cherishes His servant; with Love, He hugs him close.

617.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਿਸਰਤ; ਜਗਤ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੨॥
617.e: Says Nanak, forgetting You, O God, how can the world find life? ||2||4||32||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

617.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਝੂਠ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਇਨ ਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਵਹੁ ॥
617.e: Sexual desire, anger, greed, falsehood and slander - please, save me from these, O Lord.

617.g: ਇਹ ਭੀਤਰ ਤੇ ਇਨ ਕਉ ਡਾਰਹੁ; ਆਪਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
617.e: Please eradicate these from within me, and call me to come close to You. ||1||
You alone teach me Your Ways.
With the Lord's humble servants, I sing His Praises. ||1||Pause||

617.g: ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ. ਕਬਹੂ ਹੀਏ ਤੇ; ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
617.e: May I never forget the Lord within my heart; please, instill such understanding within my mind.

617.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਧਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੧॥
617.e: By great good fortune, servant Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru, and now, he will not go anywhere else. ||2||3||31||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

617.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦਾ; ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਦੁਖੀ ॥
617.e: Meditating on Him, one is in ecstasy; the pains of birth and death and fear are removed.

617.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ. ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖੀ ॥੧॥
617.e: The four cardinal blessings, and the nine treasures are received; you shall never feel hunger or thirst again. ||1||

617.g: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ; ਤੂ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
617.e: Chanting His Name, you shall be at peace.

617.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ; ਮਨ ਤਨ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਮੁਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
617.e: With each and every breath, meditate on the Lord and Master, O my soul, with mind, body and mouth. ||1||Pause||

617.g: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ; ਅਗਨਿ. ਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧੁਖੀ ॥
617.e: You shall find peace, and your mind shall be soothed and cooled; the fire of desire shall not burn within you.

617.g: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ; ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰੁਖੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੦॥
617.e: The Guru has revealed God to Nanak, in the three worlds, in the water, the earth and the woods. ||2||2||30||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

617.g: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ. ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ॥
617.e: He is imperishable, the Giver of all beings; meditating on Him, all filth is removed.

617.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ. ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਬਰਤਨਿ; ਬਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
617.e: He is the treasure of excellence, the object of His devotees, but rare are those who find Him. ||1||

617.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ; ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
617.e: O my mind, meditate on the Guru, and God, the Cherisher of the world.

617.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
617.e: Seeking His Sanctuary, one finds peace, and he shall not suffer in pain again. ||1||Pause||

617.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ; ਤਿਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
617.e: By great good fortune, one obtains the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Meeting them, evil-mindedness is eliminated.
He went there and there was none with him, he saw a very charming woman there.26.
Her glory coveted his mind, when the king saw her, his mind was startled.27.
The king though as to whose daughter that beautiful woman was, seeing here beauty the king saw allured and his mind fell in love with her.28.
The king caught her arm and that woman kept silent, absorded and dyed with love, both became lustful.29.
The king enjoyed her in various ways till night both of them felt so much pleased with each other that is the not possible for me to narrate.30.
Being absorbed and dyed with love, they kept engrossed in sexual enjoinment many types of postures.31.
They enjoyment the relish of various types of postures and in the way, both of them established their sexual sport.32.
After that woman having enjoyed the sexual sport, came out of that cottage, the king went away and Shakuntala became pregnant.33.
Many days passed, when she gave birth to a child, who was wearing armour on his body and was also the abductor of moon’s beauty.34.
His splendour was like the forest-fire, whosoever saw him, he was wonder-struck.35.
When the child grew a bit older, she (the mother) took him there where his father was.36.
When the king saw her, he hesitated a little and asked her ”O” woman, who are you and who is this boy?”37.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Dho-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

617.g: ਸਗਲ ਬਨਸਪਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ; ਸਗਲ ਦੂਧ ਮਹਿ ਘੀਆ ॥
617.e: Fire is contained in all firewood, and butter is contained in all milk.

617.g: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀਆ ॥੧॥
617.e: God's Light is contained in the high and the low; the Lord is in the hearts of all beings. ||1||
O Saints, He is pervading and permeating each and every heart.

617.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ; ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਆਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
617.e: The Perfect Lord is completely permeating everyone, everywhere; He is diffused in the water and the land. ||1||Pause||

617.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਓ ॥
617.e: Nanak sings the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of excellence; the True Guru has dispelled his doubt.

617.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਦਾ ਅਲੇਪਾ; ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੯॥
617.e: The Lord is pervading everywhere, permeating all, and yet, He is unattached from all. ||2||1||29||

618.g: ਕਸ ਹੇਰ ਤਲੈ ॥੪੩॥
618.e: Sakuntla placed a gold coin on the hand of the king and said, " You look at it and remember." 43.

618.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਜਾਨਿ ਗਏ ॥
ਪਹਿਚਾਨਤ ਭਏ ॥
ਤਬ ਤਉਨ ਬਰੀ ॥
ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਭਰੀ ॥੪੪॥
618.e: The king remembered all and recognised Shakuntala,Then the king solemnised his wedding with her and enjoyed her in various ways.44.

618.g: ਸਿਸੁ ਸਾਤ ਭਏ ॥
ਰਸ ਰੂਪ ਰਏ ॥
ਅਮਿਤੋਜ ਬਲੀ ॥
ਦਲ ਦੀਹ ਦਲੀ ॥੪੫॥
618.e: She had seven charming sons born to her, who were man of infinite glory and destroyers of enemies. 45.

618.g: ਹਨਿ ਭੂਪ ਬਲੀ ॥
ਜਿਣਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਥਲੀ ॥
ਰਿਖਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਰਜੀ ॥
ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗ ਸਜੀ ॥੪੬॥
618.e: They conquered the earth after killing the mighty kings and inviting the sages performed the Yajna. 46.

618.g: ਸੁਭ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ॥
ਅਰਿ ਪੁੰਜ ਹਰੇ ॥
ਅਤਿ ਸੂਰ ਮਹਾ ॥
ਨਹਿ ਔਰ ਲਹਾ ॥੪੭॥
618.e: The performed good actions and destroyed the enemies and none seems equivalent in bravery to them. 47.

618.g: ਅਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਲਸੈ ॥
ਸਸਿ ਕ੍ਰਾਤਿ ਕਸੈ ॥
ਦਿਸ ਚਾਰ ਚਕੀ ॥
ਸੁਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਛਕੀ ॥੪੮॥
618.e: They were lustrous like moonlight and women of gods of all the four directions were pleased to see them. 48.

618.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
618.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

618.g: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ. ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ; ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪਾਹਿ ਨਿਬੇਰੋ ॥
618.e: Only You know the state of my innermost self; You alone can judge me.

618.g: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ. ਸਾਹਿਬ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ; ਲਾਖ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਫੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
618.e: Please forgive me, O Lord God Master; I have committed thousands of sins and mistakes. ||1||

618.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ; ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨੇਰੋ ॥
618.e: O my Dear Lord God Master, You are always near me.

618.g: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ; ਮੋਹਿ ਚੇਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
618.e: O Lord, please bless Your disciple with the shelter of Your feet. ||1||Pause||

618.g: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਊਚੋ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰੋ ॥
618.e: Infinite and endless is my Lord and Master; He is lofty, virtuous and profoundly deep.

618.g: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ. ਕੀਨੋ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਦਾਸਰੋ; ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਹਾ ਨਿਹੋਰੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੫॥
618.e: Cutting away the noose of death, the Lord has made Nanak His slave, and now, what does he owe to anyone else? ||2||7||35||

618.g: ਅਥ ਰਾਜਾ ਭਰਥ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
ਰੂਆਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
618.e: ROOAAL STANZA

618.g: ਜਾਨਿ ਅੰਤ ਸਮੋ ਭਯੋ; ਪ੍ਰਿਥੁ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਜ ਵਤਾਰ ॥
ਬੋਲਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮ੍ਰਿਧਿ ਸੰਪਤਿ; ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥
618.e: Considering his end very near, the king Prithu called for all his assets, friends, ministers and princes

618.g: ਸਪਤ ਦ੍ਵੀਪ ਸੁ ਸਪਤ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਨਿ; ਬਾਟ ਦੀਨ ਤੁਰੰਤ ॥
ਸਪਤ ਰਾਜ ਕਰੈ ਲਗੈ; ਸੁਤ ਸਰਬ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ॥੫੧॥
618.e: He immediately the seven continents among his seven sons and they all being to rule with extreme glory.51.

618.g: ਸਪਤ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰੈ ਲਗੈ ਸਿਰ; ਸਪਤ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥
ਸਪਤ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪਰੇ ਧਰਾ ਪਰਿ; ਸਪਤ ਜਾਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
618.e: The canopies swung over the heads of all the seven princes and they were all considered as the seven incarnation of Indra

618.g: ਸਰਬ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਰੀ ਸਬੈ ਮਿਲਿ; ਬੇਦ ਰੀਤਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ॥
ਦਾਨ ਅੰਸ ਨਿਕਾਰ ਲੀਨੀ; ਅਰਥ ਸ੍ਵਰਥ ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ॥੫੨॥
618.e: They established all the Shastras with commentaries according to Vedic rites and held in honour again the significance of charity.52.

618.g: ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਅਖੰਡ ਉਰਬੀ; ਬਾਟਿ ਲੀਨਿ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥
ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਭਏ ਪੁਨਿਰ; ਨਵਖੰਡ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
618.e: Those princes fragmented the earth and distributed amongst themselves and seven continents “Nav-Khand’ (nine regions)

618.g: ਜੇਸਟ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਧਰੀ ਧਰਾ; ਤਿਹ ਭਰਥ ਨਾਮ ਬਖਾਨ ॥
ਭਰਥ ਖੰਡ ਬਖਾਨ ਹੀ; ਦਸ ਚਾਰ ਚਾਰੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥੫੩॥
618.e: The eldest son, whose name was Bharat, he named one of the region as “Bharat Khand”, after the name of the adept Bharat, who was expert in eighteen sciences.53.

618.g: ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਕਹੈ ਕਥੇ ਕਵਿ, ਨਾਮ ਠਾਮ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
618.e: Which names should be mentioned here by the poet ?

618.g: ਬਾਟਿ ਬਾਟਿ ਸਬੋ ਲਏ; ਨਵਖੰਡ ਦ੍ਵੀਪ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥
618.e: They all distributed the Nav-Khand continents among themselves

618.g: ਠਾਮ ਠਾਮ ਭਏ ਨਰਾਧਿਪ; ਠਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
618.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

618.g: ਸੰਚਨਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਥਾਤੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
618.e: I gather in and collect the immaculate wealth of the Naam; this commodity is inaccessible and incomparable.

618.g: ਬਿਲਛਿ ਬਿਨੋਦ. ਆਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣਹੁ; ਖਾਇ ਜੀਵਹੁ. ਸਿਖ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
618.e: Revel in it, delight in it, be happy and enjoy peace, and live long, O Sikhs and brethren. ||1||

618.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ; ਆਧਾਰ ॥
618.e: I have the support of the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

618.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਚ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ; ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਉ. ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
618.e: By the Grace of the Saints, I have found the boat of Truth; embarking on it, I sail across the ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||

618.g: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਆਪਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
618.e: The perfect, imperishable Lord has become merciful; He Himself has taken care of me.

618.g: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾਨੋ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੩੮॥
618.e: Beholding, beholding His Vision, Nanak has blossomed forth in ecstasy. O Nanak, He is beyond estimation. ||2||10||38||

618.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
618.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

618.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ; ਸਭ ਘਟ ਉਪਜੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
618.e: The Perfect Guru has revealed His power, and compassion has welled up in every heart.

618.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਕੀਨੀ; ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਸਭ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
618.e: Blending me with Himself, He has blessed me with glorious greatness, and I have found pleasure and happiness. ||1||

618.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ; ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
618.e: The Perfect True Guru is always with me.

618.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
618.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

618.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਬਸੇ ਰਿਦ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਸੁਭ ਲਖਣ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
618.e: The Guru's feet abide within my heart; God has blessed me with good fortune.

618.g: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ; ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਨੇ ॥੧॥
618.e: The Perfect Transcendent Lord became merciful to me, and I found the treasure of the Naam within my mind. ||1||

618.g: ਮੇਰੋ ਗੁਰੁ; ਰਖਵਾਰੋ ਮੀਤ ॥
618.e: My Guru is my Saving Grace, my only best friend.

618.g: ਦੂਣ ਚਊਣੀ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਸੋਭਾ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
618.e: Over and over again, He blesses me with double, even four-fold, greatness. ||1||Pause||

618.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ; ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
618.e: God saves all beings and creatures, giving them the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

618.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ. ਅਚਰਜ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੩੭॥
618.e: Wondrous is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||37||

618.g: ਰੂਆਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
618.e: ROOAAL STANZA

618.g: ਗਾਰਿ ਗਾਰਿ ਅਖਰਬ ਗਰਬਿਨ; ਮਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਰੇਸ ॥
ਜੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਅਜੀਤ ਰਾਜਨ; ਛੀਨਿ ਦੇਸ ਬਿਦੇਸ ॥
618.e: They killed innumerable proud kings and snatching the kingdoms of invincible kings, they killed them

618.g: ਟਾਰਿ ਟਾਰਿ ਕਰੋਰਿ ਪਬਯ; ਦੀਨ ਉਤਰ ਦਿਸਾਨ ॥
ਸਪਤ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਭਏ ਧਰਾ ਪਰ; ਲੀਕ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਰਥਾਨ ॥੪੯॥
618.e: They went to the North, crossing many mountains and with the lines of the wheels of their chariots seven oceans were formed. 49.

618.g: ਗਾਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ਅਗਾਹ ਦੇਸਨ; ਬਾਹਿ ਬਾਹਿ ਹਥਿਯਾਰ ॥
ਤੋਰਿ ਤੋਰਿ ਅਤੋਰ ਭੂਧ੍ਰਿਕ; ਦੀਨ ਉਤ੍ਰਹਿ ਟਾਰ ॥
618.e: By striking their weapons and roaming on the whole earth and breaking the mountains, they threw their fragments in the North

618.g: ਦੇਸ ਔਰ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਜੀਤਿ; ਬਿਸੇਖ ਰਾਜ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
ਅੰਤ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੋ ਮਿਲਿ; ਜਾਤਿ ਭੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਥ ਰਾਇ ॥੫੦॥
618.e: After conquering various countries far and near and ruling over them, the king prithu ultimately merged in the Supreme Light.50.

618.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਅਵਤਾਰੇ ਬਿਆਸ ਰਾਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਥੁ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੨॥੫॥
ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
618.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

618.g: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਏ ॥
618.e: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, became merciful to me, and I obtained all of my mind's desires.

618.g: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਭਏ. ਲਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ; ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
618.e: I have become stable and steady, touching the Lord's Feet, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

618.g: ਭਲੋ ਸਮੂਰਤੁ; ਪੂਰਾ ॥
618.e: It is a good time, a perfectly auspicious time.

618.g: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ. ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ; ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
618.e: I am in celestial peace, tranquility and ecstasy, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unstruck melody of the sound current vibrates and resounds. ||1||Pause||

618.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
618.e: Meeting with my Beloved Lord and Master, my home has become a mansion filled with happiness.

618.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ. ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਗਲੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੩੬॥
618.e: Servant Nanak has attained the treasure of the Lord's Name; all his desires have been fulfilled. ||2||8||36||

618.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ. ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਬਾਛੈ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰੋਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੩੩॥
618.e: Slave Nanak yearns for the dust of the feet of those, who have woven the Lord's Name into their hearts. ||2||5||33||

618.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
618.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

618.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ; ਸੂਕਾ ਮਨੁ. ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ॥
618.e: He dispels the pains of countless incarnations, and lends support to the dry and shrivelled mind.

618.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
618.e: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is enraptured, contemplating the Name of the Lord. ||1||

618.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਬੈਦੁ; ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
618.e: My physician is the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

618.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ; ਕਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
618.e: He places the medicine of the Naam into my mouth, and cuts away the noose of Death. ||1||Pause||

618.g: ਸਮਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ; ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
618.e: He is the all-powerful, Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.

618.g: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੩੪॥
618.e: The Lord Himself saves His slave; Nanak takes the Support of the Naam. ||2||6||34||

619.g: ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਉਚਾਰੀਐ; ਕਰਿ ਸੂਰ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੫੪॥
619.e: Many of various names ruled over many places and with power of intellect, whose names should be mentioned, with their description? 54.

619.g: ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪਨ ਸਪਤ ਭੂਪ; ਭੁਗੈ ਲਗੇ ਨਵਖੰਡ ॥
ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿਨ ਸੋ ਫਿਰੇ; ਅਸਿ ਬਾਧਿ ਜੋਧ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ॥
619.e: The king ruled over seven continents and nine regions and taking up their swords, in various ways, they moved at all places powerfully

619.g: ਦੀਹ ਦੀਹ ਅਜੀਹ ਦੇਸਨਿ; ਨਾਮ ਆਪਿ ਭਨਾਇ ॥
ਆਨਿ ਜਾਨੁ ਦੁਤੀ ਭਏ ਛਿਤਿ; ਦੂਸਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੫੫॥
619.e: They forcefully promulgated their names and it seemed that they were the incarnation of the Lord on the earth.55.

619.g: ਆਪ ਆਪ ਸਮੈ ਸਬੈ ਸਿਰਿ; ਅਤ੍ਰ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥
ਜੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਅਜੀਤ ਜੋਧਨ; ਰੋਹ ਕ੍ਰੋਹ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
619.e: They continued to conquer furiously the invincible warriors, swinging the canopies over the heads of one another

619.g: ਝੂਠ ਸਾਚ ਅਨੰਤ ਬੋਲਿ; ਕਲੋਲ ਕੇਲ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲ ਸਬੈ ਭਛੇ; ਜਗਿ ਛਾਡੀਆ ਨਹਿ ਏਕ ॥੫੬॥
619.e: Garrying on behavior conquer furiously the invincible warriors, Swinging the canopies over the ultimately became the food of KAL ( death).56.

619.g: ਆਪ ਅਰਥ ਅਨਰਥ ਅਪਰਥ; ਸਮਰਥ ਕਰਤ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਤ ਠਟੀ ਕਛੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੋਟਿ ਕ︀ਯੋਨ ਨ ਕਰੰਤ ॥
619.e: The powerful people perform many sinful action and unjust deeds, for their interest, but ultimately they have to appear before the Lord

619.g: ਜਾਨ ਬੂਝ ਪਰੰਤ ਕੂਪ; ਲਹੰਤ ਮੂੜ ਨ ਭੇਵ ॥
619.e: The being deliberately falls into the well and dose not know the secret of the Lord

619.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲ ਤਬੈ ਬਚੈ; ਜਬ ਜਾਨ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੫੭॥
619.e: He will only save himself from death, when he will comprehend that Guru-Lord.57.

619.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਤ ਠਟੀ ਭਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਮੂੜ ਲੋਗ ਨ ਜਾਨਿ ॥
619.e: The fools do not know that ultimately we feet shy before the Lord

619.g: ਆਪ ਅਰਥ ਪਛਾਨ ਹੀ; ਤਜਿ ਦੀਹ ਦੇਵ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
619.e: These fools forsaking their supreme father, the Lord, only recognize their own interest

619.g: ਧਰਮ ਜਾਨਿ ਕਰਤ ਪਾਪਨ; ਯੌ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਮੂੜ ॥
ਸਰਬ ਕਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੋ; ਕਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਯੋਗ ਗੂੜ ਅਗੂੜ ॥੫੮॥
619.e: They commit sins in the name of religion and they do not know even this much that this is the profound myself of the compassionate of the Name of the Lord.58

619.g: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਛਾਨ ਹੀ ਕਰਿ; ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਸਮ ਪਾਪ ॥
ਪਰਮ ਜਾਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਪਨ; ਜਪੈ ਲਾਗ ਕੁਜਾਪ ॥
619.e: They are ever absorbed in evil action considering sin as virtue and virtue as sin, the holy as unholy and without knowing the remembrance of the Name of the Lord:

619.g: ਸਿਧ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਮਾਨਹੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਧ ਠਉਰ ਪੂਜੰਤ ॥
619.e: The being does not believe in the good place and worship bad place

619.g: ਹਾਥਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਲੈ ਮਹਾ ਪਸੁ; ਮਧਿ ਕੂਪ ਪਰੰਤ ॥੫੯॥
619.e: In such a position he falls in the well, even having the lamp in his hand.59.

619.g: ਸਿਧ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਮਾਨ ਹੀ; ਅਨਸਿਧ ਪੂਜਤ ਠਉਰ ॥
619.e: Having on belief in holy places, he worship the unholy ones

619.g: ਕੈ ਕੁ ਦਿਵਸ ਚਲਾਹਿਗੇ, ਜੜ ਭੀਤ ਕੀ ਸੀ ਦਉਰ ॥
619.e: But for now many days he will be able to run such a cowardly race ?

619.g: ਪੰਖ ਹੀਨ ਕਹਾ ਉਡਾਇਬ, ਨੈਨ ਹੀਨ ਨਿਹਾਰ ॥
619.e: Hoe can one fly without the wings? And how can one see without the eyes? How can one go to the battlefield without weapons

619.g: ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਹੀਨ ਜੁਧਾ ਨ ਪੈਠਬ; ਅਰਥ ਹੀਨ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੬੦॥
619.e: And without understaning the meaning how can one understand any problem?.60.

619.g: ਦਰਬ ਹੀਣ ਬਪਾਰ ਜੈਸਕ; ਅਰਥ ਬਿਨੁ ਇਸ ਲੋਕ ॥
ਆਂਖ ਹੀਣ ਬਿਲੋਕਬੋ ਜਗਿ ਕਾਮਕੇਲ ਅਕੋਕ ॥
619.e: How can one indulge in trade without wealth? How can one visualise the lustful actions without eyes?

619.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਹੀਣ ਸੁ ਪਾਠ ਗੀਤਾ; ਬੁਧਿ ਹੀਣ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
ਹਿੰਮਤ ਹੀਨ ਜੁਧਾਨ ਜੂਝਬ; ਕੇਲ ਹੀਣ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥੬੧॥
619.e: How can one recite Gita without knowledge and reflect upon it without intellect? How can one go to the battlefield without counrage.61

619.g: ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਗਨਾਈਐ, ਜੇ ਭਏ ਭੂਮਿ ਮਹੀਪ ॥
ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਸੁ ਕਥੀਐ, ਜਗਿ ਕੇ ਸੁ ਦ੍ਵੀਪ ਅਦ੍ਵੀਪ ॥
619.e: How many kings were there? To want extent they be enumerated, and how far should the continents and regions of the world be described?

619.g: ਜਾਸੁ ਕੀਨ, ਗਨੈ ਵਹੈ; ਇਮਿ ਔਰ ਕੀ ਨਹਿ ਸਕਤਿ ॥
ਯੌ ਨ ਐਸ ਪਹਚਾਨੀਐ; ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਕੀਏ ਭਗਤਿ ॥੬੨॥
619.e: I have enumerated, only those which have come within my sight, I am unable to enumerate more and the this is also not possible without His devotion.62.

619.g: ਇਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਭਰਥ ਰਾਜ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੩॥੫॥
ਅਥ ਰਾਜਾ ਸਗਰ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
ਰੂਆਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
619.e: ROOAAL STANZA

619.g: ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਭਏ ਜਿਤੇ; ਇਹ ਭੂਮਿ ਆਨਿ ਨਰੇਸ ॥
ਤਉਨ ਤਉਨ ਉਚਾਰਹੋ; ਤੁਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਸੇਸ ॥
619.e: All the superb kings who had ruled over the earth, O Lord! With thy Grace, I describe at of them

619.g: ਭਰਥ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਤੀਤ ਭੇ; ਭਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਸਗਰ ਰਾਜ ॥
ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਤਪਸਾ ਕਰੀ; ਲੀਅ ਲਛ ਸੁਤ ਉਪਰਾਜਿ ॥੬੩॥
619.e: There was king sagar after Bharat, who meditated on Rudra and performed austerities, he obtained the boon of one lakh sons.63.

619.g: ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬਕ੍ਰ ਧੁਜਾ ਗਦਾ; ਭ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਬ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥
ਲਛ ਰੂਪ ਧਰੇ ਮਨੋ; ਜਗਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੈਨ ਸੁ ਧਾਰ ॥
619.e: They were princes of discus, banners and maces and it seemed that the god of love had manifested himself in lakhs of forms

619.g: ਬੇਖ ਬੇਖ ਬਨੇ ਨਰੇਸ੍ਵਰ; ਜੀਤਿ ਦੇਸ ਅਸੇਸ ॥
ਦਾਸ ਭਾਵ ਸਬੈ ਧਰੇ; ਮਨਿ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਨਰੇਸ ॥੬੪॥
619.e: They conquered various countries and became kings considering them sovereigns became their servants.64.

619.g: ਬਾਜ ਮੇਧ ਕਰੈ ਲਗੈ; ਹਯਸਾਲਿ ਤੇ ਹਯ ਚੀਨਿ ॥
619.e: They selected a fine horse from their stable and decided to perform Ashvamedha Yajna

619.g: ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲ ਰਿਤੁਜ; ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ॥
619.e: They invited the ministers, friends and Brahmins

619.g: ਸੰਗ ਦੀਨ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੈਨ; ਬ੍ਰਯੂਹ ਬ੍ਰਯੂਹ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰੈ ਲਗੇ; ਸਿਰਿ ਅਤ੍ਰ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥੬੫॥
619.e: After that they gave groups of their forces to their ministers, who moved here and there, swinging the canopies over their heada.65.

619.g: ਜੈਤਪਤ੍ਰ ਲਹ︀ਯੋ ਜਹਾ ਤਹ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਭੇ ਸਭ ਚੂਰ ॥
619.e: They obtained letter of victory from all the places and all their enemies were smashed

619.g: ਛੋਰਿ ਛੋਰਿ ਭਜੇ ਨਰੇਸ੍ਵਰ; ਛਾਡਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੂਰ ॥
619.e: All the such kings ran away, forsaking their weapons

619.g: ਡਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਸਨਾਹਿ ਸੂਰ; ਤ੍ਰੀਆਨ ਭੇਸ ਸੁ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
ਭਾਜਿ ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲੇ ਜਹਾ ਤਹ; ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੬੬॥
619.e: These warriors, putting off their armours, assuming the guise of women and forgetting their sons and friends, ran away here and there.66.

619.g: ਗਾਜਿ ਗਾਜਿ ਗਜੇ ਗਦਾਧਰਿ; ਭਾਜਿ ਭਾਜਿ ਸੁ ਭੀਰ ॥
619.e: The mace-wielders thundered and the cowards fled away

619.g: ਸਾਜ ਬਾਜ ਤਜੈ ਭਜੈ ਬਿਸੰਭਾਰ ਬੀਰ ਸੁਧੀਰ ॥
619.e: Many warriors leaving their paraphernalia ran away

619.g: ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਗਜੇ ਜਹਾ ਤਹ; ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਨਚਾਇ ॥
ਜੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਲਏ ਸੁ ਦੇਸਨ; ਜੈਤਪਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥੬੭॥
619.e: Wherever there brave warriors thundered, activating their arms and weapons, they obtained victory and got the letter of conquest.67.

619.g: ਜੀਤਿ ਪੂਰਬ ਪਛਿਮੈ; ਅਰੁ ਲੀਨ ਦਛਨਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
ਤਾਕਿ ਬਾਜ ਚਲ︀ਯੋ ਤਹਾ ਜਹ ਬੈਠਿ ਥੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
619.e: They conquered the East, West and south and now the horse reached there where the grate sage Kapila was sitting

619.g: ਧ੍ਰਯਾਨ ਮਧਿ ਹੁਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਮੁਨਿ; ਸਾਜ ਬਾਜ ਨ ਦੇਖਿ ॥
ਪ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪਛ ਖਰੋ ਭਯੋ ਰਿਖਿ; ਜਾਨਿ ਗੋਰਖ ਭੇਖ ॥੬੮॥
619.e: He was absorbed in meditation, he did not see the home, which seeing him in the guise of Gorakh, stood behind him.68.

619.g: ਚਉਕ ਚਿਤ ਰਹੇ ਸਬੈ; ਜਬ ਦੇਖਿ ਨੈਨ ਨ ਬਾਜ ॥
619.e: When all the warriors did not see the horse, they were wonderstruks

619.g: ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਥਕੇ ਸਬੈ ਦਿਸ; ਚਾਰਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਸਲਾਜ ॥
619.e: And in their shame, began to search for the horse in all the four direction

619.g: ਜਾਨਿ ਪਯਾਰ ਗਯੋ ਤੁਰੰਗਮ; ਕੀਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
ਸਗਰ ਖਾਤ ਖੁਦੈ ਲਗੇ; ਰਣਧੀਰ ਬੀਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੬੯॥
619.e: Thinking this that the horse had gone to the nether-world, they tried to enter that world by digging a comprehensive pit.69.

619.g: ਖੋਦਿ ਖੋਦਿ ਅਖੋਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀ; ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਜੋਧ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
ਭਛਿ ਭਛਿ ਗਏ ਸਬੈ ਮੁਖ; ਮ੍ਰਿਤਕਾ ਦੁਤਿ ਵੰਤ ॥
619.e: The furious warriors began to dig the earth and the brightness of their faces became earth like

619.g: ਸਗਰ ਖਾਤ ਖੁਦੈ ਲਗੇ; ਦਿਸ ਖੋਦ ਦਛਨ ਸਰਬ ॥
ਜੀਤਿ ਪੂਰਬ ਕੋ ਚਲੇ; ਅਤਿ ਠਾਨ ਕੈ ਜੀਅ ਗਰਬ ॥੭੦॥
619.e: In this way when they made the whole of the South an abyss, then they conquering it advanced towards the East.70.

619.g: ਖੋਦ ਦਛਨ ਕੀ ਦਿਸਾ; ਪੁਨਿ ਖੋਦ ਪੂਰਬ ਦਿਸਾਨ ॥
ਤਾਕਿ ਪਛਮ ਕੋ ਚਲੇ; ਦਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
619.e: After digging the south and the east, those warriors, who were experts in all the sciences, fell upon the west

619.g: ਪੈਠਿ ਉਤਰ ਦਿਸਾ ਜਬੈ; ਖੋਦੈ ਲਗੇ ਸਭ ਠਉਰ ॥
ਅਉਰ ਅਉਰ ਠਟੈ ਪਸੂ; ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਠਾਟੀ ਅਉਰ ॥੭੧॥
619.e: When, advancing towards the north, they began to dig the earth, they were thinking sometime else in their minds, but the Lord had thought otherwise.71.

619.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਪਿ; ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
619.e: Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, I am forever in ecstasy. ||Pause||

619.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ; ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੋਈ ॥
619.e: Inwardly and outwardly, in all places and interspaces, wherever I look, He is there.

619.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੯॥
619.e: Nanak has found the Guru, by great good fortune; no one else is as great as He. ||2||11||39||

619.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
619.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

619.g: ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
619.e: I have been blessed with peace, pleasure, bliss, and the celestial sound current, gazing upon the feet of God.

619.g: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤਾਪੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
619.e: The Savior has saved His child, and the True Guru has cured his fever. ||1||

619.g: ਉਬਰੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
619.e: I have been saved, in the True Guru's Sanctuary;

619.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ; ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
619.e: service to Him does not go in vain. ||1||Pause||

619.g: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਖ. ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਖਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
619.e: There is peace within the home of one's heart, and there is peace outside as well, when God becomes kind and compassionate.

619.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਘਨੁ, ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਊ; ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੪੦॥
619.e: O Nanak, no obstacles block my way; my God has become gracious and merciful to me. ||2||12||40||

619.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
619.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

619.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਸਗਲਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
619.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Guru, the True Guru, all pains have been eradicated.

619.g: ਤਾਪ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ; ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
619.e: The fever and the disease are gone, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, and I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires. ||1||

619.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ; ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
619.e: My Perfect Guru is the Giver of peace.

619.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
619.e: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Almighty Lord and Master, the Perfect Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||Pause||

619.g: ਅਨੰਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ; ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
619.e: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord in bliss, joy and ecstasy; Guru Nanak has become kind and compassionate.

619.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ਭਏ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੪੩॥
