619.e: Shouts of cheers and congratulations ring out all over the world; the Supreme Lord God has become my Savior and Protector. ||2||15||43||

619.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
619.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

619.g: ਹਮਰੀ ਗਣਤ. ਨ ਗਣੀਆ ਕਾਈ; ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ॥
619.e: He did not take my accounts into account; such is His forgiving nature.

619.g: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
619.e: He gave me His hand, and saved me and made me His own; forever and ever, I enjoy His Love. ||1||

619.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਸਦ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਣ ॥
619.e: The True Lord and Master is forever merciful and forgiving.

619.g: ਬੰਧੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਹੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
619.e: My Perfect Guru has bound me to Him, and now, I am in absolute ecstasy. ||Pause||

619.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ. ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ; ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
619.e: The One who fashioned the body and placed the soul within, who gives you clothing and nourishment

619.g: ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖੀ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੪੪॥
619.e: - He Himself preserves the honor of His slaves. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||16||44||

619.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
619.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

619.g: ਗਏ ਕਲੇਸ ਰੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
619.e: My sufferings have come to an end, and all diseases have been eradicated.

619.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
619.e: God has showered me with His Grace. Twenty-four hours a day, I worship and adore my Lord and Master; my efforts have come to fruition. ||1||

619.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਤੂ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
619.e: O Dear Lord, You are my peace, wealth and capital.

619.g: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਉ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
619.e: Please, save me, O my Beloved! I offer this prayer to my God. ||Pause||

619.g: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਉ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਉ; ਅਪਨੇ ਖਸਮ ਭਰੋਸਾ ॥
619.e: Whatever I ask for, I receive; I have total faith in my Master.

619.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ; ਮਿਟਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੪੨॥
619.e: Says Nanak, I have met with the Perfect Guru, and all my fears have been dispelled. ||2||14||42||

619.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
619.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

619.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਦਮੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈ ॥
619.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my mind became excited, and I sang the Praises of the jewel of the Naam.

619.g: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਚਿੰਤਾ. ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਨੰਤਾ; ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
619.e: My anxiety was dispelled, meditating in remembrance on the Infinite Lord; I have crossed over the world ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

619.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
619.e: I enshrine the Lord's Feet within my heart.

619.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ; ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਣਿ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
619.e: I have found peace, and the celestial sound current resounds within me; countless diseases have been eradicated. ||Pause||

619.g: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ; ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
619.e: Which of Your Glorious Virtues can I speak and describe? Your worth cannot be estimated.

619.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਗਤ ਭਏ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੪੧॥
619.e: O Nanak, the Lord's devotees become imperishable and immortal; their God becomes their friend and support. ||2||13||41||

620.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
My True Guru is my Savior and Protector.

620.g: ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
620.e: Showering us with His Mercy and Grace, God extended His Hand, and saved Hargobind, who is now safe and secure. ||1||Pause||

620.g: ਤਾਪੁ ਗਇਆ. ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ; ਜਨ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
620.e: The fever is gone - God Himself eradicated it, and preserved the honor of His servant.

620.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਈ ॥੧॥
620.e: I have obtained all blessings from the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||1||

620.g: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੋਵੈ ਸਵਾਰੇ; ਹਮਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗੁਣੁ. ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
620.e: God has saved me, both here and hereafter. He has not taken my merits and demerits into account.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

620.g: ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ; ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
620.e: The Lord God Himself has rid the whole world of its sins, and saved it.

620.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ; ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
620.e: The Supreme Lord God extended His mercy, and confirmed His innate nature. ||1||
I have attained the Protective Sanctuary of the Lord, my King.

620.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
620.e: In celestial peace and ecstasy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and my mind, body and being are at peace. ||Pause||

620.g: ਪਤਿਤ. ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਮੋਹਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
620.e: My True Guru is the Savior of sinners; I have placed my trust and faith in Him.

620.g: ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸਭਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ; ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਾ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੪੫॥
620.e: The True Lord has heard Nanak's prayer, and He has forgiven everything. ||2||17||45||

620.g: ਖੋਦਿ ਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀ; ਪੂਜਿ ਅਰਧ ਦਿਸਾਨ ॥
ਅੰਤਿ ਭੇਦ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਆ ਮੁਨਿ ਬੈਠਿ ਸੰਜੁਤ ਧ︀ਯਾਨ ॥
620.e: While digging the earth in various ways, scanned all the directions, they ultimately saw the sage Kapila in medication

620.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਪਾਛ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਬਾਜ; ਸਮਾਜ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
ਲਾਤ ਭੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਮਾਰਿਓ; ਅਤਿ ਗਰਬ ਕੈ ਸੁਤ ਭੂਪ ॥੭੨॥
620.e: They saw the horse behind him and those princes in their pride, hit the sage with the leg.72.

620.g: ਧ੍ਰਯਾਨ ਛੂਟ ਤਬੈ ਮੁਨੀ; ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਜ੍ਵਾਲ ਮਾਲ ਕਰਾਲ ॥
ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿਨ ਸੋ ਉਠੀ; ਜਨੁ ਸਿੰਧ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿਸਾਲ ॥
620.e: The medication of the sage was broken and from within him arose various kinds of huge fires

620.g: ਭਸਮਿ ਭੂਤ ਭਏ ਸਬੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ; ਲਛ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸੁ ਨੈਨ ॥
ਬਾਜ ਰਾਜ ਸੁ ਸੰਪਦਾ ਜੁਤ; ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੁ ਸੈਨ ॥੭੩॥
620.e: In that fire, one-lakh sons of the king along with their horses, arms, weapons and forces were reduced to ashes.73.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

620.g: ਬਖਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ; ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
620.e: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, has forgiven me, and all diseases have been cured.

620.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਉਬਰੇ; ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
620.e: Those who come to the Sanctuary of the True Guru are saved, and all their affairs are resolved. ||1||
The Lord's humble servant meditates in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is his only support.

620.g: ਤਾਪੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
620.e: The Perfect True Guru extended His Mercy, and the fever has been dispelled. ||Pause||

620.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰਹ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
620.e: So celebrate and be happy, my beloveds - the Guru has saved Hargobind.

620.g: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ. ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ; ਸਾਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੪੬॥
620.e: Great is the glorious greatness of the Creator, O Nanak; True is the Word of His Shabad, and True is the sermon of His Teachings. ||2||18||46||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
O Saints, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

620.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਵਿਸਰਉ ਨਾਹੀ; ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
620.e: Never forget God, the ocean of peace; thus you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||

620.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ. ਤਾਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ; ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
620.e: Extending His Mercy, the Perfect True Guru has dispelled the fever.

620.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਭ ਪਰਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
620.e: The Supreme Lord God has become kind and compassionate, and my whole family is now free of pain and suffering. ||1||

620.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਰੂਪਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
620.e: The Treasure of absolute joy, sublime elixir and beauty, the Name of the Lord is my only Support.

620.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ; ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੪੮॥
620.e: O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord has preserved my honor, and saved the whole world. ||2||20||48||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

620.g: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
620.e: My Lord and Master has become Merciful, in His True Court.

620.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਤਾਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ; ਠਾਂਢਿ ਪਈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
620.e: The True Guru has taken away the fever, and the whole world is at peace, O Siblings of Destiny.

620.g: ਅਪਣੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ. ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੇ; ਜਮਹਿ ਕੀਓ ਹਟਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
620.e: The Lord Himself protects His beings and creatures, and the Messenger of Death is out of work. ||1||

620.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
620.e: Enshrine the Lord's feet within your heart.

620.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਦੁਖ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
620.e: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on God, O Siblings of Destiny. He is the Eradicator of suffering and sins. ||1||Pause||

620.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਊਬਰੈ ਭਾਈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
620.e: He fashioned all beings, O Siblings of Destiny, and His Sanctuary saves them.

620.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੋ ਭਾਈ; ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
620.e: He is the Almighty Creator, the Cause of causes, O Siblings of Destiny; He, the True Lord, is True.

620.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਭਾਈ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੪੭॥
620.e: Nanak: meditate on God, O Siblings of Destiny, and your mind and body shall be cool and calm. ||2||19||47||
MADHUBHAAR SATAZA
All the sons of the king were reduced to ashes and all his forces were destroyed while lamenting.74
When those prices of great glory were burnt down then the pride of all was smashed.75.
That most powerful Lord is extremely Glorious and the warriors of all the four directions fear Him.76.
Some warriors who had been burnt, ran impatiently towards the king and they conveyed the whole thing to the king sagar.77.
When the king sagar saw this, he impatiently asked the news about his sons.78.
Then all of them talked about their strength and also said how the pried of those warriors was destroyed, the tears were flowing from their eyes while saying this.79.
The messengers told this that his sons, causing their horse to move on all the earth, had conquered all the kings and had taken them along with themselves.80.
Your sons, thinking that the horse had gone to the nether-world, had dug the whole of the earth and in this way, their pride had enormously increased.81.
There all of them saw themost glorious sage (Kapila) absorbed in meditation.82.

621.g: ਅਟਲ ਬਚਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ; ਸਫਲ ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੪੯॥
621.e: Your Word is eternal, O Guru Nanak; You placed Your Hand of blessing upon my forehead. ||2||21||49||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Perfect Guru has granted His Grace,
and God has fulfilled my desire.
After taking my bath of purification, I returned to my home,
and I found bliss, happiness and peace. ||1||
O Saints, salvation comes from the Lord's Name.

621.g: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
621.e: While standing up and sitting down, meditate on the Lord's Name. Night and day, do good deeds. ||1||Pause||

621.g: ਅਥ ਜੁਜਾਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ
621.e: Now begins the description about king Yayati
MADHUBHAAR STANZA
Then there was a most glorious king Yayati, whose fame had spread in the fourteen worlds.90.
His eyes were charming and his form of enormous glory was like the god of love.91.
The fourteen worlds had received brilliance from the glory of his charming elegance.92.
That generous king had innumerable qualities and had skill in fourteen science.93.
That beautiful king was most glorious, capable, expert in qualities and had faith in God.94.
The king had knowledge of Shastras, he was extremely furious in war, he was the fulfiller of all wishes like Kamadhenu, the wish-fulfilling cow.95.
The king with his bloody dagger was and invincible, complete, furious and powerful warrior.96.
When he drew his sword, he was like KAL (death) for his enemies, and his magnificence was like the fires of the sun.97.
When he fought, none of his limbs turned back, none of his enemies could stand before him and thus ran away.98.
The sun trembled before him, the directions shivered, the opponents stood with bowed heads and would run away in anxiety.99.
The warriors trembled, the cowards fled and the kings of various countries would break before him like thread.100.
Your sons, taking the warriors with them, hit that sage with their legs.83.
Then the meditation of that great sage was shattered and a huge fire came out of his eyes.84.
The messenger told, “O king Sagar! in this way all your sons were burnt and reduced to ashes alongwith their army and not even one of them survived.”85.
Hearing about the destruction of his sons, the whole city was steeped in sorrow and all the people here and there were filled with anguish.86.
All of them, remembering Shiva, withholding their tears assumed patience in their minds with the holy saying of the sages.87.
Then the king performed the last funeral rites of all affectionately according to Vedic injunctions.88.
In his extreme sorrow on the demise of his sons, the king left for heaven and after him, there were several other kings, who can describe them?89.

621.g: ਇਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੪॥੫॥
621.e: End of the description of Vyas, the incrnation of Brahma and the rule of king Prithu in Bachittar Natak.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
Enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart;
sitting within your own home, meditate on the Guru.
The Perfect Guru has spoken the Truth;
the True Peace is obtained only from the Lord. ||1||
My Guru has become merciful.

621.g: ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਿਉ; ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
621.e: In bliss, peace, pleasure and joy, I have returned to my own home, after my purifying bath. ||Pause||
True is the glorious greatness of the Guru;

621.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
621.e: His worth cannot be described.
He is the Supreme Overlord of kings.
Meeting with the Guru, the mind is enraptured. ||2||
All sins are washed away,
meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
The Lord's Name is the treasure of excellence;
chanting it, one's affairs are perfectly resolved. ||3||
The Guru has opened the door of liberation,
and the entire world applauds Him with cheers of victory.
O Nanak, God is always with me;
my fears of birth and death are gone. ||4||2||52||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Chau-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Meeting with the council, my doubts were not dispelled.
The chiefs did not give me satisfaction.
I presented my dispute to the noblemen as well.
But it was only settled by meeting with the King, my Lord. ||1||
Now, I do not go searching anywhere else,
because I have met the Guru, the Lord of the Universe. ||Pause||
When I came to God's Darbaar, His Holy Court,
then all of my cries and complaints were settled.
Now that I have attained what I had sought,
where should I come and where should I go? ||2||
There, true justice is administered.
There, the Lord Master and His disciple are one and the same.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows.
Without our speaking, He understands. ||3||
He is the King of all places.
There, the unstruck melody of the Shabad resounds.
Of what use is cleverness when dealing with Him?
Meeting with Him, O Nanak, one loses his self-conceit. ||4||1||51||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

621.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ; ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
621.e: All beings and creatures were created by Him; He alone is the support and friend of the Saints.

621.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
621.e: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; their glorious greatness becomes perfect. ||1||
The Perfect Supreme Lord God is always with me.

621.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ. ਪੂਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਖੀ; ਹੋਏ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
621.e: The Perfect Guru has perfectly and totally protected me, and now everyone is kind and compassionate to me. ||1||Pause||

621.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ; ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
621.e: Night and day, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is the Giver of the soul, and the breath of life itself.

621.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੫੦॥
621.e: He hugs His slave close in His loving embrace, like the mother and father hug their child. ||2||22||50||

622.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
O Lord Master, You are the ocean of excellence.
My home and all my possessions are Yours.
The Guru, the Lord of the world, is my Savior.
All beings have become kind and compassionate to me. ||1||
Meditating on the Guru's feet, I am in bliss.

622.g: ਭਉ ਕਤਹਿ ਨਹੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
622.e: There is no fear at all, in God's Sanctuary. ||Pause||
You dwell in the hearts of Your slaves, Lord.
God has laid the eternal foundation.
You are my strength, wealth and support.
You are my Almighty Lord and Master. ||2||
Whoever finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
is saved by God Himself.
By His Grace, He has blessed me with the sublime essence of the Naam.
All joy and pleasure then came to me. ||3||
God became my helper and my best friend;
everyone rises up and bows down at my feet.
With each and every breath, meditate on God;
O Nanak, sing the songs of joy to the Lord. ||4||4||54||
Now beings the description about the rule of Mandhata
DODHAK STANZA

622.g: ਨਾਮ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਵਿ ਕੋ ਧਰਿ ॥

622.e: All the kings who have ruled over the earth, which poet can describe their names? I fear the increase of this volume by narrating their names.108.

622.g: ਬੇਨੁ ਗਏ ਜਗ ਤੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਾ ਕਰਿ ॥

622.e: After the rule of Ben, Mandhata became the king

622.g: ਬਾਸਵ ਲੋਗ ਗਏ ਜਬ ਹੀ ਵਹ ॥

622.e: When he went to the country of Indra, Indra gave him half his seat.109.
The king Mandhata was filled with rage and challenging him, held his dagger in his hand
When, in his fury, he was about to strike Indra, then Brihaspati immediately caught his hand.110.

622.g: ਨਾਸ ਕਰੋ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਾਸਵ ਕੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ॥
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ. ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ; ਕੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
622.e: The way of the Saints is the ladder of righteous living, found only by great good fortune.

622.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸੇ; ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
622.e: The sins of millions of incarnations are washed away, by focusing your consciousness on the Lord's feet. ||2||

622.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ. ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
622.e: So sing the Praises of your God forever; His almighty power is perfect.

622.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ ॥੩॥
622.e: All beings and creatures are purified, listening to the True Teachings of the True Guru. ||3||

622.g: ਬਿਘਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ. ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਨ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
622.e: The True Guru has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; it is the Eliminator of obstructions, the Destroyer of all pains.

622.g: ਖੋਏ ਪਾਪ. ਭਏ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਵਨ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਖਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੩॥
622.e: All of my sins were erased, and I have been purified; servant Nanak has returned to his home of peace. ||4||3||53||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
Celestial peace and bliss have come,
meeting God, who is so pleasing to my mind.
The Perfect Guru showered me with His Mercy,
and I attained salvation. ||1||

622.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
622.e: My mind is absorbed in loving devotional worship of the Lord,
and the unstruck melody of the celestial sound current ever resounds within me. ||Pause||
The Lord's feet are my all-powerful shelter and support;
my dependence on other people is totally finished.
I have found the Life of the world, the Great Giver;
in joyful rapture, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
God has cut away the noose of death.
My mind's desires have been fulfilled;
wherever I look, He is there.

622.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
622.e: Without the Lord God, there is no other at all. ||3||
In His Mercy, God has protected and preserved me.
I am rid of all the pains of countless incarnations.
I have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord;
O Nanak, I have found eternal peace. ||4||5||55||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Creator has brought utter peace to my home;
the fever has left my family.
The Perfect Guru has saved us.
I sought the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||1||
The Transcendent Lord Himself has become my Protector.

622.g: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੇ; ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
622.e: Tranquility, intuitive peace and poise welled up in an instant, and my mind was comforted forever. ||Pause||
The Lord, Har, Har, gave me the medicine of His Name,
which has cured all disease.
He extended His Mercy to me,
and resolved all these affairs. ||2||
God confirmed His loving nature;
He did not take my merits or demerits into account.
The Word of the Guru's Shabad has become manifest,
SANYUKTA STANZA

Everyone heard his praise at many places and the enemies, listening to his praises would become fearful and suffer mental agony, he removed the afficions of the poor by performing the Yajnas in a nice manner.102.

622.g: ਇਤਿ ਜੁਜਾਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਸਿ ਹੋਤ ਭਏ ॥੫॥੫॥
622.e: End of the description about king Yayati and his death.

622.g: ਅਥ ਬੇਨ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
622.e: Now begins the description about the rule of king Ben
SANYUKTA STANZA

622.g: ਨਿਜਿ ਡੰਡ ਕਾਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਨ ਲਯੋ ॥

622.e: Then Ben became the king of the earth, he never charged tax from anyone, the beings were happy in various ways and none had any pride in him.103.
The beings were happy in various ways and even the trees did not seem to have any suffering, there was praise of the king everywhere on the earth.104.
In this way, keeping all his country happy, the king removed many afflictions of the lowly and seeing his splendour, all the gods also appreciated him.105.
Ruling for a very long time and getting the canopy swung over his head, the light of the soul of that mighty king Ben merged in the Supreme Light of the Lord.106.
All the immaculate kings ultimately merged in the Lord after their rule, which poet can enumerate their names? Therefore, I have only hinted about them.107.

622.g: ਇਤਿ ਬੇਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਸ ਹੋਤ ਭਏ ॥੬॥੫॥
622.e: End of the description about the king Ben and his death.
The moon stood wonder-stuck in his presence, the heart of Indra throbbed violently, the ganas were destroyed and the mountains also fled away.101.

623.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Perfect Guru has attached me to His feet.
I have obtained the Lord as my companion, my support, my best friend.
Wherever I go, I am happy there.
By His Kind Mercy, God united me with Himself. ||1||
So sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord with loving devotion.

623.g: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
623.e: You shall obtain all the fruits of your mind's desires, and the Lord shall become the companion and the support of your soul. ||1||Pause||
The Lord is the support of the breath of life.
I am the dust of the feet of the Holy people.
I am a sinner, but the Lord made me pure.
By His Kind Mercy, the Lord blessed me with His Praises. ||2||
The Supreme Lord God cherishes and nurtures me.
He is always with me, the Protector of my soul.
Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises day and night,
I shall not be consigned to reincarnation again. ||3||
One who is blessed by the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny,
realizes the subtle essence of the Lord.
The Messenger of Death does not come near him.
In the Lord's Sanctuary, Nanak has found peace. ||4||9||59||

623.g: ਆਸਨ ਅਰਧ ਦਯੋ ਤੁਹ ਯਾ ਬ੍ਰਤ ॥
623.e: He said, “O king! do not strike Indra, there is reason on his part for offering you half of his seat

623.g: ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਮਾਰ ਸਕੇ ਤੁਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰ ॥੧੧੧॥
623.e: There is one demon named Lavanasura on earth, why have you not been able to kill him as yet?111.

623.g: ਜੌ ਤੁਮ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਕੈ ਆਵਹੁ ॥
ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੋ, ਪਰ ਨਾਕੁ ਨ ਐਠਹੁ ॥੧੧੨॥
623.e: “When you will come after killing him, you will then have the full seat of Indra, therefore now be seated on half the seat and accepting this truth, do not exhibit your anger.”112.

623.g: ਅਬ ਏਕ ਕੀਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਯੌ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥

623.e: The king was determined to kill him and body of the enemies, grinding their teeth and challenging each other began to fight violently

623.g: ਜਬ ਲੌ ਨ ਸੁਨੋ ਲਵ ਖੇਤ ਮਰਾ ॥
ਤਬ ਲਉ ਨ ਲਖੋ ਰਨਿ ਬਾਜ ਟਰਾ ॥੧੧੫॥
623.e: The king did not stop the showering of arrows, as he waited to get the news of the death of Lavansaura.115.

623.g: ਅਬ ਹੀ ਰਣਿ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਏਕ ਕਰੈ ॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਏਕ ਕੀਏ ਰਣਿ ਤੇ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥
623.e: Both of them had the same objective and did not want to leave the battle without killing the opponent

623.g: ਬਹੁ ਸਾਲ ਸਿਲਾ ਤਲ ਬ੍ਰਿਛ ਛੁਟੇ ॥
ਦੁਹੂੰ ਓਰਿ ਜਬੈ ਰਣ ਬੀਰ ਜੁਟੇ ॥੧੧੬॥
623.e: Both the warriors showered trees and stones etc. from both the sides.116.

623.g: ਕੁਪ ਕੈ ਲਵ ਪਾਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸੂਲ ਲਯੋ ॥

623.e: Lavanasura held his trident in his hand in anger and chopped the head of Mandhata into two parts

623.g: ਨ ਉਚਾਇ ਸਕੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਐਸ ਲਜੀ ॥੧੧੭॥
623.e: The army of Mandhata ran away, being grouped together and got so much ashmed that it could not carry the head of the king.117.

623.g: ਘਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਜੇ ਘਨ ਘਾਇਲ ਹੁਐ ॥

623.e: The army, getting wounded, flew away like clouds and the blood flowed as if it was raining

623.g: ਸਬ ਹੀ ਦਲ ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲਾ ਜੀਅ ਲੈ ॥੧੧੮॥
623.e: Abandoning the dead king in the battlefield, the whole army of the king saved itself by fleeing away.118.
Those who returned, their heads cracked, their hair were loosened and being wounded, the blood flowed form their heads

623.g: ਰਣਿ ਮਾਰ ਕੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸੂਲ ਲੀਏ ॥

623.e: In this way, Lavanasura won the battle on the strength of his trident and caused the warriors of many kinds to run away.119.
End of the killing of Mandhata.
and through it, my honor was totally preserved. ||3||
I speak as You cause me to speak;
O Lord and Master, You are the ocean of excellence.
Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, according to the Teachings of Truth.
God preserves the honor of His slaves. ||4||6||56||
When taking the trident of Shiva, Lavanasura killed the superb king mandhata, then the king Dileep came to the throne
He had various types of royal luxuries.121.
This king was a great warrior any Sovereign
It seemed that he had been shaped in a mould of gold, like the form of the god of love, this king was so beautiful, that he appeared to be the Sovereign of Beauty.122.
He performed various types of Yajnas and executed hom and bestowed charities according to Vedic injunctions
His banner of the extension of Dharma fluttered here and there and seeing his glory, the abode of Indra felt shy.123.

623.g: ਪਗ ਪਗ ਜਗਿ ਖੰਭ ਕਹੁ ਗਾਡਾ ॥
ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਅੰਨ ਸਾਲ ਕਰਿ ਛਾਡਾ ॥
623.e: He got planted the columns of Yajnas at short distances
And caused the granaries of corn to be built in every home, the hungry or naked, whosoever came, his desire was fulfilled Immediately.124.

623.g: ਜੋ ਜਿਹੰ ਮੁਖ ਮਾਗਾ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
ਬਿਮੁਖ ਆਸ ਫਿਰਿ ਭਿਛਕ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥
623.e: Whosoever asked for anything, he obtained it and no beggar returned without the fulfillment of his wish
The banner of Dharma flew on every home and seeing this the abode of Dharamraja also became unconscious.125.
No one remained ignorant and all children and old people studied intelligently

623.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਤ ਭਈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
ਜਹ ਤਹ ਮਾਨਿ ਸਬੈ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧੨੬॥
623.e: There was the worship of the Lord in every home and the Lord was abored nad honoured everywhere.126.

623.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਾਜ ਦਿਲੀਪ ਬਡੋ ਕਰਿ ॥

623.e: Such was the rule of king Dileep, who himself was great warrior and a great archer
ASTAR STANZA
The king, taking up his weapons, reached there, where the demon lived in Mathura-Mandal

623.g: ਮਹਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਦ ਬੁਧੀ ॥
ਮਹਾ ਜੋਰ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਦਲੰ ਪਰਮ ਕ੍ਰੁਧੀ ॥੧੧੩॥
623.e: He was a great stupid and an egoist, he was a most powerful one and dreadfully outrageous.113.

623.g: ਮਹਾ ਘੋਰ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਘਨੰ ਕੀ ਘਟਾ ਜਿਯੋ ॥
ਸੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਰਣੰ ਬਿਜੁਲੀ ਕੀ ਛਟਾ ਜਿਯੋ ॥
623.e: Thundering like the clouds Mandhata fell upon (the demon) in the battlefield like lightning

623.g: ਸੁਨੇ ਸਰਬ ਦਾਨੋ ਸੁ ਸਾਮੁਹਿ ਸਿਧਾਇ ॥
623.e: MEDAK STANZA

623.g: ਮਹਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਸੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਨਚਾਏ ॥੧੧੪॥
623.e: When the demons heard this, they also confronted him and furioudly caused their horses to dance.114.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Creator Lord Himself stood between us,
and not a hair upon my head was touched.
The Guru made my cleansing bath successful;
meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, my sins were erased. ||1||
O Saints, the purifying pool of Ram Das is sublime.

623.g: ਜੋ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸੋ ਕੁਲੁ ਤਰਾਵੈ; ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਹੈ ਜੀ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
623.e: Whoever bathes in it, his family and ancestry are saved, and his soul is saved as well. ||1||Pause||
The world sings cheers of victory,
and the fruits of his mind's desires are obtained.
Whoever comes and bathes here,
And meditates on his God, is safe and sound. ||2||
One who bathes in the healing pool of the Saints,
that humble being obtains the supreme status.
He does not die, or come and go in reincarnation;
he meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
He alone knows this about God,
whom God blesses with His kindness.
Baba Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God;
all his worries and anxieties are dispelled. ||4||7||57||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Supreme Lord God has stood by me and fulfilled me,
and nothing is left unfinished.
Attached to the Guru's feet, I am saved;
I contemplate and cherish the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
He is forever the Savior of His slaves.

623.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
623.e: Bestowing His Mercy, He made me His own and preserved me; like a mother or father, He cherishes me. ||1||Pause||
By great good fortune, I found the True Guru,
who obliterated the path of the Messenger of Death.
My consciousness is focused on loving, devotional worship of the Lord.
One who lives in this meditation is very fortunate indeed. ||2||
He sings the Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani,
and bathes in the dust of the feet of the Holy.
He Himself bestows His Name.
God, the Creator, saves us. ||3||
The Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is the support of the breath of life.
This is the perfect, pure wisdom.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, has granted His Mercy;
slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master. ||4||8||58||
Now begins the description of the rule of Dileep
TOTAK STANZA
When Mandhata was killed in the war, then Dileep became the king of Delhi
CHAUPI

623.g: ਸਬ ਠੌਰ ਸਬੈ ਉਠਿ ਧਰਮ ਪਲੇ ॥੧੨੦॥
623.e: He destroyed the demons in various ways and propagated religion at all places.120.

624.e: He had complete knowledge of Kok Shastra nd Smrities and he was expert in fourteen sciences.127.
He was a great hero and superb intellectual, he was the store of fourteen sciences
He was extremely charming and enormously glorious, he was also very proud and alongwith it, he was greatly deatched from the world.128.
The king was expert in all Vedangs and six Shastras, he was the knower of the secret of Dhanurveda and also remained absorbed in the love of the Lord

624.g: ਅਰਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੀਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਲਿ ਮਲਿ ॥੧੨੯॥
624.e: He had many qualities and was unlimited like the virtues and strength of the Lord, he had conquered man
He had conquered many kings of undivided territories and there was none like him
He was extremely powerful and glorious and was very modest in the presence of the saints.130.

624.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਚਲੀ ਰਾਜ ਕੀ ਨੀਤਾ ॥
624.e: He conquered many countries far and near and his rule was discussed everywhere

624.g: ਤਜਿ ਹਠ ਚਰਨਿ ਲਗੇ ਬਡ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੧੩੧॥
624.e: He assumed many types of canopies and many great kings fell at his feet leaving their persistence.131.

624.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਹੋਤ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਾ ॥

624.e: The traditions of Dharma became prevalent in all directions and there was no misconduct anywhere
He became famous in bestowing charities like the king Varuna, Kuber, Ben, and Bali.132.
He ruled in various ways and his drum sounded upto the ocean

624.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਕਰਮ ਪਾਪ ਭਯੋ ਦੂਰਾ ॥

624.e: The voice and fear were nowhere observed and all performed the religious actions in his presence.133.

624.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਪਾਪ ਛਪਾ ਸਬ ਦੇਸਾ ॥

624.e: All the countries became sinless and all the kings observed the religious injunctions
The discussion about the rule of Dileep extended upto the ocean.134.
End of the description of the rule of Dileep and his departure for heaven.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Perfect Guru has made me perfect.
God is totally pervading and permeating everywhere.
With joy and pleasure, I take my purifying bath.
I am a sacrifice to the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

624.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ; ਰਿਦ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
624.e: I enshrine the lotus feet of the Guru within my heart.

624.g: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ. ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ; ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
624.e: Not even the tiniest obstacle blocks my way; all my affairs are resolved. ||1||Pause||
Meeting with the Holy Saints, my evil-mindedness was eradicated.
All the sinners are purified.
Bathing in the sacred pool of Guru Ram Das,
all the sins one has committed are washed away. ||2||
So sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe;
joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him.
The fruits of your mind's desires are obtained
by meditating on the Perfect Guru within your heart. ||3||
The Guru, the Lord of the World, is blissful;
chanting, meditating on the Lord of supreme bliss, He lives.
Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
God has confirmed His innate nature. ||4||10||60||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

624.g: ਗਈ ਬਹੋੜੁ. ਬੰਦੀ ਛੋੜੁ; ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਦੁਖਦਾਰੀ ॥
624.e: The Restorer of what was taken away, the Liberator from captivity; the Formless Lord, the Destroyer of pain.

624.g: ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ. ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ; ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
624.e: I do not know about karma and good deeds; I do not know about Dharma and righteous living. I am so greedy, chasing after Maya.

624.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਭਗਤੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ; ਇਹ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
624.e: I go by the name of God's devotee; please, save this honor of Yours. ||1||
O Dear Lord, You are the honor of the dishonored.

624.g: ਨਿਚੀਜਿਆ. ਚੀਜ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ; ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
624.e: You make the unworthy ones worthy, O my Lord of the Universe; I am a sacrifice to Your almighty creative power. ||Pause||

624.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਬਾਲਕੁ. ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ; ਲਖ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
624.e: Like the child, innocently making thousands of mistakes

624.g: ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਝਿੜਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਪਿਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
624.e: his father teaches him, and scolds him so many times, but still, he hugs him close in his embrace.

624.g: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਅਉਗੁਣ. ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਆਗੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
624.e: Please forgive my past actions, God, and place me on Your path for the future. ||2||

624.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ; ਤਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
624.e: The Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows all about my state of mind; so who else should I go to and speak to?

624.g: ਕਹਣੈ ਕਥਨਿ. ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ; ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥
624.e: The Lord, the Lord of the Universe, is not pleased by mere recitation of words; if it is pleasing to His Will, He preserves our honor.

624.g: ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਦੇਖੀ; ਇਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਰਹਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
624.e: I have seen all other shelters, but Yours alone remains for me. ||3||

624.g: ਅਥ ਰਘੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
624.e: Now begins the description of he rule of the king Raghu
CHAUPAI
The light of everyone merged in supreme light, and this activity continued in the world
The king Rahghu ruled over the world and wore new arms, weapons and canopies.135.
He performed several types of Yajnas and spread the religion in all the countires

624.g: ਝੂਠ ਬੈਨ ਕਿਹੂੰ ਭੂਲਿ ਨ ਭਾਖਾ ॥੧੩੬॥
624.e: He did not allow any sinner to stay with him and never uttered falsehood, even through oversight.136.
The nigh considered him as moon and the day as sun
The Vedas considered him as “Brahm” and the gods visualized him as Indra.137.
All the Brahmins saw in him the god Brihaspati and the demons as Shukracharya
The ailments looked at him as medicine and the Yogis visulised in him the supreme essence.138.
The children saw him as a child and the Yogis as the supreme Yogi
The donors saw in him the supreme Donor and the pleasure seeking persons considered him as a Supreme Yogi.139.
The Sannyasis considered him as Dattatreya and the Yogis as Guru Gorakhnath
The Bairagis considered him as Ramanand and the Muslims as Muhammad.140. (This is a period-error).
The gods considered him as Indra and the demons as Shmbh
The Yakshas and Kinnar thought of him as their king.141.
The lustful women considered him as the god of love and the diseases thought of him as the incarnation of Dhanvantri
The kings considered him as the Sovereign and the Yogis thought of him s the Supreme Yogi.142.
The Kshatriyas considered him the great canopied king and the wielders of arms and weapons thought of him as the great and powerful warrior
The night considered him as moon and the day as sun.143.
The saints thought of him as manifestation of peace and the fire thought of him as effulgence
The earth considered him as a mountain and the does as the king of deer.144.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

624.g: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਛਤ੍ਰ. ਮੇਘ ਘਟਾ ਘਟ; ਦਾਮਨਿ ਚਮਕਿ ਡਰਾਇਓ ॥
624.e: In the ten directions, the clouds cover the sky like a canopy; through the dark clouds, lightning flashes, and I am terrified.

624.g: ਸੇਜ ਇਕੇਲੀ. ਨੀਦ ਨਹੁ ਨੈਨਹ; ਪਿਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
624.e: By bed is empty, and my eyes are sleepless; my Husband Lord has gone far away. ||1||
Now, I receive no messages from Him, O mother!

624.g: ਏਕ ਕੋਸਰੋ. ਸਿਧਿ ਕਰਤ ਲਾਲੁ; ਤਬ ਚਤੁਰ ਪਾਤਰੋ ਆਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
624.e: When my Beloved used to go even a mile away, He would send me four letters. ||Pause||

624.g: ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ. ਇਹੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ; ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਓ ॥
624.e: How could I forget this Dear Beloved of mine? He is the Giver of peace, and all virtues.

624.g: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਚਰਿ ਕੈ. ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ; ਨੈਨ. ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਆਇਓ ॥੨॥
624.e: Ascending to His Mansion, I gaze upon His path, and my eyes are filled with tears. ||2||

624.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਭੀਤਿ ਭਇਓ ਹੈ ਬੀਚੋ; ਸੁਨਤ ਦੇਸਿ ਨਿਕਟਾਇਓ ॥
624.e: The wall of egotism and pride separates us, but I can hear Him nearby.

624.g: ਭਾਂਭੀਰੀ ਕੇ ਪਾਤ ਪਰਦੋ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪੇਖੇ. ਦੂਰਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
624.e: There is a veil between us, like the wings of a butterfly; without being able to see Him, He seems so far away. ||3||

624.g: ਭਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਸਗਰੋ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਓ ॥
624.e: The Lord and Master of all has become merciful; He has dispelled all my sufferings.

624.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਉਮੈ ਭੀਤਿ, ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ; ਤਉ ਦਇਆਰੁ ਬੀਠਲੋ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
624.e: Says Nanak, when the Guru tore down the wall of egotism, then, I found my Merciful Lord and Master. ||4||
All my fears have been dispelled, O mother!
Whoever I seek, the Guru leads me to find.

624.g: ਸਰਬ ਗੁਨਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੧॥੬੧॥
624.e: The Lord, our King, is the treasure of all virtue. ||Second Pause||11||61||

625.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Supreme Lord God has established that home,
In which He comes to mind.

625.g: ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥
625.e: Becoming kind and compassionate, God the Lord and Master Himself listens to my prayer.

625.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ; ਸਭ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤੀ ॥
625.e: He unites me in Union with the Perfect True Guru, and all the cares and anxieties of my mind are dispelled.

625.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੰਤੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੬੨॥
625.e: The Lord, Har, Har, has placed the medicine of the Naam into my mouth; servant Nanak abides in peace. ||4||12||62||
He appeared to the kshatris as Soverign and to the Yogis as Supreme Yogi
The mountains considered him as Himalaya and the darkness thought of him as the effulgence of the sun.145.
The water thought of him as the sea and the cloud considered him as Indra
The Vedas considered him as Brahman and the Brahmins imagined him as the sage Vyas.146.
Lakshmi considered him as Vishnu and Indrani as Indra
The saints saw him s peace-personified and the enemies as the clash-personified.147.
The ailments saw him as medicine and the women as lust
The friends considered him as great friend and the Yogis as Supreme essence.148.
The peacocks thought of him as cloud and the Chakvi (Brahmani duck) as sun
The female partridge viewed him as moon and the shell as rain-drop.149.
The nightingale saw him as spring and the rain-bird as the rain-drop
The Sadhus (saints) viewed him s Siddh (an adept) and the kings as Sovereign.150.
The beggars saw him as the Donor and the enemies as KAL (death)
The Smritis considered him as the knowledge of Shastras and the saints as Truth.151.
The saints viewed him as the personification of good conduct and absorbed his kindness in their mind
The peacocks thought of him as cloud and the thieves as day dawn.152.
The women considered him s the incarnation of lust and the saints saw him s adept
The serpents considered him as Sheshnaga and the gods believed him to be ambrosia.153.
He seemed to be like jewel in the serpent and the creatures saw him as prana (life-force)
In the whole Raghu clan, he was authenticated s raghhu clan, he was authenticated as Raghuraj, the king Raghu and the Yadavas considered him like Krishna.154.
The affliction saw him as the destroyer of suffering and Bali saw him as Vaman
The devotees of Shiva considered him as Shiva and also as Vyas and Parashar.155.
The Brahmins considered him as Veda and Kshatriyas as war
The person who thought of him in any manner, he presented himself in accordance with his desire.156.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
I bow in reverence to the Perfect Guru.
God has resolved all my affairs.
The Lord has showered me with His Mercy.
God has perfectly preserved my honor. ||1||
He has become the help and support of His slave.

625.g: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਤੈ; ਊਣੀ ਬਾਤ. ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
625.e: The Creator has achieved all my goals, and now, nothing is lacking. ||Pause||
The Creator Lord has caused the pool of nectar to be constructed.
The wealth of Maya follows in my footsteps,
and now, nothing is lacking at all.
This is pleasing to my Perfect True Guru. ||2||
Remembering, remembering the Merciful Lord in meditation,
all beings have become kind and compassionate to me.
Hail! Hail to the Lord of the world,
who created the perfect creation. ||3||
You are my Great Lord and Master.
These blessings and wealth are Yours.
Servant Nanak has meditated on the One Lord;
he has obtained the fruitful rewards for all good deeds. ||4||14||64||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, Third House, Dho-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Bathing in the nectar tank of Ram Das,
all sins are erased.
One becomes immaculately pure, taking this cleansing bath.
The Perfect Guru has bestowed this gift. ||1||
God has blessed all with peace and pleasure.

625.g: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ. ਸਭਿ ਥੋਕ ਉਬਾਰੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ. ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
625.e: Everything is safe and sound, as we contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||Pause||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, filth is washed off.
The Supreme Lord God has become our friend and helper.
Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
He has found God, the Primal Being. ||2||1||65||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

625.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ; ਦੁਖ ਕਲੇਸ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
625.e: Remembering, remembering God in meditation, bliss ensues, and one is rid of all suffering and pain.

625.g: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਂਠੇ ॥੧॥
625.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of God, and meditating on Him, all my affairs are brought into harmony. ||1||
Your Name is the Life of the world.

625.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਦੀਓ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ; ਜਪਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
625.e: The Perfect Guru has taught me, that by meditating, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||

625.g: ਤੂਹੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ. ਸੁਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂਹੈ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
625.e: You are Your own advisor; You hear everything, God, and You do everything.

625.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ. ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ; ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
625.e: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. What can this poor creature do? ||2||

625.g: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
625.e: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I describe and speak of? Your value cannot be described.

625.g: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਅਚਰਜੁ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੩॥
625.e: I live by beholding, beholding You, O God. Your glorious greatness is wonderful and amazing! ||3||

625.g: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ. ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ; ਪਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
625.e: Granting His Grace, God my Lord and Master Himself saved my honor, and my intellect has been made perfect.

625.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ; ਬਾਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੬੩॥
625.e: Forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice, longing for the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||13||63||

626.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Perfect Guru has dispelled the fever.
The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds.
God has bestowed all comforts.
In His Mercy, He Himself has given them. ||1||
The True Guru Himself has eradicated the disease.

626.g: ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਸੇ ਹੋਏ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
626.e: All the Sikhs and Saints are filled with joy, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||Pause||
They obtain that which they ask for.
God gives to His Saints.
God saved Hargobind.
Servant Nanak speaks the Truth. ||2||6||70||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Guru has blessed me with peace here,
and the Guru has arranged peace and pleasure for me hereafter.
I have all treasures and comforts,
meditating on the Guru in my heart. ||1||
This is the glorious greatness of my True Guru;
I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires.

626.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
626.e: O Saints, His Glory increases day by day. ||Pause||

626.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
626.e: All beings and creatures have become kind and compassionate to me; my God has made them so.

626.g: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਨੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੬੭॥
626.e: Nanak has met with the Lord of the world with intuitive ease, and with Truth, he is pleased. ||2||3||67||
I found the Guru, the ocean of peace,
And all my doubts were dispelled. ||1||
This is the glorious greatness of the Naam.
Twenty-four hours a day, I sing His Glorious Praises.
I obtained this from the Perfect Guru. ||Pause||
God's sermon is inexpressible.
His humble servants speak words of Ambrosial Nectar.
Slave Nanak has spoken.
Through the Perfect Guru, it is known. ||2||2||66||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
I am a sacrifice to my Guru.
He has totally preserved my honor.
I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires.
I meditate forever on my God. ||1||

626.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ. ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
626.e: O Saints, without Him, there is no other at all.
He is God, the Cause of causes. ||Pause||
My God has given me His Blessing.
He has made all creatures subject to me.
Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord,
and all his sorrows depart. ||2||5||69||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Word of the Guru's Shabad is my Saving Grace.
It is a guardian posted on all four sides around me.
My mind is attached to the Lord's Name.
The Messenger of Death has run away in shame. ||1||
O Dear Lord, You are my Giver of peace.

626.g: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ. ਕਰੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
626.e: The Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny, has shattered my bonds, and made my mind immaculately pure. ||Pause||
O Nanak, God is eternal and imperishable.

626.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ; ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
626.e: Service to Him shall never go unrewarded.
Your slaves are in bliss;
chanting and meditating, their desires are fulfilled. ||2||4||68||
He ruled in various ways after conquering various countries far and near
Seizing various countries, he performed Yajnas after short intervals.157.

626.g: ਪਗ ਪਗ ਜਗਿ ਖੰਭ ਕਹੁ ਗਾਡਾ ॥
ਡਗ ਡਗ ਹੋਮ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ ਛਾਡਾ ॥
626.e: He got planted the columns of Yajnas at short distances and performed heaven at various places by reciting mantras

626.g: ਜਗਿ ਖੰਭ ਜਿਹ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੫੮॥
626.e: No part of the earth was visible, where no columns of Yajnas were seen.158.
Inviting superb Brahmins, he performed many Gomedh Yajnas

626.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਭੂਯ ਕੇ ਰਸ ਲੀਨੇ ॥੧੫੯॥
626.e: Enjoying various types of the luxuries of the earth, he also performed Ashvamedh Yajnas many times.159.

626.g: ਗਜਾ ਮੇਧ ਬਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਿ ਤਿਹ ॥
ਅਜਾ ਮੇਧ ਤੇ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਗਨ ਕਿਹ ॥
626.e: He also performed Gajmedh Yajnas and he performed Ajaamedh Yajnas so many times that they cannot be enumerated
Performing Gomedh Yajnas in various ways, he sacrificed many animals.160.
Performing many Raajsu Yajnas, the king Raghu seemed like a second Indra
After taking baths at different pilgrim-stations, he bestowed various types of charities according to Vedic injunctions.161.

626.g: ਅੰਨ ਛੇਤ੍ਰ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੈ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
626.e: He got built places for drinking water at all the pilgrim-stations and stores of corn in every home,
So that if anyone comes with any desire, he may be able to obtain the desired thing.162.

626.g: ਭੂਖ ਨਾਗ ਕੋਈ ਰਹਨ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥

626.e: Nobody should remain hungry or naked and any beggar who came, may return like a king

626.g: ਬਹੁਰ ਦਾਨ ਕਹ ਕਰ ਨ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥

626.e: The king Raghu had such administration that anyone, who would see him once, he would become able to bestow charities himself on others.163.
He gave gifts of gold and silver in various ways

626.g: ਜਨ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਕ ਰਘੁ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੧੬੪॥
626.e: He gave so much to everyone that the recipient became like a king form the status of poor.164.
He would take bath according to Shastric injunctions and then give gifts of elephants, camels and cows
By bestowing gifts of various types of garments, he had fascinated the whole earth.165.
By honouring various types of the lowly, he gave horses and elephants in charity

626.g: ਜੋ ਮੁਖ ਮਾਗੈ ਵਹ ਬਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੬੬॥
626.e: None was afflicted with suffering and hunger and whosoever asked with suffering and hunger and whosoever asked for anything, he obtained the same.166.
The king Raghu was the abode of charity and gentleness and an ocean of mercy on this earth
He was a great and expert archer and a glorious king, always remaining detached.167.

626.g: ਨਿਤਿ ਉਠਿ ਕਰਤ ਦੇਵ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥

626.e: He always worshipped the goddess with roses, pandanus and sugar-candyy
And while worshipping, he touched her lotus-feet with his head.168.
He introduced the religious traditions at all places and all the people lived peacefully everywhere

626.g: ਭੂਖ ਨਾਗ ਕੋਈ ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਦੇਖਾ ॥

626.e: There did not seem to be any hungry and naked, high and low and everyone seemed to be a self-sufficient person.169.
The religious banners fluttered everywhere and there seemed to be no thief or Thug anywhere

626.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਯਾਰ ਚੋਰ ਚੁਨਿ ਮਾਰਾ ॥
ਏਕ ਦੇਸਿ ਕਹੂੰ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੧੭੦॥
626.e: He had picked up and killed all the thieves and Thugs and had established one-canopy kingdom.170.

626.g: ਸਾਧ ਓਰਿ ਕੋਈ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਪੇਖਾ ॥

626.e: The kingdom of king Raghu was such that the differentiation of a saint and a thief did not exist there and all were saits
His discus fluttered in all the four directions, which returned only on cutting the heads of the sinners.171.
The cow caused the lion to drink milk and the lion supervised the cow while grazing

626.g: ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੋਈ ਹਾਥੁ ਨ ਡਾਰਾ ॥੧੭੨॥
626.e: The persons considered to be thieves now protected the wealth and none committed any wrong act because of the fear of punishment.172.
The men and women slept peacefully in their beds and none begged for anything from others

626.g: ਰਾਜ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਤੇ ਢਰੈ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥੧੭੩॥
626.e: The ghee and fire lived at the same places, and did not damage each other because of the fear of the king.173.

626.g: ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਤ੍ਰਸਤ ਕਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨ ਡਾਰੈ ॥
626.e: The thief and saints moved together and none frightened any fear because of the fear of the administration
The cow and the lion moved freely in the same field and no power could harm them.174.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
You make me do what pleases You.
I have no cleverness at all.
I am just a child - I seek Your Protection.
God Himself preserves my honor. ||1||
The Lord is my King; He is my mother and father.

626.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਣ ਲਾਗਾ; ਕਰਂ‍ੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
626.e: In Your Mercy, You cherish me; I do whatever You make me do. ||Pause||
The beings and creatures are Your creation.
O God, their reins are in Your hands.

627.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
Meeting with the Guru, I contemplate God.
All of my affairs have been resolved.
No one speaks ill of me.
Everyone congratulates me on my victory. ||1||
O Saints, I seek the True Sanctuary of the Lord and Master.

627.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੈ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
627.e: All beings and creatures are in His hands; He is God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||Pause||
He has resolved all of my affairs.
God has confirmed His innate nature.
God's Name is the Purifier of sinners.
Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||73||

627.g: ਅਥ ਅਜ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
627.e: Now begins the description of the rule of king Aj
PAADHARI STANZA
Then there ruled the great and powerful king Aj, who destroyed several clans after conquering many heroes
He also conquered the rebellious kings.1.
He conquered many invincible kings and shattered the pride of many egoistic kings
The great king Aj was the ocean of fourteen sciences.2.
That king was a powerful warrior and expert in the study of Shrutis (Vedas) and Shastras
That great king was full of self-pride and had a very charming face, seeing which all the kings felt shy.3.
That Sovereign was king of kings and in his kingdom, all the houses were full of wealth
The women were allured on seeing his beauty and he was the knower of the mysteries of the Vedas he was a great donor, skilful in sciences and a very gentle king.4.
If I relate the whole story, I fear the Granth to become voluminous
Therefore, O friend! listen this story only in brief there was a king named Subahu in Vidrabha country, the name of whose queen was Champavati.5.
She gave birth to a daughter, whose name was Indumati

627.g: ਜਬ ਭਈ ਜੋਗ ਬਰ ਕੇ ਕੁਮਾਰਿ ॥

627.e: When she attained the marriageable age, the king then consulted his ministers.6.
The king invited the kings of all the countries, who came to the kingdom of Subahu with their armies

627.g: ਜਿਹਿ ਜਪਤ ਲੋਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਰਬ ਜਾਪੁ ॥੭॥
627.e: The adorable goddess Sarasvati came to reside in the mouths of all them and all of them with the desire of marrying that girl, offered prayers alongwith

627.g: ਤਬ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਭੂਪ ਆਨਿ ॥

627.e: All the kings of various countries came and bowed before that king Subahu nad sat in the assembly

627.g: ਜਨ ਦੇਵ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਸਮ ਨ ਤੈਸੁ ॥੮॥
627.e: , Where their glory excelled that of the assembly of gods.8.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Supreme Lord God created and embellished him.
The Guru has saved this small child.
So celebrate and be happy, father and mother.
The Transcendent Lord is the Giver of souls. ||1||
Your slaves, O Lord, focus on pure thoughts.

627.g: ਰਾਖਹਿ ਪੈਜ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ; ਕਾਰਜ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
627.e: You preserve the honor of Your slaves, and You Yourself arrange their affairs. ||Pause||
My God is so benevolent.
His Almighty Power is manifest.
Nanak has come to His Sanctuary.
He has obtained the fruits of his mind's desires. ||2||10||74||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
Forever and ever, I chant the Lord's Name.
God Himself has saved my child.
He healed him from the smallpox.
My troubles have been removed through the Lord's Name. ||1||
My God is forever Merciful.

627.g: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ; ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਭਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
627.e: He heard the prayer of His devotee, and now all beings are kind and compassionate to him. ||Pause||
God is Almighty, the Cause of causes.
Remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains and sorrows vanish.
He has heard the prayer of His slave.
O Nanak, now everyone sleeps in peace. ||2||11||75||
PAADHARI STANZA
The king Raghu ruled in this way and gave in charity the elephants and horses to the poor
He conquered many kings and shattered many forts.177.
End of “The Rule of king Raghu.”
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
I have woven the Lord's Name into the fabric of my heart.
All my affairs are resolved.
His mind is attached to God's feet,
whose destiny is perfect. ||1||
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord.

627.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਰਾਧਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
627.e: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har; I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires. ||Pause||
The seeds of my past actions have sprouted.
My mind is attached to the Lord's Name.
My mind and body are absorbed into the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
Slave Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||2||8||72||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Transcendent Lord has given me His support.
The house of pain and disease has been demolished.
The men and women celebrate.
The Lord God, Har, Har, has extended His Mercy. ||1||

627.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਰ︀ਯੋ ਰਘੁ ਰਾਜਾ ॥

627.e: The king Raghu ruled in this way and the fame of his charity spread in all the four directions
The mighty and elegant warriors protected him in all the four directions.175.
That king, skilful in fourteen sciences, ruled for twenty thousand years

627.g: ਔਰ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਐਸ ਕਰ ਕਰਮਾ ॥੧੭੬॥
627.e: He always performed the religious acts of this kind, which none other could perform.176.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
I meditated on my Guru.
I met with Him, and returned home in joy.
This is the glorious greatness of the Naam.
Its value cannot be estimated. ||1||
O Saints, worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

627.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ. ਸਭੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧਹੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
627.e: Worship the Lord in adoration, and you shall obtain everything; your affairs shall all be resolved. ||Pause||
He alone is attached in loving devotion to God,
who realizes his great destiny.
Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
He obtains the rewards of all joys and peace. ||2||12||76||
Whatever You cause us to do, we do.
Nanak, Your slave, seeks Your Protection. ||2||7||71||

628.e: MOHINI STANZA

628.g: ਦੇਖਤ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਕੋ ਮਨ ਮੋਹਤ ॥
628.e: These whit-complexioned elegant women were fascinating the mind of gods and men
Seeing them, the great kings got pleased what more description can be given of their glory?.25.
The small and big drums were resounding
The glory of that place is indescribable all of them appeared to be like Indra.9.
That royal assembly was such that seeing it, Indra shrunk his nose, who should describe its glory?
The Gandharvas and Yakshas kept silent on seeing it.10.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
Here and hereafter, He is our Savior.
God, the True Guru, is Merciful to the meek.
He Himself protects His slaves.
In each and every heart, the Beautiful Word of His Shabad resounds. ||1||

628.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਊਪਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
628.e: I am a sacrifice to the Guru's Feet.

628.g: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ; ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
628.e: Day and night, with each and every breath, I remember Him; He is totally pervading and permeating all places. ||Pause||
He Himself has become my help and support.
True is the support of the True Lord.
Glorious and great is devotional worship to You.
Nanak has found God's Sanctuary. ||2||14||78||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Perfect Guru has done it perfectly.
He blessed me with forgiveness.
I have found lasting peace and bliss.
Everywhere, the people dwell in peace. ||1||
Devotional worship to the Lord is what gives rewards.

628.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ. ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ; ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
628.e: The Perfect Guru, by His Grace, gave it to me; how rare are those who know this. ||Pause||
Sing the Word of the Guru's Bani, O Siblings of Destiny.
That is always rewarding and peace-giving.
Nanak has meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
He has realized his pre-ordained destiny. ||2||17||81||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
Humility is my spiked club.
My dagger is to be the dust of all men's feet.

628.g: ਇਸੁ ਆਗੈ; ਕੋ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ. ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥
628.e: No evil-doer can withstand these weapons.
The Perfect Guru has given me this understanding. ||1||

628.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਓਟਾ ॥
628.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the support and shelter of the Saints.

628.g: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ. ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਉਧਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੋਟਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
628.e: One who remembers the Lord in meditation, is emancipated; millions have been saved in this way. ||1||Pause||
In the Society of the Saints, I sing His Praises.
I have found this, the perfect wealth of the Lord.
Says Nanak, I have eradicated my self-conceit.
I see the Supreme Lord God everywhere. ||2||16||80||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
ARDH PAADHARI STANZA
The warriors looked splendid, seeing whom the heavenly damsels got allured
There were innumerable heavenly damsels.11.
They were singing fascinating songs, in which they were blessing together for their long like till the end of four ages.12.
The knocking on the instruments were being heard and many heavenly damsels were being seen.13.
The songs were being sung according to Vedic rites and the kings of unique glory looked magnificent.14.
The stringed instruments were being played and the women, being pleased, were happily singing songs.15.
O Saints, there is peace everywhere.

628.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
628.e: The Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Transcendent Lord, is pervading everywhere. ||Pause||
The Bani of His Word emanated from the Primal Lord.
It eradicates all anxiety.
The Lord is merciful, kind and compassionate.
Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the True Lord. ||2||13||77||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
When it was pleasing to the Perfect True Guru,
then I chanted the Naam, the Name of the Pervading Lord.
The Lord of the Universe extended His Mercy to me,
and God saved my honor. ||1||
The Lord's feet are forever peace-giving.

628.g: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ. ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਬਿਰਥੀ ਆਸ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
628.e: Whatever fruit one desires, he receives; his hopes shall not go in vain. ||1||Pause||

628.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ; ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
628.e: That Saint, unto whom the Lord of Life, the Great Giver, extends His Mercy - he alone sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

628.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ. ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
628.e: His soul is absorbed in loving devotional worship; his mind is pleasing to the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

628.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਰਵਣਾ; ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਲਾਥੀ ॥
628.e: Twenty-four hours a day, he chants the Praises of the Lord, and the bitter poison does not affect him.

628.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਲੀਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤੈ; ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਭਏ ਸਾਥੀ ॥੩॥
628.e: My Creator Lord has united me with Himself, and the Holy Saints have become my companions. ||3||

628.g: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ. ਸਰਬਸੁ ਦੀਨੇ; ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
628.e: Taking me by the hand, He has given me everything, and blended me with Himself.

628.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਪੂਰਨ; ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੭੯॥
628.e: Says Nanak, everything has been perfectly resolved; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||4||15||79||
UCHHAAL STANZA
The women were singing with the clapping of their hands and the kings with the decoration of gods, were looking at them.16.
The singing of songs continued with happy mind and seeing the glory of that place, even the mind of greed was becoming greedy.17.
They were talking with the signs of their eyes and all the weapon wielders were looking splendid.18.
The elephants were thundering and the companions were bedecked
The horses were jumping and dancing.19.
The young damsels were dancing and were singing happily while clapping their hands.20.
These women of the voice of a nightingale and having beautiful eyes, were alluring the mind by singing the song.21.
These women having beautiful hair, charming eyes and in the garb of heavenly damsels had the voice of a nightingale.22.
These women had marvelous figures, full of desires, with bewitching smiles and long nostrils.23.
Seeing the beauty of the queens, the wife of Indra also felt shy
These heavenly maidens were like the rosary of musical modes.24.

629.e: Seeing the embellishment of these women, many men of taste were getting pleased
The women were dancing in many emotional postures, seeing which all the gods and men were delighted.26.
The horses were neighing
The elephants were trumpeting and the people of the town were dancing the gods, men and women were all getting pleased and the kings were busy in bestowing charities.27.
The heavenly damsels were dancing while singing, seeing whom, the kings got pleased and their queens were also getting angry
The pretty lyre of Narada was being played, seeing which the gods seemed radiant like fire.28.
All of them had put antimony in their eyes and had bedecked their limbs, having worn handsome garments
The kings were getting pleased and were trying to wed them.29.

629.g: ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣ ਬਾਜੈ ਰੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
629.e: The women of gods were dancing and the jingling of the rosaries of their limbs was being heard

629.g: ਬਨਿ ਬਨਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਜਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
ਦੈ ਦੈ ਡਾਰੈ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਸਾਜਾ ॥੩੦॥
629.e: The kings were sitting with pomp and show at various places.30.

629.g: ਜਿਹ ਜਿਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੋ ਸੋ ਰੀਝਾ ॥
ਜਿਨ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਿਹ ਮਨ ਖੀਝਾ ॥
629.e: Whosoever saw this, he was pleased and he who did not see this, he got angry in his mind

629.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਯੰ ਤ੍ਰੀਅ ਬਰ ਨਾਚੈ ॥

629.e: The women were dancing, exhibiting various kinds of emotions and there was wonderful emotional play from every limb of theirs.31.

629.g: ਤਿਨ ਅਤਿਭੁਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਤਹ ਜਹ ਠਾਨੀ ॥
ਜਹ ਤਹ ਸੋਹੈ ਮੁਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
629.e: Those women also decided to do something marvelous at that place, because there were sitting there some persistent sages

629.g: ਤਜਿ ਤਜਿ ਜੋਗੰ ਭਜਿ ਭਜਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
ਲਖਿ ਅਤਿ ਆਭਾ ਜੀਅ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੨॥
629.e: The Yogis leaving their meditation came running and seeing the glory of this function, they were pleased.32.

629.g: ਬਨਿ ਬਨਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਜਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
ਜਹ ਤਹ ਸੋਭੈ ਸਭ ਸੁਭ ਸਾਜਾ ॥
629.e: Wherever the kings were sitting well-bedecked, the atmosphere of that place seemed extremely splendid

629.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਦੇਖੈ ਗੁਨਿ ਗਨ ਫੂਲੇ ॥
ਮੁਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਛਬਿ ਲਖਿ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਭੂਲੇ ॥੩੩॥
629.e: The kings were filled with pleasure here and there, accomplished with their qualities and servants and the sages seeing their magnificence, had forgotten the consciousness of their mind and body.33.

629.g: ਤਤ ਬਿਤ ਘਨ ਮੁਖਰਸ ਸਬ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਗੰ ਗੁਨਿ ਗਨ ਲਾਜੈ ॥
629.e: The stringed musical instruments were being played there and hearing their pleasing musical modes, the experts of musicology were feeling shy

629.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਗਿਰ ਗੇ ਰਿਝਿ ਰਿਝਿ ਐਸੇ ॥
ਜਨੁ ਭਟ ਜੂਝੇ ਰਣ ਬ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੈਸੇ ॥੩੪॥
629.e: Hearing the tunes of the musical instruments, the kings fell down here and there like the warriors lying wounded in the battlefield.34.

629.g: ਬਨਿ ਬਨਿ ਫੂਲੇ ਜਨੁ ਬਰ ਫੂਲੰ ॥
ਤਨੁ ਬਰੁ ਸੋਭੇ ਜਨੁ ਧਰ ਮੂਲੰ ॥
629.e: They seemed to have blossomed like the flowers of the forest and their bodies were exhibiting the fundamental emotion of the earthly comfort

629.g: ਜਹੰ ਤਹੰ ਝੂਲੇ ਮਦ ਮਤ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
ਜਨੁ ਮੁਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੁਨ ਘਨ ਗਾਜਾ ॥੩੫॥
629.e: The intoxicated kings were swinging here and there like the peacocks getting intoxicated hearing the thundering of clouds.35.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
Peace in this world, O my friends,
and bliss in the world hereafter - God has given me this.
The Transcendent Lord has arranged these arrangements;
I shall never waver again. ||1||
My mind is pleased with the True Lord Master.
I know the Lord to be pervading all. ||1||Pause||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The hungry man is not ashamed to eat.

629.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
629.e: Just so, the humble servant of the Lord sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
Why are you so lazy in your own affairs?

629.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ. ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
629.e: Remembering Him in meditation, your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord; you shall find peace, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||
Just as the lustful man is enticed by lust,

629.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
629.e: so is the Lord's slave pleased with the Lord's Praise. ||2||
Just as the mother holds her baby close,
so does the spiritual person cherish the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
This is obtained from the Perfect Guru.
Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||19||83||
I worship and adore the Perfect Guru.
All my affairs have been resolved.
All desires have been fulfilled.
The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds. ||1||
O Saints, meditating on the Lord, we obtain peace.

629.g: ਸੰਤ ਅਸਥਾਨਿ. ਬਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ; ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
629.e: In the home of the Saints, celestial peace is pervading; all pain and suffering is dispelled. ||1||Pause||
The Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani
is pleasing to the Mind of the Supreme Lord God.
Slave Nanak speaks
the Unspoken, immaculate sermon of the Lord. ||2||18||82||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
Within my heart, I meditate on God.
I have returned home safe and sound.
The world has become contented.
The Perfect Guru has saved me. ||1||
O Saints, my God is forever merciful.

629.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਕੀ. ਗਣਤ, ਨ ਗਣਈ; ਰਾਖੈ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
629.e: The Lord of the world does not call His devotee to account; He protects His children. ||1||Pause||
I have enshrined the Lord's Name within my heart.
He has resolved all my affairs.
The Perfect Guru was pleased, and blessed me,
and now, Nanak shall never again suffer pain. ||2||21||85||
PAADHARI STANZA
Seeing the splendour here and there, the kings sat down

629.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਰਤ ਬੈਨ ॥

629.e: Their glory cannot be described and seeing their figures, the eyes were getting pleased.36.
Seeing the colourful dance of this kind, the god of love was pulling his bow and discharging his arrows on the kings
The great glory of the atmosphere is indescribable and all were getting pleased on seeing it.37.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
Safe and sound, I have returned home.
The slanderer's face is blackened with ashes.
The Perfect Guru has dressed in robes of honor.
All my pains and sufferings are over. ||1||
O Saints, this is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.
He has created such wonder and glory! ||1||Pause||
I speak according to the Will of my Lord and Master.
God's slave chants the Word of His Bani.
O Nanak, God is the Giver of peace.
He has created the perfect creation. ||2||20||84||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Lord abides in my mind and body.

629.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
629.e: Everyone congratulates me on my victory.
This is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru.

629.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ; ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
629.e: His value cannot be described. ||1||
I am a sacrifice to Your Name.

629.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਸੋ ਜਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
629.e: He alone, whom You have forgiven, O my Beloved, sings Your Praises. ||1||Pause||
You are my Great Lord and Master.
You are the support of the Saints.
Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary.
The faces of the slanderers are blackened with ashes. ||2||22||86||

630.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

630.g: ਭਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ. ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
630.e: Becoming merciful, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor has Himself devised all devices.

630.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓ. ਜਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਬੇੜੀ ਕਾਟੀ ॥੧॥
630.e: In an instant, He has saved His humble servant; the Perfect Guru has cut away his bonds. ||1||

630.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
630.e: O my mind, meditate forever on the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

630.g: ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ; ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
630.e: All illness shall depart from this body, and you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||Pause||

630.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
630.e: God created all beings and creatures; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

630.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਏ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੭॥੯੧॥
630.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; his face is radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||2||27||91||
All beings are Yours, O Merciful Lord.
You cherish Your devotees.
Your glorious greatness is wonderful and marvellous.
Nanak ever meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||23||87||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

630.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
630.e: The True Guru is the Giver of all peace and comfort - seek His Sanctuary.

630.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ; ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
630.e: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, bliss ensues, pain is dispelled, and one sings the Lord's Praises. ||1||
Drink in the sublime essence of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

630.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ. ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
630.e: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; worship the Naam in adoration, and enter the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||Pause||

630.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ. ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
630.e: Only one who has such pre-ordained destiny receives it; he alone becomes perfect, O Siblings of Destiny.

630.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ; ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੮੯॥
630.e: Nanak's prayer, O Dear God, is to remain lovingly absorbed in the Naam. ||2||25||89||
It seemed that this was the first day of spring

630.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਮਾਨ ਨਹੀ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਹੈਸ ॥੩੮॥
630.e: In this way, seeing the whole assembly, all the kings sat down there in their glory as if they excelled even Indra.38.

630.g: ਇਕ ਮਾਸ ਲਾਗ ਤਹ ਭਇਓ ਨਾਚ ॥
ਬਿਨ ਪੀਐ ਕੈਫ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਬਾਚ ॥
630.e: In this, way, the dancing continued there for one month and no one could save himself from drinking the wine of that dance

630.g: ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੁ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥੩੯॥
630.e: Here, there and everywhere the beauty of the kings and princes was seen.39.

630.g: ਜਿਹ ਕੋ ਜਪੰਤ ਸਭ ਜਗਤ ਜਾਪ ॥
630.e: Sarasvati, the goddess worshipped by the world, said to the princess,

630.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਮਾਨ ਨਹੀ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਾਜ ॥੪੦॥
630.e: “O princess! Look at these princes, who even excel Indra.”40.
The princess looked towards the group of princes and did not even like the prince of Sindhu-kingdom

630.g: ਜਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੋਭ ਕਹੁ ਲੀਲ ਲੀਸੁ ॥੪੧॥
630.e: Leaving him, absorbing all the glory within herself, she moved further.41.
Sarasvati said to her again, “Here is a king of the West, you may see him
The princess saw his natural features, but she did not like him also.42.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
I meditate in remembrance on my Lord.
Day and night, I ever meditate on Him.
He gave me His hand, and protected me.
I drink in the most sublime essence of the Lord's Name. ||1||
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

630.g: ਚਲੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਤਾ ਕੌ ਤ੍ਰੀਆ ਰਾਜ ਐਸੇ ॥
ਮਨੋ ਪਾਡੁ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੰ ਸਿਰੀ ਰਾਜ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
630.e: Leaving all of them, the princess moved forward like the Pandavas, the sons of Pandu, moving away after leaving their kingdom etc.

630.g: ਮਨੋ ਜ੍ਵਾਲ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਾ ਮੋਨਿ ਮੋਹੈ ॥੪੯॥
630.e: Standing in the royal court, she appeared like the fascinating fire-flame.49.
Standing in the royal court she appeared like the portrait of painter

630.g: ਬਧੇ ਸ੍ਵਰਣ ਕੀ ਕਿੰਕਣੀ ਲਾਲ ਮਾਲੰ ॥
ਸਿਖਾ ਜਾਨ ਸੋਭੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪੰ ਜਗਿ ਜ੍ਵਾਲੰ ॥੫੦॥
630.e: She was wearing a golden ornament (Kinkini) fitted with wreath of gems the pigtail of her hair was apparently like fire for the kings.50.

630.g: ਲਖੋ ਨੈਨਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਸਭੈ ਭੂਪ ਆਲਾ ॥
630.e: Sarasvati, seeing the damsel said to her again, “O princess! See these superb kings

630.g: ਰੁਚੈ ਚਿਤ ਜਉਨੈ ਸੁਈ ਨਾਥ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
ਸੁਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਿਆਰੀ, ਇਹੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੫੧॥
630.e: O my beloved! Obey my saying wed him, whom you consider worthy in your mind.51.

630.g: ਬਡੀ ਬਾਹਨੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਬਿਰਾਜੈ ॥
ਘੁਰੈ ਸੰਗ ਭੇਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਜੈ ॥
630.e: “He, with whom there is a large army and the conches, battledrums and the war-horns are being played, see this great king
Whose thousand arms make the day appear as night.52.

630.g: ਧੁਜਾ ਮਧਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਬਡੋ ਸਿੰਘ ਰਾਜੈ ॥
ਸੁਨੇ ਨਾਦ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਹਾ ਪਾਪ ਭਾਜੈ ॥
630.e: “In whose banner, there is seated a huge lion and hearing whose voice, the great sins are eliminated

630.g: ਸੁਨੋ ਬੈਨ ਬਾਲਾ, ਸੁਰੂਪੰ ਸੁ ਭਾਨੰ ॥੫੩॥
630.e: O princess! See that sun-faced great king of the East.53.
“Here the kettledrums, conches and drums are being played
The tones and tunes of many other instruments are being heard also the drums, anklets etc. are being played.54.

630.g: ਬਧੇ ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰੰ ਸੁ ਬੀਰੰ ਸੁਬਾਹੰ ॥

630.e: The warriors are wearing beautiful garments
MADHUBHAAR STANZA
“O princess! Look towards these elegantly dressed warrior-kings of the countery.”43.
The princess saw towards the natural features of many kings thoughtfully and that supremely immaculate damsel even did not like the king of the West.44.
Then that girl moved forward and began to smile like the flash of lightning amongst the clouds.45.
The kings were getting allured on seeing her and the heavenly damsels were getting angry
They were enraged because they found the princess more beautiful than themselves.46.
The kings of charming forms and apparently beauty-incarnate and of supreme glory were there.47.
The princess saw the kings standing there and also saw amongst them the sovereign of Mulatan.48.
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

630.g: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ; ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
630.e: The Lord is the Cause of Causes, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He preserves the honor of His servant.

630.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
630.e: He is hailed and congratulated throughout the world, and he tastes the sublime essence of the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
Dear God, Lord of the world, You are my only support.

630.g: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ. ਸਰਨਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਮੑ ਧਿਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
630.e: You are all-powerful, the Giver of Sanctuary; twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on You. ||Pause||

630.g: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ. ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ; ਤਿਸੈ. ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
630.e: That humble being, who vibrates upon You, O God, is not afflicted by anxiety.

630.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਗੇ. ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
630.e: Attached to the Feet of the True Guru, his fear is dispelled, and within his mind, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

630.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
630.e: He abides in celestial peace and utter ecstasy; the True Guru has comforted him.

630.g: ਜਿਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤੀ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ॥੩॥
630.e: He has returned home victorious, with honor, and his hopes have been fulfilled. ||3||

630.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ. ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ; ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
630.e: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru; Perfect are the actions of God.

630.g: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗਿ. ਤਰਿਓ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ; ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੦॥
630.e: Grasping hold of the Guru's feet, Nanak has crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||26||90||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:
The Lord is always with me.
The Messenger of Death does not approach me.
God holds me close in His embrace, and protects me.
True are the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||
The Perfect Guru has done it perfectly.

630.g: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ; ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੀਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
630.e: He has beaten and driven off my enemies, and given me, His slave, the sublime understanding of the neutral mind. ||1||Pause||
God has blessed all places with prosperity.
I have returned again safe and sound.
Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary.
It has eradicated all disease. ||2||24||88||

631.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
631.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

631.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
631.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

631.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ; ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
631.e: O mind, love the Lord.

631.g: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨੁ ਸੁਨਉ; ਅਰੁ ਗਾਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
631.e: With your ears, hear the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and with your tongue, sing His song. ||1||Pause||

631.g: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਮਰੁ ਮਾਧੋ; ਹੋਹਿ. ਪਤਿਤ, ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
631.e: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meditate in remembrance on the Lord; even a sinner like yourself will become pure.

631.g: ਕਾਲੁ. ਬਿਆਲੁ ਜਿਉ ਪਰਿਓ ਡੋਲੈ; ਮੁਖੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
631.e: Death is on the prowl, with its mouth wide open, friend. ||1||

631.g: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਹੈ; ਸਮਝਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
631.e: Today or tomorrow, eventually it will seize you; understand this in your consciousness.

631.g: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜਿ ਲੈ; ਜਾਤੁ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਬੀਤ ॥੨॥੧॥
631.e: Says Nanak, meditate, and vibrate upon the Lord; this opportunity is slipping away! ||2||1||

631.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
631.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

631.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ; ਕਉਨੁ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਤੈ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
631.e: O mind, what evil-mindedness have you developed?

631.g: ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਰਸ ਰਚਿਓ; ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ. ਨਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
631.e: You are engrossed in the pleasures of other men's wives, and slander; you have not worshipped the Lord at all. ||1||Pause||

631.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪੰਥੁ. ਜਾਨਿਓ ਤੈ ਨਾਹਨਿ; ਧਨ ਜੋਰਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
631.e: You do not know the way to liberation, but you run all around chasing wealth.

631.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
631.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

631.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ. ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
631.e: The mind remains in the mind.

631.g: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ. ਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੇਵੇ; ਚੋਟੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
631.e: He does not meditate on the Lord, nor does he perform service at sacred shrines, and so death seizes him by the hair. ||1||Pause||

631.g: ਦਾਰਾ ਮੀਤ ਪੂਤ ਰਥ ਸੰਪਤਿ; ਧਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਮਹੀ ॥
631.e: Wife, friends, children, carriages, property, total wealth, the entire world

631.g: ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਏ ਜਾਨਉ; ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੋ ਸਹੀ ॥੧॥
631.e: - know that all of these things are false. The Lord's meditation alone is true. ||1||

631.g: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਹਾਰਿਓ; ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਲਹੀ ॥
631.e: Wandering, wandering around for so many ages, he has grown weary, and finally, he obtained this human body.

631.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ. ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਬਰੀਆ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਹਾ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
631.e: Says Nanak, this is the opportunity to meet the Lord; why don't you remember Him in meditation? ||2||2||

631.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
631.e: I am a sacrifice to my Guru.

631.g: ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ; ਜੀਅ ਹੋਏ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
631.e: God, the Great Giver, the Perfect One, has become merciful to me, and now, all are kind to me. ||Pause||

631.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥
631.e: Servant Nanak has entered His Sanctuary.

631.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
631.e: He has perfectly preserved his honor.

631.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
631.e: All suffering has been dispelled.
So enjoy peace, O my Siblings of Destiny! ||2||28||92||

631.g: ਨਹੇ ਪਿੰਗ ਬਾਜੀ ਰਥੰ ਜੇਣਿ ਜਾਨੋ ॥
ਤਿਸੈ ਦਛਨੇਸੰ ਹੀਐ ਬਾਲ, ਮਾਨੋ ॥੫੫॥
631.e: And the canopied king is looking splendid alongwith his army he, whose chariot and its horses destroy large and mountain-sized warriors O princess! He is the king of the South.55.
