631.g: ਮਹਾ ਬਾਹਨੀਸੰ ਨਗੀਸੰ ਨਰੇਸੰ ॥
ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਤੰ ਸੁਭੈ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਭੇਸੰ ॥
ਧੁਜਾ ਬਧ ਉਧੰ ਗਜੰ ਗੂੜ ਬਾਕੋ ॥
ਲਖੋ ਉਤਰੀ ਰਾਜ ਕੈ ਨਾਮ ਤਾ ਕੋ ॥੫੬॥
631.e: “The king who has a great army and in which there are millions of soldiers on foot in green uniforms, and whose beautiful elephants tied with banners, are roaming, O princess! He is the king of the North.56.

631.g: ਫਰੀ ਧੋਪ ਪਾਇਕ ਸੁ ਆਗੇ ਉਮੰਗੈ ॥
ਜਿਣੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੰਕੈ ਮੁਰੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਅੰਗੈ ॥
ਹਰੇ ਬਾਜ ਰਾਜੰ ਕਪੋਤੰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨੰ ॥
ਨਹੇ ਸ੍ਰਯੰਦਨੀ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਸਮਾਣੰ ॥੫੭॥
631.e: “He, before whom the army on foot is moving enthusiastically, and who after conquering millions, has not turned away from the war, whose horses are like pigeons and who has such chariots which are not even with Indra.57.

631.g: ਬਡੇ ਸ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਧਰੇ ਸੂਰ ਸੋਭੈ ॥
ਲਖੇ ਦੈਤ ਕੰਨ︀ਯਾ ਜਿਨੈ ਚਿਤ ਲੋਭੈ ॥
ਕਢੇ ਦੰਤ ਪਤੰ ਸਿਰੰ ਕੇਸ ਉਚੰ ॥
ਲਖੇ ਗਰਭਣੀ ਆਣਿ ਕੇ ਗਰਭ ਮੁਚੰ ॥੫੮॥
631.e: “He, with whom there are warriors of the size of the peaks of the mountains and seeing whom, the damsels of the demons get fascinated, smile and wave the hair of their heads and in whose fear the pregnant women lose their pregnancies.58.

631.g: ਲਖੋ ਲੰਕ ਏਸੰ ਨਰੇਸੰ ਸੁ ਬਾਲੰ ॥
ਸਬੈ ਸੰਗ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਬੈ ਲੋਕ ਪਾਲੰ ॥
631.e: “That mighty one is the king of Lanka (Ceylon), in whose company there are also Lokpals

631.g: ਲੁਟਿਓ ਏਕ ਬੇਰੰ ਕੁਬੇਰੰ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥
ਜਿਣਿਓ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਰਾਜਾ ਬਡੋ ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ॥੫੯॥
631.e: He had once looted the store of Kuber and had also defeated the mighty Indra.59.

631.g: ਕਹੇ ਜਉਨ ਬਾਲੀ ਨ ਤੇ ਚਿਤ ਆਨੇ ॥
ਜਿਤੇ ਭੂਪ ਭਾਰੀ ਸੁ ਪਾਛੇ ਬਖਾਨੇ ॥
631.e: “O princess! Tell me what is in your mind? The mention of the great kings has already been made

631.g: ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਰਾਜਾ ਕਹੋ ਨਾਮ ਸੋ ਭੀ ॥
ਤਜੇ ਭਾਤਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਸਬੈ ਰਾਜ ਓ ਭੀ ॥੬੦॥
631.e: There are kings and kings on all the four sides, but you have equally abandoned them all.60.

631.g: ਲਖੋ ਦਈਤ ਸੈਨਾ ਬਡੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥
ਸੁਭੈ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਡੇ ਸੰਗ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
631.e: “See that one who has a great army of demons with him

631.g: ਧੁਜਾ ਗਿਧ ਉਧੰ ਲਸੈ ਕਾਕ ਪੂਰੰ ॥
ਤਿਸੈ ਪਿਆਲ ਰਾਜਾ ਬਲੀ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਨੂਰੰ ॥੬੧॥
631.e: And with whom there are many canopied kings on whose banner the vultures and crows are sitting you may love that mighty king.61.

631.g: ਰਥੰ ਬੇਸਟੰ ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
ਸੁਭੈ ਸੰਗ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸਭੇ ਲੋਕ ਪਾਰੰ ॥
631.e: “He, who has charming garments and chariots and with whom there are all the Lokpals

631.g: ਇਹੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਰਾਜਾ ਦੁਰੰ ਦਾਨਵਾਰੰ ॥
ਤ੍ਰੀਆ ਤਾਸ ਚੀਨੋ ਅਦਿਤਿਆ ਕੁਮਾਰੰ ॥੬੨॥
631.e: Even the king Indra conceals himself in fear because of his fame as a Donor O friend! He is the same Aditya Kumar.62.

631.g: ਨਹੇ ਸਪਤ ਬਾਜੀ ਰਥੰ ਏਕ ਚਕ੍ਰੰ ॥
ਮਹਾ ਨਾਗ ਬਧੰ ਤਪੈ ਤੇਜ ਬਕ੍ਰੰ ॥
631.e: “He, in whose chariot, there are seven horses and who can even destroy Sheshnaga with his glory

631.g: ਮਹਾ ਉਗ੍ਰ ਧੰਨ੍ਵਾ ਸੁ ਆਜਾਨ ਬਾਹੰ ॥
ਸਹੀ ਚਿਤ ਚੀਨੋ ਤਿਸੈ ਦਿਉਸ ਨਾਹੰ ॥੬੩॥
631.e: Who has long arms and dreadful bow, recognize him as dinkar of Surya.63.

631.g: ਚੜਿਓ ਏਣ ਰਾਜੰ ਧਰੇ ਬਾਣ ਪਾਣੰ ॥
ਨਿਸਾ ਰਾਜ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲਖੋ ਤੇਜ ਮਾਣੰ ॥
ਕਰੈ ਰਸਮਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਉਜਾਲਾ ਪਰਾਨੰ ॥
ਜਪੈ ਰਾਤ੍ਰ ਦਿਉਸੰ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰੀ ਭੁਜਾਨੰ ॥੬੪॥
631.e: “He, whom you see coming with his bow and arrow, he is the king of the night, the brilliant Chandra, who lightens up for all the creatures and whom thousands of people remember day and night.64.

631.g: ਚੜੇ ਮਹਿਖੀਸੰ ਸੁਮੇਰੰ ਜੁ ਦੀਸੰ ॥
ਮਹਾ ਕ੍ਰੂਰ ਕਰਮੰ ਜਿਣਿਓ ਬਾਹ ਬੀਸੰ ॥
631.e: “This one, who while going for war, seems like a mountain and who has conquered greatly tyrannical, multi-armed kings

631.g: ਧੁਜਾ ਦੰਡ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੰ ਬਿਰਾਜੈ ॥
ਲਖੇ ਜਾਸ ਗਰਬੀਨ ਕੋ ਗਰਬ ਭਾਜੈ ॥੬੫॥
631.e: His banner is powerfully exhibiting its glory, seeing which, the pride of many egoists is shattered.65.

631.g: ਕਹਾ ਲੌ ਬਖਾਨੋ, ਬਡੇ ਗਰਬਧਾਰੀ ॥
ਸਬੈ ਘੇਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਜੁਰੀ ਭੀਰ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
631.e: “To what extent should I describe these great egoists? All of them are standing in groups and surrounding others

631.g: ਨਚੈ ਪਾਤਰਾ ਚਾਤੁਰਾ ਨਿਰਤਕਾਰੀ ॥
ਉਠੈ ਝਾਝ ਸਬਦੰ ਸੁਨੈ ਲੋਗ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੬੬॥
631.e: The comely and clever prositiutes are dancing and the voice of the musical instruments is being heard.66.

631.g: ਬਡੋ ਦਿਰਬ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਡੀ ਸੈਨ ਲੀਨੇ ॥
ਬਡੋ ਦਿਰਬ ਕੋ ਚਿਤ ਮੈ ਗਰਬ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
631.e: “The great wealthy kings taking their armies with themselves and taking pride in their riche, are seated here

631.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
631.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

631.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ; ਸੇਵਕ ਸਭਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
631.e: All beings and creatures are subservient to all those who serve in the Lord's Court.

631.g: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
631.e: Their God made them His own, and carried them across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

631.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
631.e: He resolves all the affairs of His Saints.

631.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ; ਪੂਰਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
631.e: He is merciful to the meek, kind and compassionate, the ocean of kindness, my Perfect Lord and Master. ||Pause||

631.g: ਆਉ ਬੈਠੁ. ਆਦਰੁ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ; ਊਨ ਨ. ਕਤਹੂੰ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
631.e: I am asked to come and be seated, everywhere I go, and I lack nothing.

631.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਦੀਓ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੨॥੩੦॥੯੪॥
631.e: The Lord blesses His humble devotee with robes of honor; O Nanak, the Glory of God is manifest. ||2||30||94||

631.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
631.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl:

631.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ. ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ; ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
631.e: Hear my prayer, O my Lord and Master; all beings and creatures were created by You.

631.g: ਰਾਖੁ ਪੈਜ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ; ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
631.e: You preserve the honor of Your Name, O Lord, Cause of causes. ||1||

631.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ. ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
631.e: O Dear God, Beloved, please, make me Your own.

631.g: ਬੁਰੇ ਭਲੇ ਹਮ; ਥਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
631.e: Whether good or bad, I am Yours. ||Pause||

631.g: ਸੁਣੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
631.e: The Almighty Lord and Master heard my prayer; cutting away my bonds, He has adorned me.

631.g: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ. ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੨੯॥੯੩॥
631.e: He dressed me in robes of honor, and blended His servant with Himself; Nanak is revealed in glory throughout the world. ||2||29||93||

632.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
632.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

632.g: ਮਾਈ. ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਬਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
632.e: O mother, my mind is out of control.

632.g: ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਤ; ਕਿਹਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੋਕਉ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
632.e: Night and day, it runs after sin and corruption. How can I restrain it? ||1||Pause||

632.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕੇ ਮਤ ਸੁਨਿ; ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਹੀਏ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
632.e: He listens to the teachings of the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, but he does not enshrine them in his heart, even for an instant.

632.g: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਿਓ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
632.e: Engrossed in the wealth and women of others, his life passes away uselessly. ||1||

632.g: ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਭਇਓ ਬਾਵਰੋ; ਸੂਝਤ ਨਹ. ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
632.e: He has gone insane with the wine of Maya, and does not understand even a bit of spiritual wisdom.

632.g: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ. ਬਸਤ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
632.e: Deep within his heart, the Immaculate Lord dwells, but he does not know this secret. ||2||

632.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
632.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

632.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ; ਕਉਨੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
632.e: What efforts should the mortal make,

632.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ. ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਪਾਵੈ; ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
632.e: to attain devotional worship of the Lord, and eradicate the fear of death? ||1||Pause||

632.g: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮ. ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੀ; ਧਰਮੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਰਈ ॥
632.e: Which actions, what sort of knowledge, and what religion - what Dharma should one practice?

632.g: ਕਉਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ. ਗੁਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ; ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਉ ਤਰਈ ॥੧॥
632.e: What Name of the Guru should one remember in meditation, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||1||

632.g: ਕਲ ਮੈ. ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ; ਜਾਹਿ ਜਪੈ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
632.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the One Lord is the treasure of mercy; chanting it, one obtains salvation.

632.g: ਅਉਰ ਧਰਮ. ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਮ ਨਾਹਨਿ; ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
632.e: No other religion is comparable to this; so speak the Vedas. ||2||

632.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰਹਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਲੇਪੀ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
632.e: He is beyond pain and pleasure, forever unattached; He is called the Lord of the world.

632.g: ਸੋ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਰਪਨਿ ਨਿਆਈ ॥੩॥੫॥
632.e: He dwells deep within your inner self, O Nanak, like the image in a mirror. ||3||5||

632.g: ਕਬਿਤੁ ॥
632.e: KABIT

632.g: ਨਾਗਨ ਕੇ ਛਉਨਾ ਹੈਂ, ਕਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਾਹੂੰ ਟਉਨਾ ਹੈਂ; ਕਿ ਕਾਮ ਕੇ ਖਿਲਉਨਾ ਹੈਂ, ਬਨਾਏ ਹੈਂ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਕੇ ॥
632.e: Either he is mercurial like the young ones of serpents or someone has seen him like the one, who casts spells on the king Aj, has been specially created like the toy of the god of love

632.g: ਇਸਤ੍ਰਿਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੈਂ, ਕਿ ਸੁੰਦਰਤਾ ਕੀ ਖਾਨ ਹੈਂ; ਕਿ ਕਾਮ ਕੇ ਕਲਾਨ, ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਹੈਂ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕੇ ॥
632.e: The king Aj is the breath of like for women, he is the mine of beauty and is skilful in the sexual sports

632.g: ਚਾਤੁਰਤਾ ਕੇ ਭੇਸ ਹੈਂ, ਕਿ ਰੂਪ ਕੇ ਨਰੇਸ ਹੈਂ; ਕਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁ ਦੇਸ, ਏਸ ਕੀਨੇ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਾਰ ਕੇ ॥
632.e: He is the apparent manifestation of wisdom and amongst the kings he is charming like the moon

632.g: ਤੇਗ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਤੀਰ ਹੈਂ, ਕਿ ਬਾਨਾ ਬਾਧੇ ਬੀਰ ਹੈਂ; ਸੁ ਐਸੇ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਅਜਿ ਕੇ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਐ ਸੰਭਾਰ ਕੇ ॥੮੪॥
632.e: It is not clear whether he is the sword or the arrow or a bedecked warrior such a brave king Aj is being seen with great caution.84.

632.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
632.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

632.g: ਮਾਈ; ਮੈ. ਕਿਹਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਲਖਉ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
632.e: O mother, how can I see the Lord of the world?

632.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਤਿਮਰਿ; ਮੋ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਉਰਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
632.e: In the utter darkness of emotional attachment and spiritual ignorance, my mind remains entangled. ||1||Pause||

632.g: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਮ. ਭਰਮ ਹੀ ਭਰਮ ਖੋਇਓ; ਨਹ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
632.e: Deluded by doubt, I have wasted my whole life; I have not obtained a stable intellect.

632.g: ਬਿਖਿਆਸਕਤ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ; ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀ ਅਧਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
632.e: I remain under the influence of corrupting sins, night and day, and I have not renounced wickedness. ||1||

632.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਕਬਹੂ. ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ; ਨਹ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਾਈ ॥
632.e: I never joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and I did not sing the Kirtan of God's Praises.

632.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਊ ਗੁਨੁ; ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੬॥
632.e: O servant Nanak, I have no virtues at all; keep me in Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||6||

632.g: ਅੰਤਿ. ਸੰਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਨਾ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
632.e: In the end, nothing shall go along with you; you have entrapped yourself in vain. ||1||

632.g: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿਓ. ਨ ਗੁਰ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਓ; ਨਹ ਉਪਜਿਓ. ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
632.e: You have not meditated or vibrated upon the Lord; you have not served the Guru, or His humble servants; spiritual wisdom has not welled up within you.

632.g: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰੈ; ਤੈ ਖੋਜਤ ਉਦਿਆਨਾ ॥੨॥
632.e: The Immaculate Lord is within your heart, and yet you search for Him in the wilderness. ||2||

632.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮਤ ਤੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ; ਅਸਥਿਰ ਮਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
632.e: You have wandered through many many births; you are exhausted but have still not found a way out of this endless cycle.

632.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਇ. ਪਦ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥
632.e: Now that you have obtained this human body, meditate on the Lord's Feet; Nanak advises with this advice. ||3||3||

632.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
632.e: SWAYYA

632.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
632.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

632.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੋ ॥
632.e: O mind, contemplate the Sanctuary of God.

632.g: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ. ਗਨਕਾ ਸੀ ਉਧਰੀ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
632.e: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Ganika the prostitute was saved; enshrine His Praises within your heart. ||1||Pause||

632.g: ਅਟਲ ਭਇਓ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ. ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ; ਅਰੁ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
632.e: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Dhroo became immortal, and obtained the state of fearlessness.

632.g: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤੈ. ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
632.e: The Lord and Master removes suffering in this way - why have you forgotten Him? ||1||

632.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ; ਗਜ ਗਰਾਹ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
632.e: As soon as the elephant took to the protective Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of mercy, he escaped from the crocodile.

632.g: ਮਹਮਾ ਨਾਮ. ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਬਰਨਉ; ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ. ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਹ ਤੂਟਾ ॥੨॥
632.e: How much can I describe the Glorious Praises of the Naam? Whoever chants the Lord's Name, his bonds are broken. ||2||

632.g: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਪਾਪੀ. ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨੇ; ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
632.e: Ajaamal, known throughout the world as a sinner, was redeemed in an instant.

632.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ. ਚੇਤ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ; ਤੈ ਭੀ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੪॥
632.e: Says Nanak, remember the Chintaamani, the jewel which fulfills all desires, and you too shall be carried across and saved. ||3||4||

632.g: ਚਿਤੰ ਤਾਸ ਚੀਨੋ ਸਹੀ ਦਿਰਬ ਪਾਲੰ ॥
ਉਠੈ ਜਉਨ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਕੀ ਜ੍ਵਾਲ ਮਾਲੰ ॥੬੭॥
632.e: O princess! see that king, the master of riches, from whose body the fires of beauty are arising.”67.

632.g: ਸਭੈ ਭੂਪ ਠਾਢੇ ਜਹਾ ਰਾਜ ਕੰਨਿਆ ॥
ਬਿਖੈ ਭੂ ਤਲੰ ਰੂਪ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨ ਅੰਨਿਆ ॥
632.e: Where there was the princess, all the kings were standing there

632.g: ਬਡੇ ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ਬਡੇ ਗਰਬ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
ਤਹਾ ਆਨਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਬਡੀ ਸੈਨ ਲੀਨੇ ॥੬੮॥
632.e: There was none other so beautiful on the earth many egoistic canopied kings, taking their armies with them, came and stood there.68.

632.g: ਨਦੀ ਸੰਗ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸਬੈ ਰੂਪ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
ਸਬੈ ਸਿੰਧ ਸੰਗੰ ਚੜੇ ਤੇਜ ਵਾਰੇ ॥
632.e: “He, form whom the streams adopt the glory of their comeliness and from whom the oceans also spring up, not enduring His brilliance

632.g: ਬਡੀ ਕਾਇ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਮਹਾ ਰੂਪ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
ਲਖੇ ਦੇਵ ਕੰਨਿਆਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੈ ॥੬੯॥
632.e: He, whose body is very big and whose beauty is magnificent and seeing whom, the heavenly maidens get allured.69.

632.g: ਕਹੋ ਨਾਰ, ਤੋ ਕੌ ਇਹੈ ਬਰੁਨ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
ਜਿਸੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਰਾਜਾਨ ਕੋ ਮਾਨ ਭਾਜਾ ॥
632.e: “O princess! All those different kings have come here seeing whom the pride of the kings is shattered

632.g: ਕਹਾ ਲੌ ਬਖਾਨੋ, ਜਿਤੇ ਭੂਪ ਆਏ ॥
ਸਬੈ ਬਾਲ ਕੌ ਲੈ ਭਵਾਨੀ ਬਤਾਏ ॥੭੦॥
632.e: To what extent should I describe those kings who have come here?” That goddess showed the princess all those kings.70.

632.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
632.e: SWAYYA

632.g: ਆਨਿ ਜੁਰੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਮੰਡਲ ਜੇਤਿ; ਤੇਤ ਸਬੈ ਤਿਨ ਤਾਸ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
632.e: All those kings who had come there, they were all shown to the princess

632.g: ਦੇਖ ਫਿਰੀ ਚਹੂੰ ਚਕ੍ਰਨ ਕੋ; ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਮਾਰਿ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਨਹੀ ਲਿਆਏ ॥
632.e: She saw the kings in all the four directions, but did not like anyone

632.g: ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਭਟ ਮੰਡਲ; ਭੂਪਤਿ ਹੇਰਿ ਦਸਾ ਮੁਰਝਾਏ ॥
632.e: The whole sphere of heroes was defeated and seeing such a situation, the kings also became dejected

632.g: ਫੂਕ ਭਏ ਮੁਖ ਸੂਕ ਗਏ; ਸਬ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਮਾਰਿ ਫਿਰੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥੭੧॥
632.e: The faces of all of them shrank and all the princes returned to their homes.71.

632.g: ਤਉ ਲਗਿ ਆਨ ਗਏ ਅਜਿਰਾਜ; ਸੁ ਰਾਜਨ ਰਾਜ ਬਡੋ ਦਲ ਲੀਨੇ ॥
ਅੰਬਰ ਅਨੂਪ ਧਰੇ ਪਸਮੰਬਰ; ਸੰਬਰ ਕੇ ਅਰਿ ਕੀ ਛਬਿ ਛੀਨੇ ॥
632.e: At that time, the king Aj, taking alongwith him him his big army, reached there, his unique silken garments were making the god of love feel shy

632.g: ਬੇਖਨ ਬੇਖ ਚੜੇ ਸੰਗ ਹ੍ਵੈ; ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਹਾਨ ਸਬੈ ਸੁਖ ਧਾਮ ਨਵੀਨੇ ॥
632.e: There were also many well-dressed other kings affording pleasure

632.g: ਆਨਿ ਗਏ ਜਰਿਕੰਬਰ ਸੇ; ਅੰਬਰ ਸੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੰਬਰ ਕੀਨੇ ॥੭੨॥
632.e: The king Aj, wearing handsome garments reached there.72.

632.g: ਪਾਤਿ ਹੀ ਪਾਤਿ ਬਨਾਇ ਬਡੋ ਦਲ; ਢੋਲ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਬਜਾਇ ॥
632.e: His army made queues and his forces began to play on the small and big durms

632.g: ਭੂਖਨ ਚਾਰੁ ਦਿਪੈ ਸਬ ਅੰਗ; ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਅਨੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਮੁਰਛਾਏ ॥
632.e: On the bodies of al, the handsome ornaments were shining and the god of love also seeting their comeliness, was becoming unconscious

632.g: ਬਾਜਤ ਚੰਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਉਪੰਗ; ਸੁਰੰਗ ਸੁ ਨਾਦ ਸਬੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
ਰੀਝ ਰਹੇ ਰਿਝਵਾਰ ਸਬੈ; ਲਖਿ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰਾਹਤ ਆਏ ॥੭੩॥
632.e: All were listening to the sounds of the musical instruments and all seeing their unique beauty, were getting pleased.73.

632.g: ਜੈਸ ਸਰੂਪ ਲਖਿਓ ਅਜਿ ਕੋ; ਹਮ ਤੈਸ ਸਰੂਪ ਨ ਅਉਰ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
632.e: The beauty of king Aj that we saw, had not seen the same beauty of anyone else before

632.g: ਚੰਦਿ ਚਪਿਓ ਲਖਿ ਕੈ ਮੁਖ ਕੀ ਛਬਿ; ਛੇਦ ਪਰੇ ਉਰ ਮੈ ਰਿਸ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
632.e: The moon seeing his comeliness, hid himself and his heart burnt with jealousy

632.g: ਤੇਜ ਸਰੂਪ ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਵਕ; ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਰੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅਉਰਨ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
632.e: The fire seeing his elegance, was irritated and he abandoned his burning activity

632.g: ਜੈਸ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਲਖਿਓ ਅਜਿ ਕੋ ਹਮ; ਤੈਸ ਸਰੂਪ ਨ ਭੂਪ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੭੪॥
632.e: The kind of beauty that the king Aj has, the same beauty we have never seen before.74.

632.g: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਜੁਆਨ ਸਰੂਪ ਮਹਾਨ; ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਚਹੁੰ ਚਕ ਮੈ ਹਮ ਜਾਨਿਓ ॥
632.e: He was winsome youth and had a shapely figure, which was considered foremost in all the four directions

632.g: ਭਾਨੁ ਸਮਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ; ਕਿ ਰਾਵ ਕਿ ਰਾਨ ਮਹਾਨ ਬਖਾਨਿਓ ॥
632.e: He was radiant like the sun and was a great sovereign amongst kings

632.g: ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਚਕੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਚਿਤਿ; ਚੰਦ ਸਰੂਪ ਨਿਸਾ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਿਓ ॥
632.e: The gods and others were all wonder-struck to see him and the night considered him as moon

632.g: ਦਿਉਸ ਕੈ ਭਾਨੁ ਮੁਨਿਓ ਭਗਵਾਨ; ਪਛਾਨ ਮਨੈ ਘਨ ਮੋਰਨ ਮਾਨਿਓ ॥੭੫॥
632.e: The day imagined him as the sun and the peacocks thought of him as the cloud.75.

632.g: ਬੋਲਿ ਉਠੇ ਪਿਕ ਜਾਨ ਬਸੰਤ; ਚਕੋਰਨ ਚੰਦ ਸਰੂਪ ਬਖਾਨਿਓ ॥
632.e: The rain-birds raised their voice considering him as spring and the partridges thought of his as moon

632.g: ਸਾਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਲਖਿਓ ਸਭ ਸਾਧਨ; ਜੋਧਨ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਪ੍ਰਤਛ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨਿਓ ॥
632.e: The saints thought of him as peace and the warriors apparently as anger

632.g: ਬਾਲਨ ਬਾਲ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਲਖਿਓ ਤਿਹ; ਸਤ੍ਰਨ ਕਾਲ ਸਰੂਪ ਪਛਾਨਿਓ ॥
632.e: The children considered him as a good-natured child and the enemies as KAL (death)

632.g: ਦੇਵਲ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵਨ ਕੈ ਸਿਵ; ਰਾਜਨ ਰਾਜਿ ਬਡੋ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨਿਓ ॥੭੬॥
632.e: The gods thought of him as god, the ghosts and fiends as Shiva and the kings as the Sovereign.76.

632.g: ਸਾਧਨ ਸਿਧ ਸਰੂਪ ਲਖਿਓ ਤਿਹ; ਸਤ੍ਰਨ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਨ ਬਸੇਖਿਓ ॥
632.e: The saints saw him as a Siddha (adept) and the enemies as enemy

632.g: ਚੋਰਨ ਭੋਰ, ਕਰੋਰਨ ਮੋਰਨ; ਤਾਸੁ ਸਹੀ ਘਨ ਕੈ ਅਵਿਰੇਖਿਓ ॥
632.e: The thieves saw him s early morn and the peacocks as cloud

632.g: ਕਾਮ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਭੈ ਪੁਰ ਨਾਰਨ; ਸੰਭੂ ਸਮਾਨ ਸਬੂ ਗਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ॥
632.e: All the women considered him as god of love and all the ganas as Shiva

632.g: ਸੀਪ ਸ੍ਵਾਤਿ ਕੀ ਬੂੰਦ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਰਿ; ਰਾਜਨ ਰਾਜ ਬਡੋ ਤਿਹ ਪੇਖਿਓ ॥੭੭॥
632.e: The shell saw him as the rain-drop and the kings as the Sovereing.77.

632.g: ਕੰਬਰ ਜਿਉ ਜਰਿਕੰਬਰ ਕੀ ਢਿਗ; ਤਿਉ ਅਵਿਨੰਬਰ ਤੀਰ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
632.e: The king Aj looked splendid on the earth just as the clouds in the sky

632.g: ਨਾਕ ਲਖੇ ਰਿਸ ਮਾਨ ਸੂਆ ਮਨ; ਨੈਨ ਦੋਊ ਲਖਿ ਏਣ ਲਜਾਏ ॥
632.e: Seeing his comely nose, the parrot got jealous and seeing both of his eyes, the wagtail felt shy

632.g: ਪੇਖਿ ਗੁਲਾਬ ਸਰਾਬ ਪੀਐ ਜਨੁ; ਪੇਖਤ ਅੰਗ ਅਨੰਗ ਰਿਸਾਏ ॥
632.e: Seeing his limbs, the rose got dead-drunks and the god of love got angry seeing his handsome neck

632.g: ਕੰਠ ਕਪੋਤ ਕਟੂ ਪਰ ਕੇਹਰ; ਰੋਸ ਰਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਭੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਏ ॥੭੮॥
632.e: And the lions seeing his waist forgot themselves and were not able to reach their homes.78.

632.g: ਪੇਖਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਿਰਾਤ ਨ ਲੋਚਨ; ਘੂਟਤ ਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਘੂਟ ਅਮੀ ਕੇ ॥
632.e: Seeing his lake-like eyes, it seemed that they became intoxicated after drinking a draught of ambrosia

632.g: ਗਾਵਤ ਗੀਤ ਬਜਾਵਤ ਤਾਲ; ਬਤਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਜਨੋ ਆਛਰ ਹੀ ਕੇ ॥
632.e: The songs were being sung and the musical instruments were being played

632.g: ਭਾਵਤ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਤ ਗਾਰ; ਦਿਵਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਭਰਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਜੀ ਕੇ ॥
ਤੂ ਸੁ ਕੁਮਾਰ, ਰਚੀ ਕਰਤਾਰ; ਕਹੈ ਅਬਿਚਾਰ ਤ੍ਰੀਆ ਬਰ ਨੀਕੇ ॥੭੯॥
632.e: The women in their pleasure were singing abusive songs and saying, “O prince! the Lord has created this princess for you, you may wed her.”79.

632.g: ਦੇਖਤ ਰੂਪ ਸਿਰਾਤ ਨ ਲੋਚਨ; ਪੇਖਿ ਛਕੀ ਪੀਅ ਕੀ ਛਬਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
ਗਾਵਤ ਗੀਤ ਬਜਾਵਤ ਢੋਲ; ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਮੁਚੰਗਨ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
632.e: Seeing the glory of his eyes, the women were absorbed in love and were singing songs while playing on the drums

632.g: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਜਿਤੀ ਪੁਰ ਨਾਗਰ; ਗਾਗਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਲਖੈ ਦੁਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
632.e: All the women who were coming from outside the town, seeing he beauty of the king, they threw away their gowns and were only looking at his charming face

632.g: ਰਾਜ ਕਰੋ ਤਬ ਲੌ ਜਬ ਲੌ ਮਹਿ; ਜਉ ਲਗ ਗੰਗ ਬਹੈ ਜਮੁਨਾ ਰੀ ॥੮੦॥
632.e: Seeing the king they all desired, “O king! let it be the God’s will that you may rule as long as th

632.g: ਜਉਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਅਜਿ ਰਾਜ ਕੀ ਰਾਜਤ; ਸੋ ਕਹਿ ਕੈ ਕਿਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਗਨਾਊ ॥
632.e: While describing the glory of king Aj. I accept that whatever similes the poets generally give,

632.g: ਜਉਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਕਬਿ ਦੇਤ ਸਬੈ ਜੌ ਪੈ; ਤਾਸ ਕਹੋ ਜੀਅ ਬੀਚ ਲਜਾਊ ॥
632.e: They are all discourteous and I feel shy while uttering them

632.g: ਹਉ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਬਸੁਧਾ; ਛਬਿ ਅੰਗਨ ਕੀਨ ਕਹੂੰ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਊ ॥
632.e: I have searched on all the earth in order to find someone so beautiful as you, but I was not successful

632.g: ਲੇਖਨ ਊਖ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਜਾਤ ਲਿਖੋ; ਛਬਿ ਆਨਨ ਤੇ ਕਿਮਿ ਭਾਖਿ ਸੁਨਾਊ ॥੮੧॥
632.e: Writing about your beauty, my pen is pulled down and how should I describe it from my mouth ? 81.

632.g: ਨੈਨਨ ਬਾਨ ਚਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ ਮਾਰਤ; ਘਾਇਲ ਕੈ ਪੁਰ ਬਾਸਨ ਡਾਰੀ ॥
632.e: The king with the arrows of his eyes, wounded all the townfolk

632.g: ਸਾਰਸ੍ਵਤੀ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕਹਿ ਰੂਪ; ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਕਹੈ ਮਤਿ ਕਉਨ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥
632.e: Even Saravati is uncable to describe the charm of his beauty

632.g: ਕੋਕਿਲ ਕੰਠਿ ਹਰਿਓ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਨਾਇਕ; ਛੀਨ ਕਪੋਤ ਕੀ ਗ੍ਰੀਵ ਅਨਿਆਰੀ ॥
632.e: The throat of the king is sweet like the nightingale and the neck like the pigeon

632.g: ਰੀਝ ਗਿਰੇ ਨਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਧਰਾ ਪਰ; ਘੂਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਘਾਇਲ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੮੨॥
632.e: Seeing his beauty, all are falling down on earth and getting wounded.82.

632.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
632.e: DOHRA

632.g: ਨਿਰਖਿ ਰੂਪ ਅਜਿ ਰਾਜ ਕੋ; ਰੀਝ ਰਹੇ ਨਰ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਕਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਕਿ ਸੂਰ ਇਹਿ; ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੮੩॥
632.e: The men and women are getting pleased on seeing the comeliness of form of king Aj and have not been able to decide whether he is Indra, Chandra of Surya.83.

633.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਿ. ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਆਇਓ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
633.e: When I came to the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints, all my evil-mindedness was dispelled.

633.g: ਤਬ ਨਾਨਕ. ਚੇਤਿਓ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ; ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
633.e: Then, O Nanak, I remembered the Chintaamani, the jewel which fulfills all desires, and the noose of Death was snapped. ||3||7||
Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

633.g: ਇਹ ਜਗਿ ਮੀਤੁ; ਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਕੋਈ ॥
633.e: In this world, I have not found any true friend.

633.g: ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ਅਪਨੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਲਾਗਿਓ; ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
633.e: The whole world is attached to its own pleasures, and when trouble comes, no one is with you. ||1||Pause||

633.g: ਦਾਰਾ ਮੀਤ ਪੂਤ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ; ਸਗਰੇ ਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
633.e: Wives, friends, children and relatives - all are attached to wealth.

633.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਨਰ ਕਉ; ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਭ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
633.e: When they see a poor man, they all forsake his company and run away. ||1||

633.g: ਕਹਂਉ ਕਹਾ. ਯਿਆ ਮਨ ਬਉਰੇ ਕਉ; ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
633.e: So what should I say to this crazy mind, which is affectionately attached to them?

633.g: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਸਕਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ; ਜਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
633.e: The Lord is the Master of the meek, the Destroyer of all fears, and I have forgotten to praise Him. ||2||

633.g: ਸੁਆਨ ਪੂਛ ਜਿਉ. ਭਇਓ ਨ ਸੂਧਉ; ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਤਨੁ. ਮੈ ਕੀਨਉ ॥
633.e: Like a dog's tail, which will never straighten out, the mind will not change, no matter how many things are tried.

633.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਲਾਜ ਬਿਰਦ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਉ ਲੀਨਉ ॥੩॥੯॥
633.e: Says Nanak, please, Lord, uphold the honor of Your innate nature; I chant Your Name. ||3||9||
Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

633.g: ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਦੁਖ ਮੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
633.e: That man, who in the midst of pain, does not feel pain,

633.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਕੰਚਨ ਮਾਟੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
633.e: who is not affected by pleasure, affection or fear, and who looks alike upon gold and dust;||1||Pause||

633.g: ਨਹ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਨਹ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
633.e: Who is not swayed by either slander or praise, nor affected by greed, attachment or pride;

633.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ. ਰਹੈ ਨਿਆਰਉ; ਨਾਹਿ ਮਾਨ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
633.e: who remains unaffected by joy and sorrow, honor and dishonor;||1||

633.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗੈ; ਜਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
633.e: who renounces all hopes and desires and remains desireless in the world;

633.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜਿਹ ਪਰਸੈ ਨਾਹਨਿ; ਤਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
633.e: who is not touched by sexual desire or anger - within his heart, God dwells. ||2||

633.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਕਉ ਕੀਨੀ; ਤਿਹ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
633.e: That man, blessed by Guru's Grace, understands this way.

633.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਨ ਭਇਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ; ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੧੧॥
633.e: O Nanak, he merges with the Lord of the Universe, like water with water. ||3||11||

633.g: ਤੀਰਨ ਤੇ ਤਰਵਾਰਨ ਸੇ; ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਬਾਰਨ ਸੇ ਅਵਿਲੋਕਹੁ ਜਾਈ ॥
ਰੀਝ ਰਹੀ ਰਿਝਵਾਰ ਲਖੇ; ਦੁਤਿ ਭਾਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ, ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
633.e: He is impressive like a sword or an arrow his simple beauty like the young one of a deer is worth seeing all are getting pleased on seeing him and his glory is indescribable

633.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲੀ ਉਠਿ ਬਾਲ ਬਿਲੋਕਨ; ਮੋਰ ਚਕੋਰ ਰਹੇ ਉਰਝਾਈ ॥
ਡੀਠਿ ਪਰੈ ਅਜਿ ਰਾਜ ਜਬੈ; ਚਿਤ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰੀਅ ਲੀਨ ਚੁਰਾਈ ॥੮੫॥
633.e: The princess is moving forward to see him and seeing him, the peacocks and partridges have fallen in confusion the heart of that princess was fascinated, the moment she saw the king Aj.85.
Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

633.g: ਰੇ ਨਰ; ਇਹ ਸਾਚੀ ਜੀਅ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
633.e: O man, grasp this Truth firmly in your soul.

633.g: ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੁਪਨਾ; ਬਿਨਸਤ. ਲਗਤ ਨ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
633.e: The whole world is just like a dream; it will pass away in an instant. ||1||Pause||

633.g: ਬਾਰੂ ਭੀਤਿ ਬਨਾਈ ਰਚਿ ਪਚਿ; ਰਹਤ ਨਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
633.e: Like a wall of sand, built up and plastered with great care, which does not last even a few days,

633.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਇਹ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ; ਉਰਝਿਓ ਕਹਾ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
633.e: just so are the pleasures of Maya. Why are you entangled in them, you ignorant fool? ||1||

633.g: ਅਜਹੂ ਸਮਝਿ. ਕਛੁ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਨਾਹਿਨਿ; ਭਜਿ ਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
633.e: Understand this today - it is not yet too late! Chant and vibrate the Name of the Lord.

633.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਿਜ ਮਤੁ ਸਾਧਨ ਕਉ; ਭਾਖਿਓ ਤੋਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮॥
633.e: Says Nanak, this is the subtle wisdom of the Holy Saints, which I proclaim out loud to you. ||2||8||
Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:

633.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ; ਗਹਿਓ ਨ. ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
633.e: O mind, you have not accepted the Guru's Teachings.

633.g: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ. ਜਉ ਮੂਡੁ ਮੁਡਾਇਓ; ਭਗਵਉ ਕੀਨੋ ਭੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
633.e: What is the use of shaving your head, and wearing saffron robes? ||1||Pause||

633.g: ਸਾਚ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ. ਝੂਠਹ ਲਾਗਿਓ; ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਓ ॥
633.e: Abandoning Truth, you cling to falsehood; your life is uselessly wasting away.

633.g: ਕਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਉਦਰ ਨਿਜ ਪੋਖਿਓ; ਪਸੁ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਸੋਇਓ ॥੧॥
633.e: Practicing hypocrisy, you fill your belly, and then sleep like an animal. ||1||

633.g: ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਾ ॥
633.e: You do not know the Way of the Lord's meditation; you have sold yourself into Maya's hands.

633.g: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਉਰਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
633.e: The madman remains entangled in vice and corruption; he has forgotten the jewel of the Naam. ||2||

633.g: ਰਹਿਓ ਅਚੇਤੁ. ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅਉਧ ਸਿਰਾਨੀ ॥
633.e: He remains thoughtless, not thinking of the Lord of the Universe; his life is uselessly passing away.

633.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਉ; ਭੂਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੧੦॥
633.e: Says Nanak, O Lord, please, confirm your innate nature; this mortal is continually making mistakes. ||3||10||
TOMAR STANZA
When the princess saw the king, the treasure of beauty, she held her wreath of flowers with smile.86.
The charming damsel caught the garland in her hand and put it around the neck of the king, expert in eighteen sciences.87.
The goddess said to that princess, who was expert in all sciences, “O beautiful maiden like moonlight having charming eyes! listen to what I say.88.
“O princess full of charm and shyness! the king Aj is worthy match for you
You see him and listen to my speech”89.
The princess caught the wreath of flowers and put it around the neck of the king and
At that time many musical instruments including the lyre were played.90.
The tabor, drum, kettledrum and many other musical instruments of various tunes and tones were played
The flutes were played and there were many beautiful ladies of charming eyes seated there.91.
The king Aj wedded that damsel and taking various types of dowry and
Causing the tabor and lyre to be played, he retuned home with great happiness.92.
The king expert in eighteen sciences, was the ocean of pleasure and store of gentleness
He had conquered even Shiva in the war.93.
In this waay, he ruled and caused the canopy to be swung over his head and in the whole world,
The ceremonies regarding he divine kingship of that victorious king were performed.94.
The king Aj, after conquering all the four directions, gave charities of materials as a generous king
Being expert in all sciences, that king was extremely benevolent.95.
His eyes and body were so charming, hat even the god of love felt jealous

634.e: Now begins the description of six sages, the sixth incarnation of Brahma
TOMAR STANZA
In this next Age, Vyas composed Puranas in the world and in doing this his prie was also increased
He also did not considered anyone equal to him.1.
Then the dreadful KAL (death) in his rage divided him into six parts with his great fires
Then they ware considered lowly.2.
His life-force was not terminated and form his six parts emerged six sages,
Who were the wupreme scholars of Shastras and they compsed six Shastras in their names.3.
These six sages of the lustre of Brahma and Yyas, brought to light six Shastras and in this way,
Brahma assumed the sixth incarnation made ideological improvements over the earth through six Shastras.4.

634.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਖਸਟਮੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਖਸਟ ਰਿਖ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੬॥
634.e: End of the description about six sages, the sixth incarnation of Brahma in Bhachittar Natak.6.
Sorat'h, First Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa, Chau-Thukay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

634.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਪੜਉ. ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ, ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਉ; ਮੜੈ ਮਸਾਣਿ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
634.e: I am not torn by duality, because I do not worship any other than the Lord; I do not visit tombs or crematoriums.

634.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ. ਨ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਾ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ. ਨਾਮਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
634.e: I do not enter the houses of strangers, engrossed in desire. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, has satisfied my desires.

634.g: ਘਰ ਭੀਤਰਿ. ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ; ਸਹਜਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
634.e: Deep within my heart, the Guru has shown me the home of my being, and my mind is imbued with peace and poise, O Siblings of Destiny.

634.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ. ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ; ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
634.e: You Yourself are all-knowing, and You Yourself are all-seeing; You alone bestow intelligence, O Lord. ||1||

634.g: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ਰਤਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ. ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
634.e: My mind is detached, imbued with detachment; the Word of the Shabad has pierced my mind, O my mother.

634.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ; ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
634.e: God's Light shines continually within the nucleus of my deepest self; I am lovingly attached to the Bani, the Word of the True Lord Master. ||Pause||

634.g: ਅਸੰਖ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ. ਕਹਹਿ ਬੈਰਾਗ; ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
634.e: Countless detached renunciates talk of detachment and renunciation, but he alone is a true renunciate, who is pleasing to the Lord Master.

634.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਬਦਿ. ਸਦਾ ਭੈ ਰਚਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
634.e: The Word of the Shabad is ever in his heart; he is absorbed in the Fear of God, and he works to serve the Guru.

634.g: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤੈ. ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ; ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥
634.e: He remembers the One Lord, his mind does not waver, and he restrains its wanderings.

634.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ. ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ; ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
634.e: He is intoxicated with celestial bliss, and is ever imbued with the Lord's Love; he sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||2||

634.g: ਮਨੂਆ ਪਉਣੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ; ਨਾਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਈ ॥
634.e: The mind is like the wind, but if it comes to rest in peace, even for an instant, then he shall abide in the peace of the Name, O Siblings of Destiny.

634.g: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਤ੍ਰ. ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਜਲਿ ਬੂਝੀ. ਤੁਝਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
634.e: His tongue, eyes and ears are imbued with Truth; O Lord, You quench the fires of desire.

634.g: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
634.e: In hope, the renunciate remains free of hopes; in the home of his own inner self, he is absorbed in the trance of deep meditation.

634.g: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਜੇ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਆਈ ॥੩॥
634.e: He remains content, satisfied with the charity of the Naam; he drinks in the Ambrosial Amrit with ease. ||3||

634.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਚਿ. ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ; ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਰਾਈ ॥
634.e: There is no renunciation in duality, as long as there is even a particle of duality.

634.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ, ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
634.e: The whole world is Yours, Lord; You alone are the Giver. There is not any other, O Siblings of Destiny.

634.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੰਤ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
634.e: The self-willed manmukh dwells in misery forever, while the Lord bestows greatness upon the Gurmukh.

634.g: ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ; ਕਹਣੈ. ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
634.e: God is infinite, endless, inaccessible and unfathomable; His worth cannot be described. ||4||

634.g: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ; ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
634.e: The consciousness in deep Samaadhi, the Supreme Being, the Lord of the three worlds - these are Your Names, Lord.

634.g: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਿ ਜੋਨੀ; ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਸਹਾਮੰ ॥
634.e: The creatures born into this world have their destiny inscribed upon their foreheads; they experience according to their destinies.

634.g: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ; ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਮੰ ॥
634.e: The Lord Himself causes them to do good and bad deeds; He Himself makes them steadfast in devotional worship.

634.g: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਜੂਠਿ ਲਹੈ. ਭੈ ਮਾਨੰ; ਆਪੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਗਾਮੰ ॥੫॥
634.e: The filth of their mind and mouth is washed off when they live in the Fear of God; the inaccessible Lord Himself blesses them with spiritual wisdom. ||5||
Now begins the description of Kalidas Incarnation
TOMAR STANZA
Sorat'h, Ninth Mehl:
O dear friend, know this in your mind.

634.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਿਉ ਹੀ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਂਧਿਓ; ਕੋ. ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
634.e: The world is entangled in its own pleasures; no one is for anyone else. ||1||Pause||

634.g: ਸੁਖ ਮੈ ਆਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੈਠਤ; ਰਹਤ ਚਹੂ ਦਿਸਿ ਘੇਰੈ ॥
634.e: In good times, many come and sit together, surrounding you on all four sides.

634.g: ਬਿਪਤਿ ਪਰੀ. ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਡਿਤ; ਕੋਊ. ਨ ਆਵਤ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
634.e: But when hard times come, they all leave, and no one comes near you. ||1||

634.g: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ. ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ; ਸਦਾ ਰਹਤ ਸੰਗ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
634.e: Your wife, whom you love so much, and who has remained ever attached to you,

634.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਹੰਸ ਤਜੀ ਇਹ ਕਾਂਇਆ; ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
634.e: runs away crying, "Ghost! Ghost!", as soon as the swan-soul leaves this body. ||2||

634.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਹੈ; ਜਾ ਸਿਉ. ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
634.e: This is the way they act - those whom we love so much.

634.g: ਅੰਤ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ; ਕੋਊ ਕਾਮਿ. ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੩॥੧੨॥੧੩੯॥
634.e: At the very last moment, O Nanak, no one is any use at all, except the Dear Lord. ||3||12||139||
Hundreds of kings evaded him, seeing the moonlike beauty of his face.96.
In this way, the king ruled like a great sovereign in the world doing religious and social services and performing Yajnas
If I narrate all the things associated with him, the story will be greatly increased.97.
Therefore, I say in brief, O brothers! listen to it
The king Aj ruled in this way in various ways in religions and society.98.
He abandoned the idea of considering the whole world as his own and did not care for anyone
Then the great Death, in great rage, reduced king Aj to ashes in his fire.99.
Seeing the king Aj merging in the supreme Light, all the people became fearful like the passengers of a boat without the sailor
The people became weak like the individual becoming helpless with the loss of physical strength.100.
Just as a village becomes helpless without a headman, the earth becomes meaningless without fertility,
The treasure loses charm without wealth and the trader becomes in low spirit without the trade.101.
Without the king, the people became like poetry without meaning, friend without love,
The country without the king and as the army becomes helpless without the general.102.
That state becomes like a Yogi without knowledge, a king without kingdom,
The idea without the meaning and the donor without the material.103.
The people became like an elephant without a goad, the king without the army,
The warrior without weapons and the ideas without wiseom.104.
They are just like the wife without husband, the woman without beloved,
The poetry without wisdom and the friend without love.105.
They are just like the country becoming desolate, the women losing their husbands,
The Brahmins without learning or the men without wealth.106.
In this way, the kings, who ruled over this country, how can they be described?
Vyas, the store of Vedic learning, composed eighteen Puranas.107.
He composed eighteen parvas (parts of Mahabharata), listening which th whole world was pleased
In this way Vyas was the fifth incarnation of Brahma.108.

634.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਪੰਚਮੋਵਤਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਆਸ ਰਾਜਾ ਅਜ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੧੦॥੫॥
634.e: End of the description of Vyas the fifth incarnation of Brahma and the rule of king Aj in Bachittar Natak.5.

635.e: PAADHARI STANZA

635.g: ਤਿਮ ਕਹੇ ਰਿਖਿਨ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਸਮਾਜ ॥
ਜਿਹ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਤਿਹ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਨ ॥
ਜਿਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਜੇਮਿ ਦਿਜ ਬਰਨ ਲੀਨ ॥੭॥
635.e: The way, in which all the kings have been described, in the same way, the actions done by all the sages have been narrated as to how Rudra manifested himself in the castes of dvijas (twice born).7.

635.g: ਤੇ ਤੇ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਾਖੋ ਸੁ ਬਾਸ ॥
635.e: Whatever deeds they brought to light, I relate them here

635.g: ਰਿਖਿ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਏਸ ਭਏ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਦੇਵ ॥

635.e: In this way, rudra became the sons of the sages, who adopted silence and attained recognition.8.

635.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਭਏ ਅਤ੍ਰਿ ਰਿਖਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਮਹਾਨ ॥

635.e: Then he incarnated himself as sage Atrl, who the store of eighteen sciences

635.g: ਲਿਨੇ ਸੁ ਜੋਗ ਤਜਿ ਰਾਜ ਆਨਿ ॥

635.e: He abandoned everything else and adopted Yoga as his way of life and served Rudra, the store of all wealth.9.

635.g: ਕਿਨੋ ਸੁ ਯੋਗ ਬਹੁ ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ॥
ਬਰੁ ਮਾਗ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ, ਜੋ ਰੁਚੈ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
ਬਰੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਤਉਨ ਮੈ ਦੇਉ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੧੦॥
635.e: He performed austerities for a long time, on which, Rudra got pleased and said, “You may ask for any boon which you like, I shall grant it to you.”10.

635.g: ਕਰਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਅਤ੍ਰਿ ਤਬ ਭਯੋ ਠਾਢ ॥

635.e: Then the sage Atri stood up with folded hands and his love for Rudra was further increased in his mind

635.g: ਗਦ ਗਦ ਸੁ ਬੈਣ ਭਭਕੰਤ ਨੈਣ ॥

635.e: He became very happy the tears flowed form his eyes and his hair showed signs of jubilation, when he said11

635.g: ਜੋ ਦੇਤ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ, ਬਰੁ ਰੀਝ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਹੋਇ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
635.e: “O Rudra! if you want to grant me a boon, then give me a son like you

635.g: ਕਹਿ ਕੈ ਤਥਾਸਤੁ ਭਏ ਅੰਤ੍ਰ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਗਯੋ ਅਤ੍ਰਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਮਹਾਨ ॥੧੨॥
635.e: ” Rudra saying “let it be”, disappeared and the sage came back to his home.12.

635.g: ਜਨੁ ਪਠਿਓ ਤਤੁ ਨਿਜ ਸਿਵ ਨਿਕਾਰਿ ॥
ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ. ਸੇਈ ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਣਨਿ; ਜਿਉ ਗੁੰਗੇ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ॥
635.e: Only those who taste it know its sweet taste, like the mute, who eats the candy, and only smiles.

635.g: ਅਕਥੈ ਕਾ. ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਚਾਲਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
635.e: How can I describe the indescribable, O Siblings of Destiny? I shall follow His Will forever.

635.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਲੇ. ਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਨਿਗੁਰੇ. ਮਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
635.e: If one meets with the Guru, the Generous Giver, then he understands; those who have no Guru cannot understand this.

635.g: ਜਿਉ ਚਲਾਏ. ਤਿਉ ਚਾਲਹ ਭਾਈ; ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੬॥
635.e: As the Lord causes us to act, so do we act, O Siblings of Destiny. What other clever tricks can anyone try? ||6||

635.g: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ. ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ; ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
635.e: Some are deluded by doubt, while others are imbued with devotional worship; Your play is infinite and endless.

635.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਾਏ. ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤੂ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
635.e: As You engage them, they receive the fruits of their rewards; You alone are the One who issues Your Commands.

635.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ. ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਪਣਾ; ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
635.e: I would serve You, if anything were my own; my soul and body are Yours.

635.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
635.e: One who meets with the True Guru, by His Grace, takes the Support of the Ambrosial Naam. ||7||

635.g: ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸਿਆ. ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ; ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨੰ ॥
635.e: He dwells in the heavenly realms, and his virtues radiantly shine forth; meditation and spiritual wisdom are found in virtue.

635.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ. ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ; ਤਤੋ ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਨੰ ॥
635.e: The Naam is pleasing to his mind; he speaks it, and causes others to speak it as well. He speaks the essential essence of wisdom.

635.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰਾ. ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨੰ ॥
635.e: The Word of the Shabad is his Guru and spiritual teacher, profound and unfathomable; without the Shabad, the world is insane.

635.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ. ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਗੀ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੰ ॥੮॥੧॥
635.e: He is a perfect renunciate, naturally at ease, O Nanak, whose mind is pleased with the True Lord. ||8||1||
The Lord is One and He can be attained through the grace of the true Guru.
The Lord is One and He can be realized through the Grace of the True Guru.
Now begins the description of Rudra Incarnation
TOMAR STANZA
Now I describe in chastened form those incarnations, which were assumed by Rudra
Performing extreme austerities Rudra became egoistic.1.
He did not consider anyone equal to him in all place and countries, then Mahakal (the great death) in ire said to him thus
“Those who become proud, they deliberately perform the action of falling into a well
O Rudra! Listen to me attentively that my name is also the destroyer of ego.3.
“Brahma had also become egoistic in his mind and the evil notions arose there, but when he took birth for seven times, he was then redeemed.4.
“O the king of sages! listen to what I say and in the same way, you may go and take birth on the earth
Otherwise, O Rudra! You will not be redeemed in any other way.”5.
Hearing this, Shiva, considering the Lord as the destroyer of ego, and leaving his persistence, incarnated on earth.6.
This Brahma, the ocean of Vedas, who was the authentic knower of eighteen Puranas and Shastras, began to scan the whole world in his incarnation named Kalidas in the Iron Age.1.
The king Vikramaditya, who himself was glorious, unconquerable, scholar, full of virtues with auspicious brightness and charming eyes, remained pleased on seeing kalidas.2.
After his manifestation, Kalidas composed in chastened form his poem ‘Raghuvansh’
To what extent I should describe the number of poems that he composed?3.
He was the seventh incarnation of Brahma and when he was redeemed, then he assumed the form of fourheaded Brahma i.e. merged himself in Brahma.4.

635.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਸਪਤਮੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਕਾਲਿਦਾਸ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ॥੭॥
635.e: End of the description of Kalidas, the seventh incarnation of Brahma in a Bachittar Natak.7.
Sorat'h, First Mehl, Thi-Thukay:

635.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੰਧਨੀ ਭਾਈ; ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਬੰਧਕਾਰੀ ॥
635.e: Hope and desire are entrapments, O Siblings of Destiny. Religious rituals and ceremonies are traps.

635.g: ਪਾਪਿ ਪੁੰਨਿ. ਜਗੁ ਜਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ; ਬਿਨਸੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
635.e: Because of good and bad deeds, one is born into the world, O Siblings of Destiny; forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he is ruined.

635.g: ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ. ਜਗਿ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਭਾਈ; ਕਰਮ ਸਭੇ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
635.e: This Maya is the enticer of the world, O Siblings of Destiny; all such actions are corrupt. ||1||
Listen, O ritualistic Pandit:

635.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਰਮਿ. ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ; ਸੁ ਆਤਮ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
635.e: that religious ritual which produces happiness, O Siblings of Destiny, is contemplation of the essence of the soul. ||Pause||

635.g: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ. ਬਕੈ ਖੜੋ ਭਾਈ; ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
635.e: You may stand and recite the Shaastras and the Vedas, O Siblings of Destiny, but these are just worldly actions.

635.g: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਮੈਲੁ. ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਭਾਈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
635.e: Filth cannot be washed away by hypocrisy, O Siblings of Destiny; the filth of corruption and sin is within you.

635.g: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ. ਡੂਬੀ ਮਾਕੁਰੀ ਭਾਈ; ਊਂਡੀ ਸਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
635.e: This is how the spider is destroyed, O Siblings of Destiny, by falling head-long in its own web. ||2||

635.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਘਣੀ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ਭਾਈ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
635.e: So many are destroyed by their own evil-mindedness, O Siblings of Destiny; in the love of duality, they are ruined.

635.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਨਾਮੁ, ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ. ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
635.e: Without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Name, doubt does not depart.

635.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ. ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਈ; ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੩॥
635.e: If one serves the True Guru, then he obtains peace, O Siblings of Destiny; his comings and goings are ended. ||3||

635.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ. ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ; ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
635.e: True celestial peace comes from the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; the immaculate mind is absorbed into the True Lord.

635.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
635.e: One who serves the Guru, understands, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Guru, the way is not found.

635.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਭਾਈ; ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੪॥
635.e: What can anyone do, with greed within? O Siblings of Destiny, by telling lies, they eat poison. ||4||

635.g: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਦਹੀ ਵਿਲੋਈਐ ਭਾਈ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਤਥੁ ॥
635.e: O Pandit, by churning cream, butter is produced.

635.g: ਜਲੁ ਮਥੀਐ. ਜਲੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਏਹਾ ਵਥੁ ॥
635.e: By churning water, you shall only see water, O Siblings of Destiny; this world is like that.

635.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਚੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਅਲਖੁ ॥੫॥
635.e: Without the Guru, he is ruined by doubt, O Siblings of Destiny; the unseen Divine Lord is in each and every heart. ||5||

635.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ. ਤਾਗੋ ਸੂਤ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ; ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬਾਧੋ ਮਾਇ ॥
635.e: This world is like a thread of cotton, O Siblings of Destiny, which Maya has tied on all ten sides.

635.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਗਾਠਿ ਨ ਛੂਟਈ, ਭਾਈ; ਥਾਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
635.e: Without the Guru, the knots cannot be untied, O Siblings of Destiny; I am so tired of religious rituals.

635.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ; ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
635.e: This world is deluded by doubt, O Siblings of Destiny; no one can say anything about it. ||6||

635.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ; ਭੈ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
635.e: Meeting with the Guru, the Fear of God comes to abide in the mind; to die in the Fear of God is one's true destiny.

635.g: ਮਜਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਭਾਈ; ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥
635.e: In the Court of the Lord, the Naam is far superior to ritualistic cleansing baths, charity and good deeds, O Siblings of Destiny.

636.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਰੁ ਬਿਸਨ ਨਿਜ ਤੇਜ ਕਾਢਿ ॥
ਆਏ ਸੁ ਮਧਿ ਅਨਿਸੂਆ ਛਾਡਿ ॥੧੩॥
636.e: On returning, he married Ansuya, who had been blessed by Shiva, Brahma and Vishnu by their Lustre.13.

636.g: ਭਈ ਕਰਤ ਜੋਗ ਬਹੁ ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ॥
ਅਨਸੂਆ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਨ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
636.e: Ansuya also, in consonance with her name, inspection being a charming lady, performed austerities

636.g: ਅਤਿ ਤੇਜਵੰਤ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰੰਗ ॥
ਜਨੁ ਧਰਾ ਰੂਪ ਦੂਸਰ ਅਨੰਗ ॥੧੪॥
636.e: She was extremely lustrous and glorious and it appeared that she was the second manifestation of the goddess of love (Rati).14.

636.g: ਸੋਭਾ ਅਪਾਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
ਸਊਹਾਗ ਭਾਗ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਲਸੰਤ ॥
ਜਿਹ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਰੂਪ ਸੋਰਹਿ ਲੁਭਾਇ ॥
ਆਭਾ ਅਪਾਰ ਬਰਨੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੫॥
636.e: That pretty and married fortunate woman was glorious in various ways on seeing whom, the personification of beauty also got allured her glory is indescribable.15.

636.g: ਨਿਸ ਨਾਥ ਦੇਖਿ ਆਨਨ ਰਿਸਾਨ ॥
ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਨੈਨ ਲਹਿ ਰੋਸ ਮਾਨ ॥
636.e: Seeing her face, the moon was filled with jealousy and wept in affection

636.g: ਤਮ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਕੇਸ ਕੀਅ ਨੀਚ ਡੀਠ ॥
ਛਪਿ ਰਹਾ ਜਾਨੁ ਗਿਰ ਹੇਮ ਪੀਠ ॥੧੬॥
636.e: Seeing her hair, he bowed down her looks and even the Sumeru mountain, seeing her beauty, concealed himself.16.

636.g: ਕੰਠਹਿ ਕਪੋਤਿ ਲਖਿ ਕੋਪ ਕੀਨ ॥
ਨਾਸਾ ਨਿਹਾਰਿ ਬਨਿ ਕੀਰ ਲੀਨ ॥
636.e: Seeing her neck, the female pigeon got enraged and the parrot seeing her nostril hid himself in the forest

636.g: ਰੋਮਾਵਲਿ ਹੇਰਿ ਜਮੁਨਾ ਰਿਸਾਨ ॥
ਲਜਾ ਮਰੰਤ ਸਾਗਰ ਡੁਬਾਨ ॥੧੭॥
636.e: Seeing her hair, even Yamuna was filled with anger and seeing her serenity, the ocean felt shy.17.

636.g: ਬਾਹੂ ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਲਾਜੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਨਾਲ ॥
ਖਿਸਿਯਾਨ ਹੰਸ ਅਵਿਲੋਕਿ ਚਾਲ ॥
636.e: Seeing her arms, the lotus-stalk felt she and the swans, seeing her gait got angry

636.g: ਜੰਘਾ ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਕਦਲੀ ਲਜਾਨ ॥
ਨਿਸ ਰਾਟ ਆਪ ਘਟਿ ਰੂਪ ਮਾਨ ॥੧੮॥
636.e: Seeing her legs, the Kadli trees became shyful and the moon considered his beauty inferior to her.18.

636.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਤਾਸੁ ਬਰਣੋ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ॥
ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਕਬਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਉਚਾਰ ॥
636.e: In this way, the charm of her beauty is described, and no poet can utter her greatness

636.g: ਐਸੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਵਿਲੋਕ ਅਤ੍ਰਿ ॥
ਜਨੁ ਲੀਨ ਰੂਪ ਕੋ ਛੀਨ ਛਤ੍ਰ ॥੧੯॥
636.e: Seeing such a beauteous lady, the sage Atri believed that he had obtained canopied kingdom of beauty.19.

636.g: ਕੀਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਗਿ ਤਿਹ ਸਮੇ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
ਬ੍ਰਯਾਹੈ ਨ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੈ ਭਤਾਰ ॥
ਮੈ ਬਰੌ ਤਾਸੁ ਰੁਚਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਚਿਤ ॥
ਜੋ ਸਹੈ ਕਸਟ ਐਸੇ ਪਵਿਤ ॥੨੦॥
636.e: That lady had vowed that she would not marry her husband for sexual enjoyment, and would wed that person, who would have the strength to endure the sacred tribulations of austrerities.20.

636.g: ਰਿਖਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਬੈਨ ਤਬ ਬਰ੍ਰਯੋ ਵਾਹਿ ॥
ਜਨੁ ਲੀਨ ਲੂਟ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
636.e: The sage (Arti) had agreed with her vow and married her and sacrificed himself on her charm of beauty

636.g: ਲੈ ਗਯੋ ਧਾਮਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਤਉਨ ॥
ਪਿਤ ਦਤ ਦੇਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਅਤ੍ਰਿ ਜਉਨ ॥੨੧॥
636.e: He, the sage Atri, who was the father of Dattatreya, making her his wife, brought her home.21.

636.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਦੁਤੁਕੀ ॥
636.e: Sorat'h, First Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

636.g: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤੌ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਭਾਈ; ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
636.e: You are the Giver of virtue, O Immaculate Lord, but my mind is not immaculate, O Siblings of Destiny.

636.g: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੇ ਭਾਈ; ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
636.e: I am a worthless sinner, O Siblings of Destiny; virtue is obtained from You alone, Lord. ||1||

636.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ; ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
636.e: O my Beloved Creator Lord, You create, and You behold.

636.g: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੀਆ. ਭਾਈ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
636.e: I am a hypocritical sinner, O Siblings of Destiny. Bless my mind and body with Your Name, O Lord. ||Pause||

636.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
636.e: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

636.g: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਸਾਥ ਤਰੇ ॥
636.e: Those who serve the True Guru, O Beloved, their companions are saved as well.

636.g: ਤਿਨੑਾ. ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਨ ਹਰੇ ॥
636.e: No one blocks their way, O Beloved, and the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar is on their tongue.

636.g: ਬੂਡੇ ਭਾਰੇ. ਭੈ ਬਿਨਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਤਾਰੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
636.e: Without the Fear of God, they are so heavy that they sink and drown, O Beloved; but the Lord, casting His Glance of Grace, carries them across. ||1||

636.g: ਭੀ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
636.e: I ever praise You, O Beloved, I ever sing Your Praises.

636.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਬੋਹਿਥ. ਭੈ ਡੁਬੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਕੰਧੀ ਪਾਇ ਕਹਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
636.e: Without the boat, one is drowned in the sea of fear, O Beloved; how can I reach the distant shore? ||1||Pause||

636.g: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
636.e: I praise the Praiseworthy Lord, O Beloved; there is no other one to praise.

636.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ. ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
636.e: Those who praise my God are good, O Beloved; they are imbued with the Word of the Shabad, and His Love.

636.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਰਸੁ ਲੈ ਤਤੁ ਵਿਲੋਇ ॥੨॥
636.e: If I join them, O Beloved, I can churn the essence and so find joy. ||2||

636.g: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਸਾਚ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
636.e: The gateway to honor is Truth, O Beloved; it bears the Insignia of the True Name of the Lord.

636.g: ਆਇਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
636.e: We come into the world, and we depart, with our destiny written and pre-ordained, O Beloved; realize the Command of the Commander.

636.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਹੁਕਮੁ, ਨ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
636.e: Without the Guru, this Command is not understood, O Beloved; True is the Power of the True Lord. ||3||

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਿੰਮਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਹੁਕਮੈ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
636.e: By His Command, we are conceived, O Beloved, and by His Command, we grow in the womb.

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਊਧਉ ਸਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
636.e: By His Command, we are born, O Beloved, head-first, and upside-down.

636.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਚਲੈ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
636.e: The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the Lord, O Beloved; he departs after resolving his affairs. ||4||

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ. ਆਇਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਦੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
636.e: By His Command, one comes into the world, O Beloved, and by His Will, he goes.

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬੰਨੑਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
636.e: By His Will, some are bound and gagged and driven away, O Beloved; the self-willed manmukhs suffer their punishment.

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
636.e: By His Command, the Word of the Shabad, is realized, O Beloved, and one goes to the Court of the Lord robed in honor. ||5||

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
636.e: By His Command, some accounts are accounted for, O Beloved; by His Command, some suffer in egotism and duality.

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਭਵੈ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਇ ॥
636.e: By His Command, one wanders in reincarnation, O Beloved; deceived by sins and demerits, he cries out in his suffering.

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
636.e: If he comes to realize the Command of the Lord's Will, O Beloved, then he is blessed with Truth and Honor. ||6||

636.g: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਕਿਉ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
636.e: It is so difficult to speak it, O Beloved; how can we speak, and hear, the True Name?

636.g: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਹਉ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
636.e: I am a sacrifice to those who praise the Lord, O Beloved.

636.g: ਨਾਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੭॥
636.e: I have obtained the Name, and I am satisfied, O Beloved; by His Grace, I am united in His Union. ||7||

636.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਗਦੁ. ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਮਨੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
636.e: If my body were to become the paper, O Beloved, and my mind the inkpot;

636.g: ਲਲਤਾ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਲਿਖਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
636.e: and if my tongue became the pen, O Beloved, I would write, and contemplate, the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

636.g: ਧਨੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਸਾਚੁ ਲਿਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੩॥
636.e: Blessed is that scribe, O Nanak, who writes the True Name, and enshrines it within his heart. ||8||3||

636.g: ਅਥ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਵਤਾਰ ਦਤ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
ਤੋਮਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
636.e: TOMAR STANZA

636.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਰਖ ਬੀਤ ਕਿਨੋ ਬਿਵਾਹਿ ॥
ਇਕ ਭਯੋ ਆਨਿ ਅਉਰੈ ਉਛਾਹਿ ॥
ਤਿਹ ਗਏ ਧਾਮਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ॥
ਕਿਨੀ ਸੁ ਸੇਵ ਤ੍ਰੀਯ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨੨॥
636.e: Several years passed after marriage and once an opportunity arose when Brahma and other gods went to the home of that sage the women of the hermitage of the sage performed great service to them.22.

636.g: ਬਹੁ ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਅਰੁ ਅਰਘ ਦਾਨ ॥
ਪਾਦਰਘਿ ਆਦਿ ਕਿਨੇ ਸੁਜਾਨ ॥
636.e: The incense was burnt, the lamps were lighted, there were libations and salutations

636.g: ਅਵਿਲੋਕਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਿਹ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਾਕ ॥
ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਬੈਠੇ ਪਿਨਾਕ ॥੨੩॥
636.e: Seeing Indra, Vishnu and Shiva, all the devotees eulogized them.23.

636.g: ਅਵਿਲੋਕਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਏ ਰਿਖ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
ਜੋ ਤਿਹੂ ਮਧਿ ਲੋਕਾਨਿ ਧਨਿ ॥
636.e: Seeing the devotion of the sage, all were pleased and all blessed him

636.g: ਕਿਨੋ ਸੁ ਐਸ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਉਚਾਰ ॥
ਤੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਵੰਤ ਹੂਜੋ ਕੁਮਾਰਿ ॥੨੪॥
636.e: Then Brahma said, “O Kumar! You will be blessed with a son.”24.

636.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ. ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ; ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੇਖੁ ॥੭॥
636.e: One who implants the Naam within himself, through the Guru's halter - O Siblings of Destiny, the Lord dwells in his mind, and he is free of hypocrisy. ||7||

636.g: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਾਟੁ ਸਰਾਫ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ; ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
636.e: This body is the jeweller's shop, O Siblings of Destiny; the incomparable Naam is the merchandise.

636.g: ਇਹੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਸੋ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
636.e: The merchant secures this merchandise, O Siblings of Destiny, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

636.g: ਧਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਾਈ; ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
636.e: Blessed is the merchant, O Nanak, who meets the Guru, and engages in this trade. ||8||2||

637.e: MOHAN STANZA
Hearing these words that doe-eyed and extremely beautiful lady (felt agitated).28.
Her mind, which was immaculate, was filled with extreme rage alongwith other women of the sages.29.
The wife of the sage plucked her hair at that place and her comely limbs were filled with extreme ire.30.
Breaking her necklaces, she plucked her hair and began to put dust hr head.31.

637.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਭਾਈ; ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
637.e: The poisonous Maya has enticed the consciousness, O Siblings of Destiny; through clever tricks, one loses his honor.

637.g: ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ; ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਮੋਇ ॥੨॥
637.e: The True Lord and Master abides in the consciousness, O Siblings of Destiny, if the Guru's spiritual wisdom permeates it. ||2||

637.g: ਰੂੜੌ ਰੂੜੌ ਆਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਰੂੜੌ ਲਾਲ ਚਲੂਲੁ ॥
637.e: Beautiful, beautiful, the Lord is called, O Siblings of Destiny; beautiful, like the deep crimson color of the poppy.

637.g: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਭੂਲੁ ॥੩॥
637.e: If man loves the Lord with detachment, O Siblings of Destiny, he is judged to be true and infallible in the Lord's court and home. ||3||

637.g: ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਤੂ ਭਾਈ; ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
637.e: You are pervading the realms of the underworld and the heavenly skies; Your wisdom and glories are in each and every heart.

637.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ; ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
637.e: Meeting with the Guru, one finds peace, O Siblings of Destiny, and pride is dispelled from the mind. ||4||

637.g: ਜਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਭੀ ਮੈਲਾ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
637.e: Scrubbing with water, the body can be cleaned, O Siblings of Destiny, but the body becomes dirty again.

637.g: ਗਿਆਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸਿ ਨਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
637.e: Bathing in the supreme essence of spiritual wisdom, O Siblings of Destiny, the mind and body become pure. ||5||

637.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ. ਕਿਆ ਦੇਹਿ ॥
637.e: Why worship gods and goddesses, O Siblings of Destiny? What can we ask of them? What can they give us?

637.g: ਪਾਹਣੁ ਨੀਰਿ ਪਖਾਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਬੂਡਹਿ ਤੇਹਿ ॥੬॥
637.e: The stone gods are washed with water, O Siblings of Destiny, but they just sink in the water. ||6||

637.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਜਗੁ ਬੂਡੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
637.e: Without the Guru, the unseen Lord cannot be seen, O Siblings of Destiny; the world is drowning, having lost its honor.

637.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਭਾਈ; ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੭॥
637.e: Greatness is in the hands of my Lord and Master, O Siblings of Destiny; as He is pleased, He gives. ||7||

637.g: ਬਈਅਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ. ਮੀਠੁਲੀ ਭਾਈ; ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ. ਪਿਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
637.e: That soul-bride, who talks sweetly and speaks the Truth, O Siblings of Destiny, becomes pleasing to her Husband Lord.

637.g: ਬਿਰਹੈ ਬੇਧੀ. ਸਚਿ ਵਸੀ ਭਾਈ; ਅਧਿਕ ਰਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੮॥
637.e: Pierced by His Love, she abides in Truth, O Siblings of Destiny, deeply imbued with the Lord's Name. ||8||

637.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਬੁਝੈ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
637.e: Everyone calls God his own, O Siblings of Destiny, but the all-knowing Lord is known only through the Guru.

637.g: ਜੋ ਬੀਧੇ ਸੇ ਊਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ; ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੯॥
637.e: Those who are pierced by His Love are saved, O Siblings of Destiny; they bear the Insignia of the True Word of the Shabad. ||9||

637.g: ਈਧਨੁ. ਅਧਿਕ ਸਕੇਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਪਾਵਕੁ ਰੰਚਕ ਪਾਇ ॥
637.e: A large pile of firewood, O Siblings of Destiny, will burn if a small fire is applied.

637.g: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ. ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਿਲਣੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੪॥
637.e: In the same way, if the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells in the heart for a moment, even for an instant, O Siblings of Destiny, then one meets the Lord with ease, O Nanak. ||10||4||
Sorat'h, Third Mehl, First House, Thi-Thukay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

637.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਰਖਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਧੁਰਿ. ਤੂ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
637.e: You always preserve the honor of Your devotees, O Dear Lord; You have protected them from the very beginning of time.

637.g: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਜਨ. ਤੁਧੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥
637.e: You protected Your servant Prahlaad, O Dear Lord, and annihilated Harnaakhash.

637.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
637.e: The Gurmukhs place their faith in the Dear Lord, but the self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt. ||1||
O Dear Lord, this is Your Glory.

637.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ. ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
637.e: You preserve the honor of Your devotees, O Lord Master; Your devotees seek Your Sanctuary. ||Pause||

637.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ. ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕੈ; ਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਨੇੜੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
637.e: The Messenger of Death cannot touch Your devotees; death cannot even approach them.

637.g: ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
637.e: The Name of the Lord alone abides in their minds; through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they find liberation.

637.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਭ ਭਗਤਾ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੀ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
637.e: Wealth and all the spiritual powers of the Siddhis fall at the feet of the Lord's devotees; they obtain peace and poise from the Guru. ||2||

637.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵੀ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
637.e: The self-willed manmukhs have no faith; they are filled with greed and self-interest.

637.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਬਦੁ. ਨ ਭੇਦਿਓ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ. ਨ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
637.e: They are not Gurmukh - they do not understand the Word of the Shabad in their hearts; they do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

637.g: ਕੂੜ ਕਪਟ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਸੀ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫੀਕਾ ਅਲਾਉ ॥੩॥
637.e: Their masks of falsehood and hypocrisy shall fall off; the self-willed manmukhs speak with insipid words. ||3||

637.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ; ਭਗਤੀ ਹੂ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
637.e: You are pervading through Your devotees, O Dear God; through Your devotees, You are known.

637.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸਭ ਲੋਕ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ; ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
637.e: All the people are enticed by Maya; they are Yours, Lord - You alone are the Architect of Destiny.
TOMAR STANZA
Seeing the wife of the sage in anger, getting fearful and forsaking his pride, and taking Shiva and other sages with him, Brahma fled.32.
Then the wife of the sage, uprooting one of the matted lock of ther head in anger, strumck it on her hand, at that time Dattatreya was born.33.
Considering Ansuya as his mother and keeping her on his right, he circumambulated around her and then saluted her
In this way, thinking about the experience of sexual pleasure, Dutt Kumar was born.34.
His body was charming and he was reciting seven Smrities
The great Dutt was reciting all the four Vedas.35.
TOMAR STANZA
When Brahma said this that the save would be blessed with a son, then listening to it, her eyes showed signs of anxiety.25.
The body of that young lady became agitated and the tears flowed form her eyes
She was filled with anxiety on hearing these words and she felt that the day had changed into night.26.
Her body was agitated with anxiety and she getting enraged, became impatient, lips and eyes quivered and she lamented.27.

638.e: Sorat'h, Third Mehl, Dho-Thukay:

638.g: ਨਿਗੁਣਿਆ ਨੋ. ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਭਾਈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇ ॥
638.e: He Himself forgives the worthless, O Siblings of Destiny; He commits them to the service of the True Guru.

638.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਊਤਮ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
638.e: Service to the True Guru is sublime, O Siblings of Destiny; through it, one's consciousness is attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||
The Dear Lord forgives, and unites with Himself.

638.g: ਗੁਣਹੀਣ ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਭਾਈ; ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਲਏ ਰਲਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
638.e: I am a sinner, totally without virtue, O Siblings of Destiny; the Perfect True Guru has blended me. ||Pause||

638.g: ਕਉਣ ਕਉਣ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਬਖਸਿਅਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
638.e: So many, so many sinners have been forgiven, O beloved one, by contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

638.g: ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਭਾਈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੇੜੈ ਚਾੜਿ ॥੨॥
638.e: They got on board the boat of the True Guru, who carried them across the terrifying world-ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||2||

638.g: ਮਨੂਰੈ ਤੇ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
638.e: I have been transformed from rusty iron into gold, O Siblings of Destiny, united in Union with the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.

638.g: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ. ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਭਾਈ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
638.e: Eliminating my self-conceit, the Name has come to dwell within my mind, O Siblings of Destiny; my light has merged in the Light. ||3||

638.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ. ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਭਾਈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
638.e: I am a sacrifice, I am a sacrifice, O Siblings of Destiny, I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru.

638.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੪॥
638.e: He has given me the treasure of the Naam; O Siblings of Destiny, through the Guru's Teachings, I am absorbed in celestial bliss. ||4||

638.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ; ਪੂਛਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
638.e: Without the Guru, celestial peace is not produced, O Siblings of Destiny; go and ask the spiritual teachers about this.

638.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਈ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੫॥
638.e: Serve the True Guru forever, O Siblings of Destiny, and eradicate self-conceit from within. ||5||

638.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ; ਭਉ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
638.e: Under Guru's Instruction, the Fear of God is produced, O Siblings of Destiny; true and excellent are the deeds done in the Fear of God.

638.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
638.e: Then, one is blessed with the treasure of the Lord's Love, O Siblings of Destiny, and the Support of the True Name. ||6||

638.g: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ; ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
638.e: I fall at the feet of those who serve their True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny.

638.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ; ਕੁਲੁ ਭੀ ਲਈ ਬਖਸਾਇ ॥੭॥
638.e: I have fulfilled my life, O Siblings of Destiny, and my family has been saved as well. ||7||

638.g: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
638.e: The True Word of the Guru's Bani, and the True Word of the Shabad, O Siblings of Destiny, are obtained only by Guru's Grace.

638.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
638.e: O Nanak, with the Name of the Lord abiding in one's mind, no obstacles stand in one's way, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||2||

638.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੪॥
638.e: Overcoming my egotism and quieting the desires within my mind, I have come to realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

638.g: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
638.e: God automatically does the work of those who love the Name of the Lord.

638.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
638.e: By Guru's Grace, he ever dwells in their minds, and He resolves all their affairs.

638.g: ਓਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ. ਸੁ ਵਿਗੁਚੈ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥੫॥
638.e: Whoever challenges them is destroyed; they have the Lord God as their Savior. ||5||

638.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਕਿਨੈ, ਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਈ ॥
638.e: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds the Lord; the self-willed manmukhs die crying out in pain.

638.g: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਠਉਰ. ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
638.e: They come and go, and find no place of rest; in pain and suffering, they perish.

638.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੬॥
638.e: But one who becomes Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, and is easily absorbed in the True Name. ||6||

638.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ; ਜੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
638.e: Without serving the True Guru, one cannot escape reincarnation, even by performing numerous rituals.

638.g: ਵੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਤੈ ਵਾਦ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ. ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
638.e: Those who read the Vedas, and argue and debate without the Lord, lose their honor.

638.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ; ਭਜਿ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੭॥
638.e: True is the True Guru, and True is the Word of His Bani; in the Guru's Sanctuary, one is saved. ||7||

638.g: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ. ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ; ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥
638.e: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord are judged as true in the Court of the Lord; they are hailed as true in the True Court.

638.g: ਓਨਾ ਦੀ ਸੋਭਾ. ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਹੋਈ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
638.e: Their praises echo throughout the ages, and no one can erase them.

638.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
638.e: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who enshrine the Lord within their hearts. ||8||1||
Shiva, remembering the earlier curse assumed himself the body of Dutt and
Took birth in the home of Ansuya this was his first incarnation.36.
PAADHARI STANZA
The loving Dutt, the store of eighteen sciences was born
He was the knower of Shastras and had a charming figure he was Yogi king of all the ganas.37.
He spread the cults of Sannyas and Yoga and he was totally spotless and servitor of all

638.g: ਜਨ ਧਰਿਓ ਆਨਿ ਬਪੁ ਸਰਬ ਜੋਗ ॥
ਤਜਿ ਰਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਅਰੁ ਤਿਆਗ ਭੋਗ ॥੩੮॥
638.e: He was the apparent manifestation of Yoga, who abandoned the path of royal pleasure.38.
He was greatly praiseworthy, had a charming personality and also the store-house of Grace

638.g: ਰਵਿ ਅਨਿਲ ਤੇਜ ਜਲ ਸੋ ਸੁਭਾਵ ॥

638.e: His disposition was radiant like sun and fire and had cool temperament like water he manifested himself as the king of Yogis in the world.39.
Dutt Dev was superior to all in Sannyas Ashrama (monastic order) and was becoming incarnation of Rudra
His radiance was like fire and power of Rudra his radiance was like fire and power endurance like earth.40.
Dutt was a person of purity, indestructible splendour and pure intellect
Even the gold feel shy before him and the waves of the Ganges seemed to surge over his head.41.
He had long arms and charming body and was a detached supreme Yogi
When he applied the ashes to his limbs, he fragranced everyone around him and he brought to light Sannyas and Yoga in the world.42.
The praise of his limbs seemed boundless and he manifested himself as a generous king of the Yogis
The brilliance of his body was infinite and from his great personality, he appeared to be a silence-observing ascetic and eminently glorious.43.
That king of the Yogis spread his infinite greatness and glory and on his manifestation, the fraudulent tendencies trembled and he made them stingless in an instant.44.
Seeing his indestructible greatness and unique body, the mother remained wonder-struck

638.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਰਿਖਿਨ ਤਜਿ ਦੀਨ ਗਰਬ ॥੪੫॥
638.e: All the people in counties far and near also marveled to see him and all of them abandoned their pride on listening to his greatness.45.

638.g: ਚਲ ਚਾਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁ ਬਾਸ ॥
638.e: The whole nether-world and sky had the feeling about his comeliness which made all the creatures full of joy
Because of him, the whole earth became blissful.46.

638.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਰਿਖੀਨ ਤਜਿ ਦੀਨ ਗਰਬ ॥
638.e: The sky and the earth all quivered and the sages here and there abandoned their pride

638.g: ਦਸ ਦਿਉਸ ਪਾਇ ਦਿਖੀ ਨ ਰੈਣ ॥੪੭॥
638.e: On his manifestation, many instruments (musical) were played in the sky and for ten days, the presence o f night was not felt.47.

639.e: Sorat'h, Third Mehl:

639.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੇ ਜਾਪਦਾ ਭਾਈ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
639.e: The Dear Lord is realized through the Word of His Shabad, O Siblings of Destiny, which is found only by perfect destiny.

639.g: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭਾਈ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਤੀਆ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
639.e: The happy soul-brides are forever in peace, O Siblings of Destiny; night and day, they are attuned to the Lord's Love. ||1||

639.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ; ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਇ ॥
639.e: O Dear Lord, You Yourself color us in Your Love.

639.g: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਿਹੋ ਭਾਈ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
639.e: Sing, continually sing His Praises, imbued with His Love, O Siblings of Destiny; be in love with the Lord. ||Pause||

639.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਭਾਈ; ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
639.e: Work to serve the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; abandon self-conceit, and focus your consciousness.

639.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ. ਨ ਲਗਈ ਭਾਈ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
639.e: You shall be in peace forever, and you shall not suffer in pain any longer, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord Himself shall come and abide in your mind. ||2||

639.g: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਭਾਈ; ਸਾ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ॥
639.e: She who does not know the Will of her Husband Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, is an ill-mannered and bitter bride.

639.g: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਭਾਈ; ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥੩॥
639.e: She does things with a stubborn mind, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Name, she is false. ||3||

639.g: ਸੇ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ; ਭਾਇ ਸਚੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
639.e: They alone sing the Lord's Praises, who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads, O Siblings of Destiny; through the Love of the True Lord, they find detachment.

639.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਭਾਈ; ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੪॥
639.e: Night and day, they are imbued with His Love; they utter His Glorious Praises, O Siblings of Destiny, and they lovingly focus their consciousness on the Fearless Guru. ||4||

639.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਦਾ ਭਾਈ; ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
639.e: He kills and revives all, O Siblings of Destiny; serve Him, day and night.

639.g: ਸੋ. ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੫॥
639.e: How can we forget Him from our minds, O Siblings of Destiny? His gifts are glorious and great. ||5||

639.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੈਲੀ ਡੁੰਮਣੀ ਭਾਈ; ਦਰਗਹ. ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
639.e: The self-willed manmukh is filthy and double-minded, O Siblings of Destiny; the finds no place of rest in the Court of the Lord.

639.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਭਾਈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੬॥
639.e: But if she becomes Gurmukh, then she chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; the meets her True Beloved, and merges in Him. ||6||

639.g: ਏਤੁ ਜਨਮਿ ਹਰਿ. ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਭਾਈ; ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
639.e: In this life, she has not focused her consciousness on the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny; how can she show her face when she leaves?

639.g: ਕਿੜੀ ਪਵੰਦੀ ਮੁਹਾਇਓਨੁ ਭਾਈ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਨੋ ਲੋਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
639.e: In spite of the warning calls which were sounded, she has been plundered, O Siblings of Destiny; she yearned only for corruption. ||7||

639.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਭਾਈ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
639.e: Those who dwell upon the Naam, O Siblings of Destiny, their bodies are ever peaceful and tranquil.

639.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਭਾਈ; ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੮॥੩॥
639.e: O Nanak, dwell upon the Naam; the Lord is infinite, virtuous and unfathomable, O Siblings of Destiny. ||8||3||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

639.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ; ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥
639.e: The One who created the whole world, O Siblings of Destiny, is the Almighty Lord, the Cause of causes.

639.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਭਾਈ; ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਵਥੁ ॥
639.e: He fashioned the soul and the body, O Siblings of Destiny, by His own power.

639.g: ਕਿਨਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਕਰਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਅਕਥੁ ॥
639.e: How can He be described? How can He be seen, O Siblings of Destiny? The Creator is One; He is indescribable.

639.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਥੁ ॥੧॥
639.e: Praise the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, O Siblings of Destiny; through Him, the essence is known. ||1||
O my mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord God.

639.g: ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ; ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਕਾ ਹੰਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
639.e: He blesses His servant with the gift of the Naam; He is the Destroyer of pain and suffering. ||Pause||

639.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ; ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
639.e: Everything is in His home, O Siblings of Destiny; His warehouse is overflowing with the nine treasures.

639.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਭਾਈ; ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
639.e: His worth cannot be estimated, O Siblings of Destiny; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

639.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਭਾਈ; ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
639.e: He cherishes all beings and creatures, O Siblings of Destiny; he continually takes care of them.

639.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
639.e: So meet with the Perfect True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, and merge in the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

639.g: ਸਚੇ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵੀਅਹਿ ਭਾਈ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਸੁ ॥
639.e: Adoring the feet of the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny, doubt and fear are dispelled.

639.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਂਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
639.e: Joining the Society of the Saints, cleanse your mind, O Siblings of Destiny, and dwell in the Name of the Lord.

639.g: ਮਿਟੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਅਗਿਆਨਤਾ ਭਾਈ; ਕਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
639.e: The darkness of ignorance shall be dispelled, O Siblings of Destiny, and the lotus of your heart shall blossom forth.

639.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ; ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
639.e: By the Guru's Word, peace wells up, O Siblings of Destiny; all fruits are with the True Guru. ||3||
Many musical instruments were played here and there and it appeared that the discriminating intellect had assumed a body itself
His glory is indescribable and he manifested himself as the king of ‘Sannyas’.48.
Even on taking birth, he absorbed himself in actions of Yogs
And he, destroying sins, propagated Dharma the great Sovereign fell at his feet and getting up, they practiced Sannyas and Yoga.49.

639.g: ਉਠਿ ਲਗੇ ਪਾਇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸਰਬ ਆਇ ॥
639.e: Seeing the unique king Dutt, all the king bowed respectfully at his feet
Seeing the greatness of Dutt, it appeared that he was the store of eighteen sciences.50.

639.g: ਨਖ ਨੇਮ ਕੇ ਸੁ ਬਢਏ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
639.e: On his head, there were the matted locks of his celibacy and on his hands grew the nails of observances

639.g: ਦਿਜ ਚਰਜ ਤੁਲਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਚਰਮ ਅਰੋਹ ॥੫੧॥
639.e: The white ashes on his body were indicative of his state devoid of illusions his character like Brahm (Brahman) was his deer skin.51.
Having white ashes on his face and wearing loin-cloth, he was the possessor of Sannyas and conduct and relinquisher of deceit
He remained absorbed in abstract meditation and his limbs were extremely charming his radiance was indestructible.52.

639.g: ਇਕ ਆਸ ਚਿਤ ਤਜਿ ਸਰਬ ਆਸ ॥

639.e: In his mind there was only one desire of Sannyas and Yoga and for this desire he had abandoned all other desires

639.g: ਮੁਨਿ ਚਰਜ ਲੀਨ ਤਜਿ ਸਰਬ ਕਾਮ ॥

639.e: His body was unique and during day and night, he remained detached from the deceits of the world leaving the desires of all kinds, he had adopted the character of sages his eyes were red and were the store of Dharma.53.
He had a pure mind, devoid of vices, and he meditated with his non-mercurial eyes
His praise was infinite having only one desire in his mind of adopting Sannyas from all sides he was the greatest among the immaculate Sannyasis.54.
He had a body of Yogis, whose greatness was infinite and he was the store of the knowledge of Shrutis (Vedas) and extremely generous

639.g: ਮੁਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਗੁਨਿ ਗਨ ਮਹਾਨ ॥

639.e: Amongst the sages, he was most skilful and great and was supremely learned.55.

639.g: ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਪਾਪ ਜਿਹ ਛੁਹਾ ਅੰਗ ॥

639.e: The sin had not even touched him and he was elegant in virtues
The Yogi Dutt wore loin-cloth and seeing him, mother was wonder-struck.56.
Seeing the greatest Sannyasi Dutt, having comely limbs, even the god of love felt shy
The sage Dutt was the king of Sannyasis and he had practiced all kinds of the activities of Sannyas.57.
His body was immaculate, which had never been troubled by lust
On his head there was a tuft of matted locks such a form was adopted by Dutt, the incarnation of Rudra.58.
Who can describe his fine glory ? And listening to his appreciation, the Yakshas and Gandharvas become silent
Brahma was also wonder-struck to see his glory and even the god of love felt shy on seeing his beauty.59.

640.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਹੋਈਐ ਸਭ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
640.e: Give up your sense of mine and yours, O Siblings of Destiny, and become the dust of the feet of all.

640.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ; ਪੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
640.e: In each and every heart, God is contained, O Siblings of Destiny; He sees, and hears, and is ever-present with us.

640.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਭਾਈ; ਤਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਮਰੀਐ ਝੂਰਿ ॥
640.e: On that day when one forgets the Supreme Lord God, O Siblings of Destiny, on that day, one ought to die crying out in pain.

640.g: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਮਰਥੋ ਭਾਈ; ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੪॥
640.e: He is the all-powerful Cause of Causes, O Siblings of Destiny; he is totally filled with all powers. ||4||

640.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ. ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
640.e: The Love of the Name is the greatest treasure, O Siblings of Destiny; through it, emotional attachment to Maya is dispelled.

640.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਭਾਈ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
640.e: If it is pleasing to His Will, then He unites us in His Union, O Siblings of Destiny; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in the mind.

640.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਰਿਦੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
640.e: The heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth, O Siblings of Destiny, and the heart is illumined.

640.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ; ਮਉਲਿਆ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
640.e: The Glory of God has been revealed, O Siblings of Destiny, and the earth and sky have blossomed forth. ||5||

640.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ. ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਭਾਈ; ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
640.e: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with contentment, O Siblings of Destiny; day and night, I remain attached to the Lord's Love.

640.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਭਾਈ; ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
640.e: My tongue continually chants the Lord's Name, O Siblings of Destiny; this is the true taste, and the object of human life.

640.g: ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਭਾਈ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਥਾਉ ॥
640.e: Listening with my ears, I hear and so I live, O Siblings of Destiny; I have obtained the unchanging, unmoving state.

640.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵਈ ਭਾਈ; ਸੋ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੬॥
640.e: That soul,which does not place its faith in the Lord shall burn, O Siblings of Destiny. ||6||

640.g: ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬੈ ਭਾਈ; ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
640.e: My Lord and Master has so many virtues, O Siblings of Destiny; I am a sacrifice to Him.

640.g: ਓਹੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀਆਰੇ ਪਾਲਦਾ ਭਾਈ; ਦੇਇ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
640.e: He nurtures even the most worthless, O Siblings of Destiny, and gives home to the homeless.

640.g: ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਭਾਈ; ਗੂੜਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
640.e: He gives us nourishment with each and every breath, O Siblings of Destiny; His Name is everlasting.

640.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਭਾਈ; ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਮਾਉ ॥੭॥
