672.e: There he saw two kshatriya fighters absorbed in their actions of war

672.g: ਤਜੰਤਿ ਸਾਇਕੰ ਸਿਤੰ ਕਟੰਤ ਟੂਕ ਬਰਮਣੰ ॥
672.e: The warriors were abandoning their bows and cutting the armours seeing that fighting

672.g: ਥਥੰਭ ਭਾਨਣੋ ਰਥੰ ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਕਉਤਕੰ ਰਣੰ ॥
ਗਿਰੰਤ ਜੁਧਣੋ ਛਿਤੰ ਬਮੰਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਣਤੰ ਮੁਖੰ ॥੪੫੮॥
672.e: The chariot of the sun stopped there and there the fighters falling on the earth, were throwing out blood from their mouths.458.

672.g: ਫਿਰੰਤ ਚਕ੍ਰਣੋ ਚਕੰ ਗਿਰੰਤ ਜੋਧਣੋ ਰਣੰ ॥
672.e: The discs were being discharged and the fighters were falling

672.g: ਉਠੰਤ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੈ ਹਠੀ ਠਠੁਕਿ ਕ੍ਰੁਧਿਤੰ ਭੁਜੰ ॥
672.e: The persistent warriors were again rising in anger

672.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤ ਅਧ ਬਧਤੰ ਕਮਧ ਬਧਤੰ ਕਟੰ ॥
ਪਰੰਤ ਭੂਤਲੰ ਭਟੰ ਬਕੰਤ ਮਾਰੂੜੈ ਰਟੰ ॥੪੫੯॥
672.e: Having been cut into half in the form of headless trunks were wandering and those falling on the earth were shouting “kill, kill”.459.

672.g: ਪਿਪੰਤ ਅਸਵ ਭਟੰਤ ਭਿਰੰਤ ਦਾਰੁਣੋ ਰਣੰ ॥
672.e: The horses of the warriors were fighting in that dreadful war

672.g: ਬਹੰਤ ਤੀਛਣੋ ਸਰੰ ਝਲੰਤ ਝਾਲ ਖੜਿਗਿਣੰ ॥
672.e: The sharp arrows were being seen

672.g: ਉਠੰਤ ਮਾਰੂੜੋ ਰਣੰ ਬਕੰਤ ਮਾਰਣੋ ਮੁਖੰ ॥
672.e: The fighters were rising with the shouts of “kill, kill”

672.g: ਚਲੰਤ ਭਾਜਿ ਨ ਹਠੀ ਜੁਝੰਤ ਦੁਧਰੰ ਰਣੰ ॥੪੬੦॥
672.e: And they were not running away from that battlefield with persistence.460.

672.g: ਕਟੰਤ ਕਾਰਮੰ ਸੁਭੰ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਤੰ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ ॥
ਸਿਲੇਣਿ ਉਜਲੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ ਬਹੰਤ ਸਾਇਕੰ ਸੁਭੰ ॥
672.e: All were cutting one another in a strange way and the white arrows like the slab were flowing (like a stream)

672.g: ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਮੋਨਿਸੰ ਜੁਧੰ ਚਚਉਧ ਚਕ੍ਰਤੰ ਭਵੰ ॥
ਮਮੋਹ ਆਸ੍ਰਮੰ ਗਤੰ ਪਪਾਤ ਭੂਤਲੀ ਸਿਰੰ ॥੪੬੧॥
672.e: Seeing that war the whole world was dazzled and wonder-struck and moving towards that hermitage, it was falling down upon the earth under the impact of attachment.461.

672.g: ਸਭਾਰ ਭਾਰਗ ਬਸਨਿਨੰ ਜਜਪਿ ਜਾਪਣੋ ਰਿਖੰ ॥
ਨਿਹਾਰਿ ਪਾਨ ਪੈ ਪਰਾ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਬਾਇਸਵੋ ਗੁਰੰ ॥
672.e: That woman, carrying her utensils on her head, was moving remembering her husband like a sage and the sag seeing her and falling at her feet adopted her as the twenty-second Guru

672.g: ਬਿਅੰਤ ਜੋਗਣੋ ਸਧੰ ਅਸੰਖ ਪਾਪਣੋ ਦਲੰ ॥
ਅਨੇਕ ਚੇਲਕਾ ਲਏ ਰਿਖੇਸ ਆਸਨੰ ਚਲੰ ॥੪੬੨॥
672.e: That great sage, who had performed innumerable Yogic practices and destroying many sins, moved towards his abode.462.

672.g: ਇਤਿ ਹਰ ਬਾਹਤਾ ਬਾਈਸਵੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਭਾਤ ਲੈ ਆਈ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੨੨॥
672.e: End of the description of the adoption of the Ploughman as the Twenty-second Guru, and his wife bringing the food.

672.g: ਅਥ ਤ੍ਰਿਆ ਜਛਣੀ ਤੇਈਸਮੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
672.e: Now begins the description of adopting a Yaksha woman as the twenty-third Guru

672.g: ਅਨੂਪ ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
672.e: ANOOP NARAAJ STANZA

672.g: ਬਜੰਤ ਨਾਦ ਦੁਧਰੰ ਉਠੰਤ ਨਿਸਨੰ ਸੁਰੰ ॥
ਭਜੰਤ ਅਰਿ ਦਿਤੰ ਅਘੰ ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਭਾਰਗਵੰ ਭਿਸੰ ॥
672.e: The trumpets sounded and there was thundering voice seeing the ochre-coloured garb the sins were destroyed

672.g: ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਕੰਚਨੰ ਗਿਰੰਤ ਤਜ ਮਾਨੁਖੀ ਭੁਅੰ ॥
ਸ ਸੁਹਕ ਤਾਪਸੀ ਤਨੰ ਅਲੋਕ ਲੋਕਣੋ ਬਪੰ ॥੪੬੩॥
672.e: The gold was seen being showered on the earth inhabitated by human beings and the bodies of the ascetic were supernatural glory.463.

672.g: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਛ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬੰ ਬਸੇਖ ਬਿਧਿਕਾ ਧਰੀ ॥
ਨਿਰਕਤ ਨਾਗਣੀ ਮਹਾ ਬਸੇਖ ਬਾਸਵੀ ਸੁਰੀ ॥
672.e: Many Yaksha, Gandharava, Naga and god’s women were dancing

672.g: ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਾਰਬਤੀ ਅਨੂਪ ਆਲਕਾਪਤੀ ॥
ਅਸਕਤ ਆਪਿਤੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਆਸੁਰੀ ਸੁਰੀ ॥੪੬੪॥
672.e: There was Parvati and the wife of the unique Kuber there were seated the women off gods and demons.464.

672.g: ਅਨੂਪ ਏਕ ਜਛਣੀ ਮਮੋਹ ਰਾਗਣੋ ਮਨੰ ॥
ਘੁਮੰਤ ਘੂਮਣੰ ਛਿਤੰ ਲਗੰਤ ਸਾਰੰਗੋ ਸਰੰ ॥
672.e: There was there a unique Yakssha woman, who was revolving in a circle as if she was struck by an arrow

672.g: ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਨੇਹ ਗੇਹਣੰ ਸਨੇਹ ਰਾਗਣੋ ਮਨੰ ॥
ਮ੍ਰਿਗੀਸ ਜਾਣੁ ਘੁਮਤੰ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੇਣ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਸਰੰ ॥੪੬੫॥
672.e: Abandoning all kinds of desires, her mind was absorbed only in music she was moving agitated like a deer.465.

672.g: ਰਝੀਝ ਰਾਗਣੋ ਚਿਤੰ ਬਦੰਤ ਰਾਗ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਭੰ ॥
ਬਜੰਤ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਕਰੰ ਮਮੋਹ ਆਸ੍ਰਮੰ ਗਤੰ ॥
672.e: She was absorbed in singing in various male and female musical modes and playing on her fiddle, she went lovingly towards the hermitage

672.g: ਸਸਜਿ ਸਾਇਕੰ ਸਿਤੰ ਕਪੰਤ ਕਾਮਣੋ ਕਲੰ ॥
ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤ ਭੂਤਲੰ ਭਲੰ ਭੁਗੰਤ ਭਾਮਿਣੀ ਦਲੰ ॥੪੬੬॥
672.e: That beautiful damsel was decorated with the arrows of her art and the group of those beautiful women was enjoying the earthly existence.466.

672.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
672.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

672.g: ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਰਾਜਨ ਅਰੁ ਭੂਮਨ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ. ਨ ਬੂਝੀ ॥
672.e: The desires of the greatest of the great kings and landlords cannot be satisfied.

672.g: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਤੇ; ਲੋਚਨ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੀ ॥੧॥
672.e: They remain engrossed in Maya, intoxicated with the pleasures of their wealth; their eyes see nothing else at all. ||1||

672.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ; ਕਿਨ ਹੀ. ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
672.e: No one has ever found satisfaction in sin and corruption.

672.g: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕੁ. ਈਧਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ. ਕਹਾ ਅਘਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
672.e: The flame is not satisfied by more fuel; how can one be satisfied without the Lord? ||Pause||

672.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਤ ਭੋਜਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ; ਤਾ ਕੀ. ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਭੂਖਾ ॥
672.e: Day after day, he eats his meals with many different foods, but his hunger is not eradicated.

672.g: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਆਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ; ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਟਾ ਘੋਖਾ ॥੨॥
672.e: He runs around like a dog, searching in the four directions. ||2||

672.g: ਕਾਮਵੰਤ ਕਾਮੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ; ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਹ. ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ॥
672.e: The lustful, lecherous man desires many women, and he never stops peeking into the homes of others.

672.g: ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ. ਕਰੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਪੈ; ਸੋਗ ਲੋਭ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਕੈ ॥੩॥
672.e: Day after day, he commits adultery again and again, and then he regrets his actions; he wastes away in misery and greed. ||3||

672.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਮੋਲਾ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
672.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is incomparable and priceless; it is the treasure of Ambrosial Nectar.

672.g: ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
672.e: The Saints abide in peace, poise and bliss; O Nanak, through the Guru, this is known. ||4||6||

672.g: ਤੋਮਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
672.e: TOMAR STANZA

672.g: ਗੁਨਵੰਤ ਸੀਲ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
ਦਸ ਚਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਉਦਾਰ ॥
672.e: She was virtuous very gentle and knower of eighteen sciences,

672.g: ਰਸ ਰਾਗ ਸਰਬ ਸਪੰਨਿ ॥
ਧਰਣੀ ਤਲਾ ਮਹਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੪੬੭॥
672.e: Well versed in music and full of essence, She was fortunate enough on earth.467.

672.g: ਇਕ ਰਾਗ ਗਾਵਤ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਸੀਲ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
672.e: A woman, gentle and virtuous, was singing a musical mode

672.g: ਸੁਖ ਧਾਮ ਲੋਚਨ ਚਾਰੁ ॥
ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
672.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

672.g: ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਗਨ. ਕਉ ਹੈ ਕਛੂਐ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
672.e: Nothing which this mortal being runs after, can compare to it.

672.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ. ਇਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ; ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
672.e: He alone comes to have it, whom the Guru blesses with this Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

672.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਇਓ ਏਕੁ ਰਸਾ ॥
672.e: The desire to eat, to wear new clothes, and all other desires,

672.g: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਖੁਧਿਆ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਚਿਤਿ. ਨ ਬਸਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
672.e: Do not abide in the mind of one who comes to know the subtle essence of the One Lord. ||Pause||

672.g: ਮਉਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਹਰਿਆ; ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
672.e: The mind and body blossom forth in abundance, when one receives even a drop of this Nectar.

672.g: ਬਰਨਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕਉ, ਉਸਤਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ; ਕੀਮਤਿ. ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
672.e: I cannot express His glory; I cannot describe His worth. ||2||

672.g: ਘਾਲ. ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ, ਸੇਵ. ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ; ਮਿਲਿਓ ਆਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
672.e: We cannot meet the Lord by our own efforts, nor can we meet Him through service; He comes and meets us spontaneously.

672.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ; ਤਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਮੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
672.e: One who is blessed by my Lord Master's Grace, practices the Teachings of the Guru's Mantra. ||3||

672.g: ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ; ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
672.e: He is merciful to the meek, always kind and compassionate; He cherishes and nurtures all beings.

672.g: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਵਿਆ; ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਲ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
672.e: The Lord is mingled with Nanak, through and through; He cherishes him, like the mother her child. ||4||7||

672.g: ਅਲੰਕਾਰ ਮਿਲਿ. ਥੈਲੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
672.e: When golden ornaments are melted down into a lump, they are still said to be gold. ||3||

672.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਜੋਤਿ. ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਸੋਭਾ; ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
672.e: The Divine Light has illuminated me, and I am filled with celestial peace and glory; the unstruck melody of the Lord's Bani resounds within me.

672.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਿਹਚਲ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਕੀਓ ਬੰਧਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
672.e: Says Nanak, I have built my eternal home; the Guru has constructed it for me. ||4||5||

672.g: ਮੁਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਏ ਰਿਖ ਸੈਨਾ ॥
ਮੁਖ ਛਬਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਲਜਤ ਜਿਹ ਮੈਨਾ ॥
672.e: The king of sages was moving alongwith a large gathering of sages and seeing the beauty of his face, even the god of love was feeling shy

672.g: ਤੀਰ ਤੀਰ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਲਿ ਗਏ ॥
ਮੁਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਬੈਠ ਰਹਤ ਪਛ ਭਏ ॥੪੫੩॥
672.e: The sages passed near him and the king of sages also sat there.453.

672.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
672.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

672.g: ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ. ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਊਪਰਿ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਯਾ ॥
672.e: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has implanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within me.

672.g: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ; ਜਿਨਿ ਸੀਧਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਯਾ ॥੧॥
672.e: In the utter darkness of the wilderness, He showed me the straight path. ||1||

672.g: ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ; ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
672.e: The Lord of the universe, the Cherisher of the world, He is my breath of life.

672.g: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਕੀ; ਜਿਸਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
672.e: Here and hereafter, he takes care of everything for me. ||1||Pause||

672.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ. ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ; ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
672.e: Meditating on Him in remembrance, I have found all treasures, respect, greatness and perfect honor.

672.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ. ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਨਾਸੇ; ਭਗਤ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧੂਰੀ ॥੨॥
672.e: Remembering His Name, millions of sins are erased; all His devotees long for the dust of His feet. ||2||

672.g: ਸਰਬ ਮਨੋਰਥ. ਜੇ ਕੋ ਚਾਹੈ; ਸੇਵੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
672.e: If someone wishes for the fulfillment of all his hopes and desires, he should serve the one supreme treasure.

672.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
672.e: He is the Supreme Lord God, infinite Lord and Master; meditating on Him in remembrance, one is carried across. ||3||

672.g: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਓਲੑਾ ॥
672.e: I have found total peace and tranquility in the Society of the Saints; my honor has been preserved.

672.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ; ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਨੋ ਚੋਲੑਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
672.e: To gather in the Lord's wealth, and to taste the food of the Lord's Name - Nanak has made this his feast. ||4||8||

673.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

673.g: ਜਿਹ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸਰਮਿੰਦਾ; ਇਹਾ ਕਮਾਨੀ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
673.e: You have made it your habit to practice those deeds which will bring you shame.

673.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ. ਸਾਕਤ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ; ਐਸੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑੀ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
673.e: You slander the Saints, and you worship the faithless cynics; such are the corrupt ways you have adopted. ||1||
Deluded by your emotional attachment to Maya, you love other things,

673.g: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਬਨ ਹਰ ਪਾਤ ਰੇ; ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਬੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
673.e: like the enchanted city of Hari-chandauree, or the green leaves of the forest - such is your way of life. ||1||Pause||

673.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪ ਹੋਤ ਦੇਹ ਕਉ; ਸੁਖੁ ਗਰਧਭ ਭਸਮ ਸੰਗੀਤਿ ॥
673.e: Its body may be anointed with sandalwood oil, but the donkey still loves to roll in the mud.

673.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨਾਹਿ ਰੁਚ ਆਵਤ; ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
673.e: He is not fond of the Ambrosial Nectar; instead, he loves the poisonous drug of corruption. ||2||

673.g: ਉਤਮ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ; ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਵਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
673.e: The Saints are noble and sublime; they are blessed with good fortune. They alone are pure and holy in this world.

673.g: ਜਾਤ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥ; ਕਾਚ ਬਾਦਰੈ ਜੀਤ ॥੩॥
673.e: The jewel of this human life is passing away uselessly, lost in exchange for mere glass. ||3||

673.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੇ; ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਦੀਤ ॥
673.e: The sins and sorrows of uncounted incarnations run away, when the Guru applies the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom to the eyes.

673.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਇਨ ਦੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ; ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਪਰੀਤ ॥੪॥੯॥
673.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have escaped from these troubles; Nanak loves the One Lord. ||4||9||
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

673.g: ਤੁਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ; ਨਾਇਕ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
673.e: You are the Giver, O Lord, O Cherisher, my Master, my Husband Lord.
(Now begins the description of the adoption of the Twenty-fourth Guru [carnation])
TOMAR STANZA
Then ascending the Sumeru mountain the sage performed great austerities for many years and felt pleased as the essence-finder.474.
Seeing the practice of the world, the sage thought as to who is He, who creates the world and then merges it within Himself?475.
When He is recognized through the knowledge, then the adoration will be complete
If He is comprehended through the medium off Yoga, only then the body (and the mind) will be completely healthy.476.
Then the supreme essence will be known (when it will be realized) that He is also the destroyer of the world
That master of the world is real and Lord is supremely absorbed and He is also beyond all forms.477.
There will be no peace without that one Lord  the bath at all the pilgrim-stations will be fruitless
When service will be rendered to him and His Name will be remembered, then all the desires will be fulfilled.478.
Without that One Lord, all the twenty-four incarnation and all others are meaningless
He, who recognizes the One Lord, he will remain jubilant even on adoring all the twenty-four incarnations.479.
He, who falls in love with the One Lord, he will feel happy in knowing about the wonderful works of all the twenty-four incarnations
He, who does not recognize the One Lord, he cannot know the mysteries of the twenty-four incarnations.480.
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

673.g: ਪਾਨੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ. ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ; ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈ ॥
673.e: I carry the water, wave the fan, and grind the corn for the Saints; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

673.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ; ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
673.e: With each and every breath, my mind remembers the Naam, the Name of the Lord; in this way, it finds the treasure of peace. ||1||
Have pity on me, O my Lord and Master.

673.g: ਐਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
673.e: Bless me with such understanding, O my Lord and Master, that I may forever and ever meditate on You. ||1||Pause||

673.g: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ. ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ; ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
673.e: By Your Grace, emotional attachment and egotism are eradicated, and doubt is dispelled.

673.g: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਰਵਿਓ ਸਭ ਮਧੇ; ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
673.e: The Lord, the embodiment of bliss, is pervading and permeating in all; wherever I go, there I see Him. ||2||

673.g: ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ; ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਾਵਨ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥
673.e: You are kind and compassionate, the treasure of mercy, the Purifier of sinners, Lord of the world.

673.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਾਜ ਪਾਏ; ਮੁਖ ਤੇ. ਨਿਮਖ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
673.e: I obtain millions of joys, comforts and kingdoms, if You inspire me to chant Your Name with my mouth, even for an instant. ||3||

673.g: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
673.e: That alone is perfect chanting, meditation, penance and devotional worship service, which is pleasing to God's Mind.

673.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ. ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
673.e: Chanting the Naam, all thirst and desire is satisfied; Nanak is satisfied and fulfilled. ||4||10||
She was the abode of happiness and her eyes were charming she was thoughtfully singing her musical modes.468.
She was pretty, gentle and generous
That lady, the treasure of music, to whichever direction she viewed, she allured everyone.469.
That blemishless and honourable lady was an ocean of happiness
She was singing with full concentration of mind and the auspicious songs seemed to be springing out from her very interior.470.
Seeing her, the king of Yogis gathered all his Yogis and
All of them were pleased to see that pure Yogin.471.
The king of Yogis thought that if in this way, detaching oneself from all other sides,
The mind is concentrated on the Lord, then the Lord can be realized without any apprehension.472.
The enthusiastic sage, accepted her as his Guru, fell at her feet
Getting absorbed in her love, the king of the sages, adopted her as his Twenty-Third Guru.473.

673.g: ਇਤਿ ਜਛਣੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਰਾਗ ਗਾਵਤੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇਈਸਵੋ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੨੩॥
673.e: End of the description of the adoption of a Yaksha woman-singer as the twenty-Third Guru.
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

673.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਵਸਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ. ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ; ਭਵਣ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
673.e: She controls the three qualities and the four directions of the world.

673.g: ਜਗ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਤਾਪ ਥਾਨ ਖੰਡੇ; ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
673.e: She destroys sacrificial feasts, cleansing baths, penances and sacred places of pilgrimage; what is this poor person to do? ||1||

673.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ; ਤਉ ਛੂਟੋ ॥
673.e: I grasped God's Support and Protection, and then I was emancipated.

673.g: ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਏ; ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਤਬ ਹੂਟੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
673.e: By the Grace of the Holy Saints, I sang the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and my sins and afflictions were taken away. ||1||Pause||

673.g: ਨਹ ਸੁਣੀਐ. ਨਹ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬਕੀਐ; ਨਹ ਮੋਹੈ ਉਹ ਡੀਠੀ ॥
673.e: She is not heard - she does not speak with a mouth; she is not seen enticing mortals.

673.g: ਐਸੀ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਵੈ; ਮਨਿ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੀਠੀ ॥੨॥
673.e: She administers her intoxicating drug, and so confuses them; thus she seems sweet to everyone's mind. ||2||

673.g: ਮਾਇ ਬਾਪ ਪੂਤ ਹਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ; ਉਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਓ ਦੂਆ ॥
673.e: In each and every home, she has implanted the sense of duality in mother, father, children, friends and siblings.

673.g: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਵਾਧਿ. ਘਾਟਿ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ; ਸਗਲੇ ਲਰਿ ਲਰਿ ਮੂਆ ॥੩॥
673.e: Some have more, and some have less; they fight and fight, to the death. ||3||

673.g: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
673.e: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has shown me this wondrous play.

673.g: ਗੂਝੀ ਭਾਹਿ ਜਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ; ਭਗਤ. ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
673.e: The world is being consumed by this hidden fire, but Maya does not cling to the Lord's devotees. ||4||

673.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਗਲੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੇ ॥
673.e: By the Grace of the Saints, I have obtained supreme bliss, and all my bonds have been broken.

673.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਅਪੁਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਖਾਟੇ ॥੫॥੧੧॥
673.e: Nanak has obtained the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; having earned his profits, he has now returned home. ||5||11||

674.g: ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
674.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

674.g: ਅਬ. ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਚਿਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
674.e: Now, I contemplate and meditate on the Lord, the Saviour Lord.

674.g: ਪਤਿਤ. ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਸਗਲਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
674.e: He purifies sinners in an instant, and cures all diseases. ||1||Pause||

674.g: ਗੋਸਟਿ ਭਈ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਮਿ; ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
674.e: Talking with the Holy Saints, my sexual desire, anger and greed have been eradicated.

674.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ; ਸੰਗੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
674.e: Remembering, remembering the Perfect Lord in meditation, I have saved all my companions. ||1||

674.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
674.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

674.g: ਪੂਜਾ ਵਰਤ ਤਿਲਕ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ; ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਬਹੁ ਦੈਨ ॥
674.e: Worship, fasting, ceremonial marks on one's forehead, cleansing baths, generous donations to charities and self-mortification

674.g: ਕਹੂੰ. ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੰਜਮ, ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਬੋਲਹਿ ਮੀਠੇ ਬੈਨ ॥੧॥
674.e: - the Lord Master is not pleased with any of these rituals, no matter how sweetly one may speak. ||1||

674.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਮਨ ਚੈਨ ॥
674.e: Chanting the Name of God, the mind is soothed and pacified.

674.g: ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਬਿਖਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲੈਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
674.e: Everyone searches for Him in different ways, but the search is so difficult, and He cannot be found. ||1||Pause||

674.g: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ. ਭ੍ਰਮਨ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕਰਿ; ਉਰਧ ਤਾਪ ਲੈ ਗੈਨ ॥
674.e: Chanting, deep meditation and penance, wandering over the face of the earth, the performance of austerities with the arms stretched up to the sky

674.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ. ਨਹ ਪਤੀਆਨੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਨ ॥੨॥
674.e: - the Lord is not pleased by any of these means, though one may follow the path of Yogis and Jains. ||2||

674.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ; ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪੈਨ ॥
674.e: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Praises of the Lord are priceless; he alone obtains them, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy.

674.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਟੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਜਨ ਰੈਨ ॥੩॥੧੩॥
674.e: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak lives in the Love of God; his life-night passes in peace. ||3||13||

674.g: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹੁ; ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
674.e: Each and every moment, You cherish and nurture me; I am Your child, and I rely upon You alone. ||1||

674.g: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਏਕ; ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
674.e: I have only one tongue - which of Your Glorious Virtues can I describe?

674.g: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤੇਰੋ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
674.e: Unlimited, infinite Lord and Master - no one knows Your limits. ||1||Pause||

674.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਖੰਡਹੁ; ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧੀ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੁ ॥
674.e: You destroy millions of my sins, and teach me in so many ways.

674.g: ਹਮ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅਲਪ ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀ; ਤੁਮ ਆਪਨ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
674.e: I am so ignorant - I understand nothing at all. Please honor Your innate nature, and save me! ||2||

674.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਸਾ; ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
674.e: I seek Your Sanctuary - You are my only hope. You are my companion, and my best friend.

674.g: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਗੋਲੇ ॥੩॥੧੨॥
674.e: Save me, O Merciful Saviour Lord; Nanak is the slave of Your home. ||3||12||

674.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
674.e: SWAYYA

674.g: ਦੇਸ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਨਰੇਸਨ ਜੀਤਿ; ਅਨੇਸ ਬਡੇ ਅਵਨੇਸ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
ਆਠੋ ਈ ਸਿਧ ਸਬੈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ; ਸਮ੍ਰਿਧਨ ਸਰਬ ਭਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
674.e: This KAL (death) has killed the great sovereigns of all the countries and the earth, who had eight powers, nine treasures, all kinds of accomplishments

674.g: ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮੁਖੀ ਬਨਿਤਾ, ਬਹੁਤੈ ਘਰਿ; ਮਾਲ ਭਰੇ, ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਸੰਭਾਰੇ ॥
674.e: Moon-faced women and unlimited wealth

674.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਅਧੀਨ ਭਏ ਜਮ; ਅੰਤਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਗੇ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ॥੪੯੧॥
674.e: They all left this world with naked feet under the control of Yama, without the remembrance of the Name of the Lord.491.

674.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਕੇ ਮਹਿਰਾਵਨ ਕੇ; ਮਨੁ ਕੇ ਨਲ ਕੇ ਚਲਤੇ ਨ ਚਲੀ ਗਉ ॥
674.e: Even Ravan and Mehravan were helpless before him

674.g: ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਦ ਛੰਦ ॥
674.e: VICHITRA PAD STANZA

674.g: ਏਕਹਿ ਜਉ ਮਨਿ ਆਨਾ ॥
ਦੂਸਰ ਭਾਵ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
ਦੁੰਦਭਿ ਦਉਰ ਬਜਾਏ ॥
ਫੂਲ ਸੁਰਨ ਬਰਖਾਏ ॥੪੮੨॥
674.e: The sage absorbed his mind in the One Lord and did not allow any other idea to enter his mind, then the gods showered flowers, beating their drums.482.

674.g: ਹਰਖੇ ਸਬ ਜਟ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
ਗਾਵਤ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
674.e: The sages, getting delighted, clapped their hands and began to sing

674.g: ਜਿਤ ਤਿਤ ਡੋਲਤ ਫੂਲੇ ॥
ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੇ ਸਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ॥੪੮੩॥
674.e: They forgot their domestic worries and moved here and there happily.483.

674.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਚਉਬਿਸੈ ਫਲ ਹੀਨ ॥
674.e: He, who not recognized the One Lord, the twenty-four are fruitless for him

674.g: ਜਿਨ ਏਕ ਕੋ ਪਹਿਚਾਨ ॥
ਤਿਨਿ ਚਉਬਿਸੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਨ ॥੪੮੧॥
674.e: He, who feels the presence of One and recognizes him, he can feel the happiness of the twenty-four.481.

674.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
674.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

674.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ, ਲੀਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥
674.e: The Lord saves His Saints.

674.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ; ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
674.e: One who wishes misfortune upon the Lord's slaves, shall be destroyed by the Lord eventually. ||1||Pause||

674.g: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਆ; ਨਿੰਦਕ ਭਾਗੇ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
674.e: He Himself is the help and support of His humble servants; He defeats the slanderers, and chases them away.

674.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਊਹਾਂ ਹੀ ਮੂਏ; ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ. ਨ ਮੰਝਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
674.e: Wandering around aimlessly, they die out there; they never return to their homes again. ||1||

674.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ; ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
674.e: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of pain; he sings the Glorious Praises of the infinite Lord forever.

674.g: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ; ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੫॥
674.e: The faces of the slanderers are blackened in the courts of this world, and the world beyond. ||2||15||

674.g: ਤੋਟਕ ਛੰਦ ॥
674.e: TOTAK STANZA

674.g: ਗਿਰਿ ਮੇਰੁ ਗਏ ਰਿਖਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਲੈ ॥
ਧਰ ਸੀਸ ਜਟਾ ਭਗਵੇ ਪਟ ਕੈ ॥
674.e: The sage having matted locks on his head and wearing ochre-coloured clothed on his body, went on the Sumeru mountain alongwith his disciples

674.g: ਤਪ ਘੋਰ ਕਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਖ ਦਿਨਾ ॥
ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪ ਨ ਛੋਰਸ ਏਕ ਛਿਨਾ ॥੪੮੬॥
674.e: There he performed austerities in various for many years and did not forget the Lord even for an instant.486.

674.g: ਦਸ ਲਛ ਸੁ ਬੀਸ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਬ੍ਰਖੰ ॥
ਤਪ ਕੀਨ ਤਹਾ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਰਿਖੰ ॥
674.e: There the sages performed austerities in various ways for ten lakh twenty thousand years

674.g: ਸਬ ਦੇਸਨ ਦੇਸ ਚਲਾਇ ਮਤੰ ॥
ਮੁਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਮਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਗੂੜ ਗਤੰ ॥੪੮੭॥
674.e: Then they propagated the secret doctrines of that great sage in all the countries far and near.487.

674.g: ਰਿਖਿ ਰਾਜ ਦਸਾ ਜਬ ਅੰਤ ਭਈ ॥
ਬਲ ਜੋਗ ਹੁਤੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਾਨ ਲਈ ॥
674.e: When the final hour of that great sage arrived, the great sage came to know of it with the strength of Yoga

674.g: ਧੂਅਰੋ ਜਗ ਧਉਲੁਰ ਜਾਨਿ ਜਟੀ ॥
ਕਛੁ ਅਉਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਠਟੀ ॥੪੮੮॥
674.e: Then that sage with matted locks, considering this world like a cloud of smoke, formulated a plan of another activity.488.

674.g: ਸਧਿ ਕੈ ਪਵਨੈ ਰਿਖ ਜੋਗ ਬਲੰ ॥
ਤਜਿ ਚਾਲ ਕਲੇਵਰ ਭੂਮਿ ਤਲੰ ॥
674.e: Controlling the wind with the strength of Yoga, relinquishing his body left the earth

674.g: ਕਲ ਫੋਰਿ ਉਤਾਲ ਕਪਾਲ ਕਲੀ ॥
ਤਿਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੁ ਜੋਤਿਹ ਮਧ ਮਿਲੀ ॥੪੮੯॥
674.e: Breaking the skull, his light of the soul merged in the supreme light of the Lord.489.

674.g: ਕਲ ਕਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਵਾਲ ਕਰਾਲ ਲਸੈ ॥
ਜਗ ਜੰਗਮ ਥਾਵਰ ਸਰਬ ਕਸੈ ॥
674.e: The KAL (death) streches his dreadful sword always o all categories of beings

674.g: ਜਗ ਕਾਲਹਿ ਜਾਲ ਬਿਸਾਲ ਰਚਾ ॥
ਜਿਹ ਬੀਚ ਫਸੇ ਬਿਨ ਕੋ ਨ ਬਚਾ ॥੪੯੦॥
674.e: It has created the large net of this world, from which none had been able to escape.490.

674.g: ਤਾਰਕ ਛੰਦ ॥
674.e: TAARAK STANZA

674.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਰਖ ਜਬੈ ਤਪਸਾ ਤਿਹ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਜੁ ਕਹੀ ਧਰ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
674.e: In this way, when the sages performed austerities for many years and did all according to the bidding of their Guru

674.g: ਤਬ ਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਹੁਐ ਬ︀ਯੋਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
ਤਬ ਹੀ ਦਸਓ ਦਿਸਿ ਸੂਝ ਬਨਾਈ ॥੪੮੪॥
674.e: The great sage told them many methods and in this way, they obtained the wisdom of knowledge of all the ten directions.484.

674.g: ਦਿਜ ਦੇਵ ਤਬੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਉਬਿਸ ਕੈ ਕੈ ॥
ਗਿਰਿ ਮੇਰ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮੁਨਿ ਲੈ ਕੈ ॥
674.e: In this way, the sage adopting twenty-four Gurus, went on the Sumeru mountain alongwith other sages

674.g: ਤਪਸਾ ਜਬ ਘੋਰ ਤਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤਬੈ ਤਿਹ ਯਾ ਸਿਖ ਦੀਨੀ ॥੪੮੫॥
674.e: There he performed severe austerities and then the Guru Dutt, gave these instructions to all of them.485.

674.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
674.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

674.g: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਵੈ. ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥
674.e: Is there anyone who can release me from my bondage, unite me with God, recite the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

674.g: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ; ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
674.e: and make this mind steady and stable, so that it no longer wanders around? ||1||

674.g: ਹੈ ਕੋਊ ਐਸੋ; ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
674.e: Do I have any such friend?

674.g: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ. ਜੀਉ ਹੀਉ ਦੇਉ; ਅਰਪਉ ਅਪਨੋ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
674.e: I would give him all my property, my soul and my heart; I would devote my consciousness to him. ||1||Pause||

674.g: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ. ਪਰ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
674.e: Others' wealth, others' bodies, and the slander of others - do not attach your love to them.

674.g: ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗੁ. ਸੰਤ ਸੰਭਾਖਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
674.e: Associate with the Saints, speak with the Saints, and keep your mind awake to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||2||

674.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
674.e: God is the treasure of virtue, kind and compassionate, the source of all comfort.

674.g: ਮਾਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ. ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥੧੪॥
674.e: Nanak begs for the gift of Your Name; O Lord of the world, love him, like the mother loves her child. ||3||14||

675.g: ਅਉਖਧ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਲ ਮਨ ਏਕੈ; ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
675.e: The Mul Mantra, the Root Mantra, is the only cure for the mind; I have installed faith in God in my mind.

675.g: ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨ. ਬਾਂਛੈ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੧੬॥
675.e: Nanak ever longs for the dust of the Lord's feet; again and again, he is a sacrifice to the Lord. ||2||16||

675.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
675.e: The Lord is One and He can be attained through the grace of the true Guru.

675.g: ਅਥ ਪਾਰਸ ਨਾਥ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
675.e: Now begins the description of Parasnath, the incarnation of Rudra. Tent Guru.

675.g: ਪਾਤਸਾਹੀ ੧੦ ॥
675.e: CHAUPAI

675.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਦਤ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
ਪੂਰਣ ਮਤ ਕੋ ਕੀਨ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
675.e: In this way there was the Dutt incarnation of Rudra and he spread his religion

675.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੋ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਨੀ ॥
ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਵਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
675.e: In the end, according to the Will of the Lord, his light (soul) merged in the Supreme Light of the Lord.1.

675.g: ਏਕ ਲਛ ਦਸ ਬਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨਾ ॥
ਪਾਛੇ ਚਲਾ ਜੋਗ ਕੋ ਬਾਨਾ ॥
675.e: After that, the Yoga-marga (path) continued its way for one lakh and ten years

675.g: ਗ੍ਰਯਾਰਵ ਬਰਖ ਬਿਤੀਤਤ ਭਯੋ ॥
ਪਾਰਸਨਾਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਭੂਅ ਵਯੋ ॥੨॥
675.e: With the passing away of the eleventh year, Parasnath was born on this earth.2.

675.g: ਰੋਹ ਦੇਸ ਸੁਭ ਦਿਨ ਭਲ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
ਪਰਸ ਨਾਥ ਭਯੋ ਸੁਰ ਗ੍ਰਯਾਨੁ ॥
675.e: On an auspicious day and at an auspicious place and country, he was born

675.g: ਅਮਿਤ ਤੇਜ ਅਸਿ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
ਚਕ੍ਰਤ ਰਹੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤ ਦੋਊ ॥੩॥
675.e: He was supremely learned and glorious there was none so illustrious like him and seeing him, his parents were wonder-struck.3.

675.g: ਦਸਊ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਤੇਜ ਅਤਿ ਬਢਾ ॥
ਦ੍ਵਾਦਸ ਭਾਨ ਏਕ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਚਢਾ ॥
675.e: His glory spread in all the ten directions and it seemed that the twelve suns were shining in one

675.g: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਲੋਕ ਉਠੇ ਅਕੁਲਾਈ ॥
ਭੂਪਤਿ ਤੀਰ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥
675.e: The people in all the ten directions felt agitated and went to the king for their lamenation.4.

675.g: ਭੋਜ ਦਿਲੀਪਤਿ ਕੌਰਵਿ ਕੈ; ਨਹੀ ਸਾਥ ਦਯੋ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ਬਲੀ ਕਉ ॥
675.e: He did not even co-operate with king Bhoj, the Delhi kings of Surya clan, the mighty Raghunath etc.

675.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲੀ ਅਬ ਲੌ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਹੂੰ ਕੇ; ਸਾਚ ਕਹੌ ਅਘ ਓਘ ਦਲੀ ਸਉ ॥
675.e: He did not even side with the destroyer of the store of sins

675.g: ਚੇਤ ਰੇ, ਚੇਤ, ਅਚੇਤ, ਮਹਾ ਪਸੁ, ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲੀ ਨ ਹਲੀ ਹਉ ॥੪੯੨॥
675.e: Therefore O great animal-like unconscious mind! come into your senses, but consider that the KAL (death) did not consider anyone its own.492.

675.g: ਸਾਚ ਔਰ ਝੂਠ ਕਹੇ ਬਹੁਤੈ ਬਿਧਿ; ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
675.e: The being, in many ways, speaking both truth and falsehood, absorbed himself in lust and anger

675.g: ਭਾਜ ਨਿਲਾਜ ਬਚਾ ਧਨ ਕੇ ਡਰ; ਲੋਕ ਗਯੋ, ਪਰਲੋਕ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
675.e: For earning and gathering wealth unashamedly lost both theis and the next world

675.g: ਦੁਆਦਸ ਬਰਖ ਪੜਾ, ਨ ਗੁੜਿਓ ਜੜ, ਰਾਜੀਵਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
675.e: Though he obtained education for twelve-years, but did not follow its sayings and lotus-eyed (Rajiv-lochan) could not realise that Lord

675.g: ਲਾਜ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਅਧੀਨ ਗਹੇ ਜਮ; ਅੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਾਗੇ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ਸਿਧਾਏ ॥੪੯੩॥
675.e: The unashamed being will ultimately be caught by Yama and it will have to go with naked feet from this place.493.

675.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਰੋ ਭਗਵੇ, ਮੁਨਿ, ਤੇ ਸਬ ਪਾਵਕ ਬੀਚ ਜਲੈਗੀ ॥
675.e: O sages! why do you wear ochre-coloured clothes?, they will all be burnt in the fire at the end.

675.g: ਕਿਯੋਂ ਇਮ ਰੀਤ ਚਲਾਵਤ ਹੋ ਦਿਨ ਦ੍ਵੈਕ ਚਲੈ ਸ੍ਰਬਦਾ ਨ ਚਲੈਗੀ ॥
675.e: Why do you introduce such-like rites, which will not continue for ever?

675.g: ਕਾਲ ਕਰਾਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਇਹ; ਕਾਹੂੰ ਜੁਗੇਸਿ ਛਲੀ ਨ ਛਲੈਗੀ ॥
675.e: Now one will be able to deceive the great tradition of the dreadful KAL

675.g: ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਦੇਹ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਮੁਨਿ, ਅੰਤ ਮਸਾਨ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਧੂਰਿ ਰਲੈਗੀ ॥੪੯੪॥
675.e: O sage! your beautiful body will ultimately be mixed with dust.494.

675.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਕੋ ਪਉਨ ਭਛੋ, ਸੁਨਿ ਹੋ ਮੁਨਿ, ਪਉਨ ਭਛੇ ਕਛੂ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਐ ਹੈ ॥
675.e: O sage! why are you only subsisting on wind ? You will not achieve anything by doing this

675.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਕੋ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੋ ਭਗਵਾ, ਇਨ ਬਾਤਨ ਸੋ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਨ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਹੈ ॥
675.e: You cannot even attain that supreme Lord by wearing the ochre-coloured clothes

675.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਕੇ ਦੇਖਹੁ; ਤੇ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਬਸ ਕਾਲ ਸਬੈ ਹੈ ॥
675.e: Look at the illustrations of all the Vedas, Pranas etc., then you will know that all are under the control of KAL

675.g: ਜਾਰਿ ਅਨੰਗ ਨ, ਨੰਗ ਕਹਾਵਤ; ਸੀਸ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਟਾਊ ਨ ਜੈ ਹੈ ॥੪੯੫॥
675.e: You can be called ANANG (limbless) by burning your lust, but even your matted locks will not accompany your head and all this will be destroyed over here.495.

675.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੂਟ ਗਿਰ︀ਯੋ ਕਹੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਸਾਤਓ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਿਯੋਂ ਨ ਸੁਕਾਨੋ ॥
675.e: Undoubtedly, the citadels of gold be reduced to dust, all the seven oceans be dried up,

675.g: ਪਸਚਮ ਭਾਨੁ ਉਦ੍ਰਯੋ ਕਹੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ; ਗੰਗ ਬਹੀ ਉਲਟੀ ਅਨੁਮਾਨੋ ॥
675.e: The sun may rise in the west, the Ganges may flow in the opposite direction,

675.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਬਸੰਤ ਤਪ︀ਯੋ ਰਵਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਚੰਦ ਸਮਾਨ ਦਿਨੀਸ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨੋ ॥
675.e: The sun may heat in the spring season, the sun may become cold like the moon, the earth supported by the tortoise may shake,

675.g: ਕਿਯੋਂ ਡਮਡੋਲ ਡੁਬੀ ਨ ਧਰਾ ਮੁਨਿ ਰਾਜ ਨਿਪਾਤਨਿ ਤਿਯੋਂ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੪੯੬॥
675.e: But even then, O king of the sages! the destruction of the world is certain by KAL.496.

675.g: ਅਤ੍ਰਿ ਪਰਾਸਰ ਨਾਰਦ ਸਾਰਦ ਬ︀ਯਾਸ ਤੇ ਆਦਿ ਜਿਤੇ ਮੁਨ ਭਾਏ ॥
675.e: There have been many sages like Atri, Parashar, Narada, Sharda, Vyas etc.,

675.g: ਗਾਲਵ ਆਦਿ ਅਨੰਤ ਮੁਨੀਸ੍ਵਰ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਗਨਾਏ ॥
675.e: Who cannot be counted even by Brahma

675.g: ਅਗਸਤ ਪੁਲਸਤ ਬਸਿਸਟ ਤੇ ਆਦਿ; ਨ ਜਾਨ ਪਰੇ, ਕਿਹ ਦੇਸ ਸਿਧਾਏ ॥
675.e: There had been many sages like Agastya, Pulastya, Vashistha etc., but it could not be known to which directions they have gone

675.g: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਚਲਾਇ ਬਨਾਇ ਮਹਾ ਮਤਿ; ਫੇਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਰ ਫੇਰ ਨ ਆਏ ॥੪੯੭॥
675.e: They composed mantras and established many sects, but they merged in the cycle of dreadful existence, that after that nothing could be known about them.497.

675.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰੰਧ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਫੋਰਿ ਮੁਨੀਸ ਕੀ; ਜੋਤਿ ਸੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੇ ਮਧਿ ਮਿਲਾਨੀ ॥
675.e: Breaking the Brahmarandhra (an aperture in the crown of the head), the light of the king of sages merged in that Supreme Light

675.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਲੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸੋ ਇਮ; ਬੇਦਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਮ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
675.e: His love was absorbed in the Lord like all kinds of compositions are interlinked in the Veda

675.g: ਪੁੰਨ ਕਥਾ ਮੁਨਿ ਨੰਦਨ ਕੀ ਕਹਿ ਕੈ ਮੁਖ ਸੋ ਕਬਿ ਸ︀ਯਾਮ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
675.e: In his way, the poet Shyam has described the episode of the great sage Dutt

675.g: ਪੂਰਣ ਧਿਆਇ ਭਯੋ ਤਬ ਹੀ; ਜਯ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਜਗਨਾਥ ਭਵੇਸ ਭਵਾਨੀ ॥੪੯੮॥
675.e: This chapter is now being completed hailing the Lord of the world and the mother of the world.498.

675.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਦਤ ਮਹਾਤਮੇ ਰੁਦ੍ਰਵਤਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥ ਸੁਭੰ ਭਵੇਤ ਗੁਰੂ ਚਉਬੀਸ ॥੨੪॥
675.e: End of the description of the composition regarding the sage Dutt, the incarnation of Rudra in Bachittar Natak.

675.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
675.e: Raag Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

675.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
675.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

675.g: ਹਾ ਹਾ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
675.e: O God, please save me!

675.g: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਹੋਇ, ਮੇਰੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
675.e: By myself, I cannot do anything, O my Lord and Master; by Your Grace, please bless me with Your Name. ||1||Pause||

675.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
675.e: Family and worldly affairs are an ocean of fire.

675.g: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
675.e: Through doubt, emotional attachment and ignorance, we are enveloped in darkness. ||1||

675.g: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ॥
675.e: High and low, pleasure and pain.

675.g: ਧ੍ਰਾਪਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ, ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ॥੨॥
675.e: Hunger and thirst are not satisfied. ||2||

675.g: ਮਨਿ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਰਚਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ॥
675.e: The mind is engrossed in passion, and the disease of corruption.

675.g: ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗਿ; ਮਹਾ ਅਸਾਧ ॥੩॥
675.e: The five thieves, the companions, are totally incorrigible. ||3||

675.g: ਜੀਅ ਜਹਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
675.e: The beings and souls and wealth of the world are all Yours.

675.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨੁ, ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
675.e: O Nanak, know that the Lord is always near at hand. ||4||1||19||

675.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
675.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

675.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ. ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਰਾਖੈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ॥
675.e: The Lord and Master destroys the pain of the poor; He preserves and protects the honor of His servants.

675.g: ਤਰਣ ਤਾਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ; ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਿਆਪਿ ॥੧॥
675.e: The Lord is the ship to carry us across; He is the treasure of virtue - pain cannot touch Him. ||1||

675.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
675.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate, vibrate upon the Lord of the world.

675.g: ਆਨ ਸੰਜਮ. ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ; ਇਹ ਜਤਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
675.e: I cannot think of any other way; make this effort, and make it in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||Pause||

675.g: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨਾ. ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
675.e: In the beginning, and in the end, there is none other than the perfect, merciful Lord.

675.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ; ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
675.e: The cycle of birth and death is ended, chanting the Lord's Name, and remembering the Lord Master in meditation. ||2||

675.g: ਬੇਦ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕਥੈ ਸਾਸਤ; ਭਗਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
675.e: The Vedas, the Simritees, the Shaastras and the Lord's devotees contemplate Him;

675.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ; ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
675.e: liberation is attained in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled. ||3||

675.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ; ਰਾਸਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਏਕ ॥
675.e: The lotus feet of the Lord are the support of His humble servants. They are his only capital and investment.

675.g: ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
675.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

675.g: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
675.e: Your Name is the medicine, O Merciful Lord.

675.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਆਤੁਰ. ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
675.e: I am so miserable, I do not know Your state; You Yourself cherish me, Lord. ||1||Pause||

675.g: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ; ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
675.e: Take pity on me, O my Lord and Master, and remove the love of duality from within me.

675.g: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ; ਕਬਹੂ. ਨ ਆਵਹ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
675.e: Break my bonds, and take me as Your own, so that I may never come to lose. ||1||

675.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ; ਤੂੰ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
675.e: Seeking Your Sanctuary, I live, almighty and merciful Lord and Master.

675.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਆਰਾਧੀ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੧੮॥
675.e: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship God; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||18||

675.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
675.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

675.g: ਮੇਰਾ. ਲਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
675.e: I have fallen in love with the Lord.

675.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਕਾ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਕੇਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
675.e: My True Guru is always my help and support; He has torn down the banner of pain. ||1||Pause||

675.g: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
675.e: Giving me His hand, He has protected me as His own, and removed all my troubles.

675.g: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੇ ਕੀਨੇ; ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
675.e: He has blackened the faces of the slanderers, and He Himself has become the help and support of His humble servant. ||1||

675.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ; ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
675.e: The True Lord and Master has become my Saviour; hugging me close in His embrace, He has saved me.

675.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥੧੭॥
675.e: Nanak has become fearless, and he enjoys eternal peace, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||17||

676.e: “O king! Listen, we tell you an episode

676.g: ਜਿਹ ਸਮ ਰੂਪ ਜਗਤ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥

676.e: A very proud person has been born and there is none so beautiful like him it seems that the Lord (Providence) Himself had created him.5.
“Either he is a Yaksha or Gandharva it appears that a second sun has arisen
His body is gleaming with youth and seeing him, even the god of love is feeling shy.”6.
The king called him in order to see him and he (Parasnath) came on the very first day with the messengers
The king was pleased in his heart on seeing him wearing matted locks and it appeared to him that he was the second incarnation of Dutt.7.
Seeing his figure the sages wearing matted locks trembled and thought he was some incarnation,

676.g: ਯਹ ਮਤ ਦੂਰ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ॥
ਜਟਾਧਾਰ ਕੋਈ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਪੈ ਹੈ ॥੮॥
676.e: who will finish their religion and no person with matted locks will survive.8.
The king, seeing the impact of his glory, was extremely pleased
Whosoever saw him, he was pleased like one pauper obtaining nine treasures.9.
He put his net of allurement on all and all were getting succumbed in wonder

676.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਕਲ ਨਰ ਗਿਰੇ ॥

676.e: All the people getting fascinated fell down here and there like the warriors falling in battle.10.

676.g: ਨਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਜਿਹ ਜਿਹ ਤਿਹ ਪੇਖਾ ॥

676.e: The man or woman, who saw him, considered him s the god of love
The hermits considered him as an adept and the Yogis as a great Yogi.11.

676.g: ਦੇ ਤਿਹ ਸੁਤਾ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
676.e: The group of queens was allured on seeing him and the king also decided to marry his daughter with him
When he became the son-in-law of the king, then he became famous as a great archer.12.
That extremely beautiful and infinitely glorious persons was absorbed within himself

676.g: ਜਾ ਸਮ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜਗਤਿ ਨ ਆਨਾ ॥੧੩॥
676.e: He was expert in the knowledge of Shastras and weapons and there was no Pandit like him in the world.13.
He was like a Yaksha in human garb, not being troubled by the outer afflictions

676.g: ਜਿਹ ਜਿਹ ਰੂਪ ਤਵਨ ਕਾ ਲਹਾ ॥
ਸੋ ਸੋ ਚਮਕ ਚਕ੍ਰਿ ਹੁਐ ਰਹਾ ॥੧੪॥
676.e: Whosoever saw his beauty, he was wonder-struck and duped.14.

676.g: ਤਾਣੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਟੇਕ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੦॥
676.e: The True Lord is Nanak's strength, honor and support; He alone is his protection. ||4||2||20||
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Chau-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
You shall have to abandon the straw which you have collected.
These entanglements shall be of no use to you.

676.g: ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਚਾਲਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਹੀਤ ॥
676.e: You are in love with those things that will not go with you.
You think that your enemies are friends. ||1||
In such confusion, the world has gone astray.
The foolish mortal wastes this precious human life. ||Pause||
He does not like to see Truth and righteousness.
He is attached to falsehood and deception; they seem sweet to him.
He loves gifts, but he forgets the Giver.
The wretched creature does not even think of death. ||2||
He cries for the possessions of others.
He forfeits all the merits of his good deeds and religion.
He does not understand the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and so he continues coming and going in reincarnation.
He sins, and then regrets and repents. ||3||
Whatever pleases You, Lord, that alone is acceptable.
I am a sacrifice to Your Will.
Poor Nanak is Your slave, Your humble servant.
Save me, O my Lord God Master! ||4||1||22||
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

676.g: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਭੇਟੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ; ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
676.e: Wandering and roaming around, I met the Holy Perfect Guru, who has taught me.

676.g: ਆਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ. ਕਾਂਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
676.e: All other devices did not work, so I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

676.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹਿ; ਧਾਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
676.e: For this reason, I sought the Protection and Support of my Lord, the Cherisher of the Universe.

676.g: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ; ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
676.e: I sought the Sanctuary of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, and all my entanglements were dissolved. ||Pause||

676.g: ਸੁਰਗ ਮਿਰਤ ਪਇਆਲ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ; ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਮਾਇ ॥
676.e: Paradise, the earth, the nether regions of the underworld, and the globe of the world - all are engrossed in Maya.

676.g: ਜੀਅ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਨ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
676.e: To save your soul, and liberate all your ancestors, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

676.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ; ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
676.e: O Nanak, singing the Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord, all treasures are obtained.

676.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥੩॥੨੧॥
676.e: Only that rare person, whom the Lord and Master blesses with His Grace, comes to know this. ||3||3||21||
SWAYYA

676.g: ਮਾਨ ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਸਾਨ ਧਰੇ; ਮਠ ਸਾਨ ਚੜੇ, ਅਸਿ ਸ੍ਰੋਣਤਿ ਸਾਏ ॥
676.e: He was glorious like the sword saturated with marrow

676.g: ਲੇਤ ਹਰੇ ਜਿਹ ਡੀਠ ਪਰੇ; ਨਹੀ ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜਾਨ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
676.e: Whomsoever he saw, he could not go back to his home

676.g: ਝੀਮ ਝਰੇ ਜਨ ਸੇਲ ਹਰੇ; ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਗਿਰੇ, ਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਨ ਆਏ ॥
676.e: He, who came to see him he fell down swinging on the earth, whomsoever he saw, he was inflicted with the arrows of the god of love,

676.g: ਜਾਸੁ ਹਿਰੇ ਸੋਊ ਮੈਨ ਘਿਰੇ; ਗਿਰ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਰੇ, ਨ ਉਠੰਤ ਉਠਾਏ ॥੧੫॥
676.e: He fell down there and writhed and could not get up to go.1.15.

676.g: ਸੋਭਤ ਜਾਨੁ ਸੁਧਾਸਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ; ਕਾਮ ਕੇ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਕੂਪ ਸੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
676.e: It seemed that the store of lust had been opened and Parasnath looked splendid like the moon

676.g: ਲਾਜਿ ਕੇ ਜਾਨ ਜਹਾਜ ਬਿਰਾਜਤ; ਹੇਰਤ ਹੀ ਹਰ ਲੇਤ ਹਕਾਰੇ ॥
676.e: Even if there were ships stored with shyness and he allured everyone only on seeing

676.g: ਹਉ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਭ੍ਰਮ︀ਯੋ ਖਗ ਜ︀ਯੋਂ ਇਨ ਕੇ ਸਮ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਨੈਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
676.e: In all the four directions, the persons like wandering birds were saying this that they had seen none so beautiful like him
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:
I am meek and poor; the Name of God is my only Support.
The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my occupation and earnings.
I gather only the Lord's Name.

676.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
676.e: It is useful in both this world and the next. ||1||
Imbued with the Love of the Lord God's Infinite Name,

676.g: ਸਾਧ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਗੁਣ ਏਕ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
676.e: the Holy Saints sing the Glorious Praises of the One Lord, the Formless Lord. ||Pause||
The Glory of the Holy Saints comes from their total humility.
The Saints realize that their greatness rests in the Praises of the Lord.
Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, the Saints are in bliss.
The Saints find peace, and their anxieties are dispelled. ||2||
Wherever the Holy Saints gather,

676.g: ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਨਾਦ ਕਵਿਤ ॥
676.e: there they sing the Praises of the Lord, in music and poetry.
In the Society of the Saints, there is bliss and peace.

676.g: ਉਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
676.e: They alone obtain this Society, upon whose foreheads such destiny is written. ||3||
With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer.
I wash their feet, and chant the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.
O God, merciful and compassionate, let me remain in Your Presence.
Nanak lives, in the dust of the Saints. ||4||2||23||

677.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
677.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

677.g: ਸੋ ਕਤ ਡਰੈ; ਜਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥
677.e: One who contemplates his Lord and Master - why should he be afraid?

677.g: ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਪਚੇ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
677.e: The wretched self-willed manmukhs are ruined through fear and dread. ||1||Pause||

677.g: ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ; ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
677.e: The Divine Guru, my mother and father, is over my head.

677.g: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
677.e: His image brings prosperity; serving Him, we become pure.

677.g: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
677.e: The One Lord, the Immaculate Lord, is our capital.

677.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ; ਹੋਵਤ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੧॥
677.e: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, we are illumined and enlightened. ||1||

677.g: ਜੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ; ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥
677.e: The Giver of all beings is totally pervading everywhere.

677.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
677.e: Millions of pains are removed by the Lord's Name.

677.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸੈ ॥
677.e: All the pains of birth and death are taken away

677.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਸੈ ॥੨॥
677.e: from the Gurmukh, within whose mind and body the Lord dwells. ||2||

677.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
677.e: He alone, whom the Lord has attached to the hem of His robe,

677.g: ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ, ਤਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
677.e: obtains a place in the Court of the Lord.

677.g: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ; ਜਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
677.e: They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to the True Lord.

677.g: ਜਮਕਾਲ ਤੇ; ਭਏ ਨਿਕਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
677.e: They are freed from the Messenger of Death. ||3||

677.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
677.e: True is the Lord, and True is His Court.

677.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
677.e: Who can contemplate and describe His value?

677.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਸਗਲ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
677.e: He is within each and every heart, the Support of all.
Nanak begs for the dust of the Saints. ||4||3||24||

677.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
677.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

677.g: ਬਿਤੈ ਬਰਖ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਸਟ ਮਾਸੰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨੰ ॥
ਭਯੋ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਭੰ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਦ︀ਯਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ॥
677.e: Two years and eight months passed and Parasnath, the store of all learnings was known as a glorious king

677.g: ਜਪੈ ਹਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਠਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਪਾਣ ਦੇਵੀ ॥
ਅਨਾਸਾ ਛੁਧਾ ਅਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ਅਭੇਵੀ ॥੨੧॥
677.e: He repeated the names of he goddess of Hinglaaj and the weapon-wearing Durga.21.

677.g: ਜਪੈ ਤੋਤਲਾ ਸੀਤਲਾ ਖਗ ਤਾਣੀ ॥
ਭ੍ਰਮਾ ਭੈਹਰੀ ਭੀਮ ਰੂਪਾ ਭਵਾਣੀ ॥
677.e: The worship of the goddesses like Shitala, Bhavani etc. was performed and t

677.g: ਚਲਾਚਲ ਸਿੰਘ ਝਮਾਝੰਮ ਅਤ੍ਰੰ ॥
ਹਹਾ ਹੂਹਿ ਹਾਸੰ ਝਲਾ ਝਲ ਛਤ੍ਰੰ ॥੨੨॥
677.e: He gleaming arms, weapons, splendour, canopy, pleasantry etc. increased his glory.22.

677.g: ਅਟਾ ਅਟ ਹਾਸੰ ਛਟਾ ਛੁਟ ਕੇਸੰ ॥
ਅਸੰ ਓਧ ਪਾਣੰ ਨਮੋ ਕ੍ਰੂਰ ਭੇਸੰ ॥
677.e: The beauty of his enjoyment and his hair appeared extremely comely and his sword glistened like lightning in his hands

677.g: ਸਿਰੰਮਾਲ ਸ੍ਵਛੰ ਲਸੈ ਦੰਤ ਪੰਤੰ ॥
ਭਜੈ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੂੜੰ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲੰਤ ਸੰਤੰ ॥੨੩॥
677.e: He had worn a pure rosary on his head and the rows of his teeth looked magnificent seeing him, the enemies fled away and the saints were pleased.23.

677.g: ਅਲਿੰਪਾਤਿ ਅਰਧੀ ਮਹਾ ਰੂਪ ਰਾਜੈ ॥
ਮਹਾ ਜੋਤ ਜ੍ਵਾਲੰ ਕਰਾਲੰ ਬਿਰਾਜੈ ॥
677.e: He appeared as a most beautiful king and there was a hideous halo of light around his face

677.g: ਤ੍ਰਸੈ ਦੁਸਟ ਪੁਸਟੰ ਹਸੈ ਸੁਧ ਸਾਧੰ ॥
ਭਜੈ ਪਾਨ ਦੁਰਗਾ ਅਰੂਪੀ ਅਗਾਧੰ ॥੨੪॥
677.e: On seeing him, the tyrants got illusioned and the saints smiled in their pleased mind he remembered the formless and mysterious Durga,24.

677.g: ਸੁਨੇ ਉਸਤਤੀ ਭੀ ਭਵਾਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੰ ॥
ਅਧੰ ਉਰਧਵੀ ਆਪ ਰੂਪੀ ਰਸਾਲੰ ॥
677.e: On listening to her praises, Bhavani was pleased on him and she endowed him with unique beauty

677.g: ਦਏ ਇਖ੍ਵਧੀ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਭੰਗੰ ਖਤੰਗੰ ॥
ਪਰਸ੍ਰਯੰ ਧਰੰ ਜਾਨ ਲੋਹੰ ਸੁਰੰਗੰ ॥੨੫॥
677.e: She gave him two unfailing arms which could cause the steel-armoured enemies to fall on the earth.25.

677.g: ਜਬੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਧੀ ਸਬੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਏ ॥
ਉਘਾਰੇ ਚੂਮੇ ਕੰਠ ਸੀਸੰ ਛੁਹਾਏ ॥
677.e: When this king, practising the armament, obtained the weapons, he kissed them, hugged them and placed them on his head

677.g: ਲਖ︀ਯੋ ਸਰਬ ਰਾਵੰ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
ਅਜੋਨੀ ਅਜੈ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥੨੬॥
677.e: All the kings saw him as unconquerable warrior and a successful scholar of he Vedic learning.26.

677.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੀਤੁਆ ਜਬੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
ਪੜੇ ਅਨੁਭਵੰ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
677.e: After obtaining the unlimited arms and weapons, he also obtained the experience of the reflection of Vedic learning

677.g: ਪੜੇ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਹੁਤੀ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਸੰ ॥
ਜਿਤੇ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਸੀ ਸੁ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਨਰੇਸੰ ॥੨੭॥
677.e: He studies the sciences of all the countries and on the strength of his arms and weapons, he conquered the kings of all the countries.27.

677.g: ਪਠੇ ਕਾਗਦੰ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸੰ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
ਕਰੋ ਆਨਿ ਕੈ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਦ︀ਯਾ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥
677.e: He invited the scholars and sages from many countries far and near for consultations on Vedic learning

677.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
677.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

677.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ. ਤਹ ਹਜੂਰਿ; ਦੂਰਿ ਕਤਹੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
677.e: Wherever I look, there I see Him present; He is never far away.

677.g: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ; ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
677.e: He is all-pervading, everywhere; O my mind, meditate on Him forever. ||1||

677.g: ਈਤ ਊਤ. ਨਹੀ ਬੀਛੁੜੈ; ਸੋ ਸੰਗੀ ਗਨੀਐ ॥
677.e: He alone is called your companion, who will not be separated from you, here or hereafter.

677.g: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੋ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਹਿ; ਸੋ ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਨੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
677.e: That pleasure, which passes away in an instant, is trivial. ||Pause||

677.g: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਅਪਿਆਉ ਦੇਇ; ਕਛੁ ਊਨ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
677.e: He cherishes us, and gives us sustenance; He does not lack anything.

677.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸੰਮਾਲਤਾ; ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
677.e: With each and every breath, my God takes care of His creatures. ||2||

677.g: ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਊਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥
677.e: God is undeceiveable, impenetrable and infinite; His form is lofty and exalted.

677.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਜਨ; ਅਚਰਜ ਆਨੂਪੁ ॥੩॥
677.e: Chanting and meditating on the embodiment of wonder and beauty, His humble servants are in bliss. ||3||

677.g: ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਾ ॥
677.e: Bless me with such understanding, O Merciful Lord God, that I might remember You.

677.g: ਪਾਰਥ ਬਾਨ ਕਿ ਜੁਬਨ ਖਾਨ; ਕਿ ਕਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ, ਕਿ ਕਾਮ ਕਟਾਰੇ ॥੧੬॥
677.e: He is a killer like Arjuna’s arrow, he is a mine of youth he controls all like the sward of youth KAL and is the dagger of lust.2

677.g: ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਭਰੇ ਕਿਧੌ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਜਰੇ; ਅਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹਰੇ ਚਖ ਚੀਨਤ ਯਾ ਤੇ ॥
677.e: On seeing him, the impact of tantra, mantra and yantra ends

677.g: ਜੋਬਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗੇ ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ; ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੇ ਮਦ ਸੇ ਮਦੂਆ ਤੇ ॥
677.e: His eyes, glistening with the light of youth appear to be extremely pretty and intoxicated

677.g: ਰੰਗ ਸਹਾਬ ਫੂਲ ਗੁਲਾਬ ਸੇ; ਸੀਖੇ ਹੈ ਜੋਰਿ ਕਰੋਰਕ ਘਾਤੇ ॥
677.e: His eyes can kill crores of people like the roses and

677.g: ਮਾਧੁਰੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੂਰਤਿ; ਹੇਰਤਿ ਹੀ ਹਰ ਲੇਤ ਹੀਯਾ ਤੇ ॥੧੭॥
677.e: Seeing his comely figure, the mind gets fascinated on seeing him.3.17.

677.g: ਪਾਨ ਚਬਾਇ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਨਾਇ; ਸੁਗੰਧ ਲਗਾਇ ਸਭਾ ਜਬ ਆਵੈ ॥
ਕਿੰਨਰ ਜਛ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਚਰਾਚਰ; ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਦੋਊ ਬਿਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
677.e: When he went to the court on chewing the betel and fragrancing the body then all the Kinnars, Yakshas, Nagas, animate and inanimate beings, gods and demons were wonder-struck

677.g: ਮੋਹਿਤ ਜੇ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਗਨ ਮਾਨਨਿ; ਮੋਹਤ ਤਉਨ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
677.e: The human males and females were pleased on getting fascinated by him

677.g: ਵਾਰਹਿ ਹੀਰ ਅਮੋਲਕ ਚੀਰ; ਤ੍ਰੀਯਾ ਬਿਨ ਧੀਰ ਸਬੈ ਬਲ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧੮॥
677.e: They sacrificed their presious garments, diamonds and jewels on him impatiently.4.18.

677.g: ਰੂਪ ਅਪਾਰ ਪੜੇ ਦਸ ਚਾਰ ਮਨੋ ਅਸੁਰਾਰਿ ਚਤੁਰ ਚਕ ਜਾਨ︀ਯੋ ॥
677.e: Indra also marveled at Parasnath, the most beautiful person and expert in all the fourteen science

677.g: ਆਹਵ ਜੁਕਤਿ ਜਿਤੀਕ ਹੁਤੀ; ਜਗ ਸਰਬਨ ਮੈ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਅਨੁਮਾਨ੍ਰਯੋ ॥
677.e: He knew all the arts of warfare,

677.g: ਦੇਸਿ ਬਿਦੇਸਨ ਜੀਤ ਜੁਧਾਬਰ; ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਚੰਦੋਵ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸ ਤਾਨ੍ਰਯੋ ॥
677.e: And after conquering all the countries far and near, he flag of victory waved in all the ten directions

677.g: ਦੇਵਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਗੋਪੀਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੰਦ ਸਮਾਨ ਪਛਾਨ︀ਯੋ ॥੧੯॥
677.e: The gods comprehended him as Indra, the gopis as Krishna and the night as the moon.5.19.

677.g: ਚਉਧਿਤ ਚਾਰ ਦਿਸਾ ਭਈ ਚਕ੍ਰਤ; ਭੂਮਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਾ ॥
677.e: Illumined like the full moon, Parasnath caused all the four directions wonder about him

677.g: ਜੁਧ ਸਮਾਨ ਲਖ︀ਯੋ ਜਗ ਜੋਧਨ ਬੋਧਨ ਬੋਧ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
677.e: He became famous everywhere on the earth and in the sky the warriors recognized him as a warrior and the learned as learned

677.g: ਸੂਰ ਸਮਾਨ ਲਖਾ ਦਿਨ ਕੈ ਤਿਹ; ਚੰਦ ਸਰੂਪ ਨਿਸਾ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਾ ॥
677.e: The day considered him as the sun and the night as the moon

677.g: ਰਾਨਨਿ ਰਾਵਿ ਸਵਾਨਿਨ ਸਾਵ; ਭਵਾਨਿਨ ਭਾਵ ਭਲੋ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੨੦॥
677.e: The queens considered him as the king, other women as the husband and the goddess as love.6.20.

677.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
677.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

677.g: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ; ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
677.e: God has fulfilled all my desires. Holding me close in His embrace, the Guru has saved me.

677.g: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ. ਜਲਨਿ ਨ ਦੀਨੇ; ਕਿਨੈ ਨ. ਦੁਤਰੁ ਭਾਖੇ ॥੧॥
677.e: He has saved me from burning in the ocean of fire, and now, no one calls it impassible. ||1||

677.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ; ਸਾਚਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ॥
677.e: Those who have true faith in their minds,

677.g: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਆਨਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਉਲਾਸੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
677.e: continually behold the Glory of the Lord; they are forever happy and blissful. ||Pause||

677.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ; ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਾਖਿਓ ॥
677.e: I seek the Sanctuary of the feet of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, the Searcher of hearts; I behold Him ever-present.

677.g: ਜਾਨਿ ਬੂਝਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਕੀਓ ਨਾਨਕ; ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਕੁਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਓ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੬॥
677.e: In His wisdom, the Lord has made Nanak His own; He has preserved the roots of His devotees. ||2||2||26||

677.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
677.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

677.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
677.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

677.g: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ; ਤੂ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
677.e: At home, and outside, I place my trust in You; You are always with Your humble servant.

677.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
677.e: Bestow Your Mercy, O my Beloved God, that I may chant the Lord's Name with love. ||1||

677.g: ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
677.e: God is the strength of His humble servants.

677.g: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਸਾ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
677.e: Whatever You do, or cause to be done, O Lord and Master, that outcome is acceptable to me. ||Pause||

677.g: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ. ਗਤਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ; ਧਨੁ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਖੀ ॥
677.e: The Transcendent Lord is my honor; the Lord is my emancipation; the glorious sermon of the Lord is my wealth.

677.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੀ. ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੫॥
677.e: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's feet; from the Saints, he has learned this way of life. ||2||1||25||

678.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
678.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Sixth House:

678.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
678.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

678.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਬਿਨਉ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
678.e: Listen, O Dear Beloved Saints, to my prayer.

678.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ; ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
678.e: Without the Lord, no one is liberated. ||Pause||

678.g: ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ, ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਹਰਿ; ਅਵਰਿ ਜੰਜਾਲ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਹੂ. ਨ ਕਾਮ ਜੀਉ ॥
678.e: O mind, do only deeds of purity; the Lord is the only boat to carry you across. Other entanglements shall be of no use to you.

678.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇਵਾ. ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੇਵਾ; ਇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
678.e: True living is serving the Divine, Supreme Lord God; the Guru has imparted this teaching to me. ||1||

678.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ. ਨ ਲਾਈਐ ਹੀਤੁ; ਜਾ ਕੋ. ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੀਤੁ; ਅੰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਓਹੁ ਸੰਗਿ, ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
678.e: Do not fall in love with trivial things; in the end, they shall not go along with you.

678.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਤੂ ਆਰਾਧ. ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਧ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ. ਤੇਰੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੨॥
678.e: Worship and adore the Lord with your mind and body, O Beloved Saint of the Lord; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall be released from bondage. ||2||

678.g: ਗਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਰਨ. ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲ ਚਰਨ; ਅਵਰ ਆਸ ਕਛੁ ਪਟਲੁ. ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
678.e: In your heart, hold fast to the Sanctuary of the lotus feet of the Supreme Lord God; do not place your hopes in any other support.

678.g: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ. ਤਪਾ ਸੋਈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੩॥੧॥੨੯॥
678.e: He alone is a devotee, spiritually wise, a meditator, and a penitent, O Nanak, who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy. ||3||1||29||

678.g: ਜਟੇ ਦੰਡ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਤਪੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ॥
ਸਧੀ ਸ੍ਰਾਵਗੀ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੮॥
678.e: They included those with matted locks, Dandis, Mudis, ascetics, celibates, practisers and many other students and scholars of Vedic learning.28.

678.g: ਹਕਾਰੇ ਸਬੈ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸਾ ਨਰੇਸੰ ॥
ਬੁਲਾਏ ਸਬੈ ਮੋਨ ਮਾਨੀ ਸੁ ਬੇਸੰ ॥
678.e: The king of all the countries far and near and the silence-observing hermits were also called

678.g: ਜਟਾ ਧਾਰ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਖ ਪਈਯੈ ॥
ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਨਾਥ ਭਾਖੈ ਬੁਲਈਯੈ ॥੨੯॥
678.e: Wherever an ascetic with matted locks was seen, he was also invited with the permission of Parasnath.29.

678.g: ਫਿਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਸੰ ਨਰੇਸੰ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਤਿਸੈ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਛੈਣੀ ਛਿਨਾਵੈ ॥
678.e: The kings of all the countries were called and whosoever refused to meet the messengers, his canopy and the army were seixed

678.g: ਪਠੇ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਏਕੈ ਦਿਸਾ ਏਕ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
ਜਟੀ ਦੰਡ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਹਾਥ ਆਵੈ ॥੩੦॥
678.e: The letters and persons were sent to all directions, so that if any ascetic with matted locks, Dandi, Mundi was found, he was brought.30.

678.g: ਰਚ︀ਯੋ ਜਗ ਰਾਜਾ ਚਲੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
ਜਹਾ ਲਉ ਕੋਈ ਬੂਢ ਬਾਰੋ ਸਭੋਗੀ ॥
678.e: Then the king performed a Yajna, in which all the Yogis, children, old men came,

678.g: ਕਹਾ ਰੰਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਕਹਾ ਨਾਰ ਹੋਈ ॥
ਰਚ︀ਯੋ ਜਗ ਰਾਜਾ ਚਲਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਕੋਈ ॥੩੧॥
678.e: Kings, paupers, men, women etc. all came for participation.31.

678.g: ਫਿਰੇ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਸੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
ਜੁਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਰਾਜਾ ਨ੍ਰਿਪੰ ਆਨਿ ਦੁਆਰੰ ॥
678.e: Invitations were sent to all the countries and all the kings reached at the gate of Parasnath

678.g: ਜਹਾ ਲੌ ਹੁਤੇ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਜਟਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
ਮਿਲੈ ਰੋਹ ਦੇਸੰ ਭਏ ਭੇਖ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੩੨॥
678.e: All the ascetics with matted locks in the world, they all gathered together and reached before the king.32.

678.g: ਜਹਾ ਲਉ ਹੁਤੇ ਜੋਗ ਜੋਗਿਸਟ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
ਮਲੇ ਮੁਖ ਬਿਭੂਤੰ ਸੁ ਲੰਗੋਟ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
678.e: The practising Yogis, smeared with ashes and wearing lion-cloth and all sages resided there peacefully

678.g: ਜਟਾ ਸੀਸ ਧਾਰੇ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
ਮਹਾ ਜੋਗ ਧਾਰੰ ਸੁਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥੩੩॥
678.e: Many great Yogis, scholars, and the ascetics with matted locks were seen there.33.

678.g: ਜਿਤੇ ਸਰਬ ਭੂਪੰ ਬੁਲੇ ਸਰਬ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
ਚਹੂੰ ਚਕ ਮੋ ਦਾਨ ਨੀਸਾਨ ਬਾਜਾ ॥
678.e: All the kings were invited by Parasnath and in all the four directions, he became famous as a donor

678.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ॥
ਕਰੈ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਜੋਗ ਬਾਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਤੰਤ੍ਰੀ ॥੩੪॥
678.e: Many ministers of the countries gathered there, the musical instruments of the practising Yogis were played there.34.

678.g: ਜਿਤੇ ਸਰਬ ਭੂਮਿ ਸਥਲੀ ਸੰਤ ਆਹੇ ॥
ਤਿਤੇ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਰਸ ਨਾਥੰ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
678.e: All the saints who had come at that place, they were all called by Prasnath

678.g: ਦਏ ਭਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਭੋਜ ਅਰਘ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
ਲਜੀ ਪੇਖ ਦੇਵਿ ਸਥਲੀ ਮੋਨ ਮਾਨੰ ॥੩੫॥
678.e: He served them with various types of food and bestowed charities on them, seeing which the abode of the gods felt shy.35.

678.g: ਕਰੈ ਬੈਠ ਕੇ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੋ ਸਬੈ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੰ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ॥
678.e: All sitting there held consultations in their own way regarding Vedic learning

678.g: ਟਕੰ ਟਕ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੁਖੰ ਮੁਖਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ॥
ਸੁਨ︀ਯੋ ਕਾਨ ਹੋ ਤੋ ਸੁ ਤੋ ਆਖਿ ਦੇਖਿਓ ॥੩੬॥
678.e: All of them saw pointedly towards one another and whatever they had heard earlier with their ears, on that day they saw it there with their own eyes.36.

678.g: ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੋ ਸਬੈ ਆਪ ਆਪੰ ਪੁਰਾਣੰ ॥
ਰੜੋ ਦੇਸਿ ਦੇਸਾਣ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਮੁਹਾਣੰ ॥
678.e: All of them opened up their Puranas and began to study their country’s lore

678.g: ਕਰੋ ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤੰ ਸੁ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
ਨ੍ਰਿਭੈ ਚਿਤ ਦੈ ਕੈ ਮਹਾ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਟਾਰੰ ॥੩੭॥
678.e: They began to reflect fearlessly on their lore in various ways.37.

678.g: ਜੁਰੇ ਬੰਗਸੀ ਰਾਫਿਜੀ ਰੋਹਿ ਰੂਮੀ ॥
ਚਲੇ ਬਾਲਖੀ ਛਾਡ ਕੈ ਰਾਜ ਭੂਮੀ ॥
ਨ੍ਰਿਭੈ ਭਿੰਭਰੀ ਕਾਸਮੀਰੀ ਕੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
ਕਿ ਕੈ ਕਾਲਮਾਖੀ ਕਸੇ ਕਾਸਕਾਰੀ ॥੩੮॥
678.e: There were gathered there the residents of Bang country, rafzi, Rohelas, Sami, Balakshi, Kashmiri, Kandhari and several Kal-mukhi Snnyasis.38.

678.g: ਜੁਰੇ ਦਛਣੀ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਤਾ ਅਰਯਾਰੇ ॥
ਦ੍ਰੁਜੈ ਦ੍ਰਾਵੜੀ ਤਪਤ ਤਈਲੰਗ ਵਾਰੇ ॥
678.e: The southern scholars of Shastras and the Dravidian and Telangi Savants has also gathered there

678.g: ਪਰੰ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਉਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਸੀ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
ਮਿਲੇ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸੇਣ ਜੋਧਾ ਜੁਝਾਰੰ ॥੩੯॥
678.e: Alongwith them there were gathered warriors of Eastern and Northern countries.39.

678.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
678.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

678.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਭਲੋ ਰੇ. ਭਲੋ ਰੇ; ਭਲੋ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥
678.e: O my dear beloved, it is good, it is better, it is best, to ask for the Lord's Name.

678.g: ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਨੈਨ. ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੇ ਬੈਨ; ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ. ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਮਰਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
678.e: Behold, with your eyes wide-open, and listen to the Words of the Holy Saints; enshrine in your consciousness the Lord of Life - remember that all must die. ||Pause||

678.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਚੋਆ ਰਸ. ਭੋਗ ਕਰਤ ਅਨੇਕੈ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੇਖੁ. ਸਗਲ ਹੈ ਫੀਕੇ; ਏਕੈ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਕੋ, ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ॥
678.e: The application of sandalwood oil, the enjoyment of pleasures and the practice of many corrupt sins - look upon all of these as insipid and worthless. The Name of the Lord of the Universe alone is sublime; so say the Holy Saints.

678.g: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਆਪਨ ਥਾਪਿਓ, ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ. ਨ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਾਪਿਓ; ਅਰਥੁ ਦ੍ਰਬੁ ਦੇਖੁ. ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ, ਨਾਹੀ ਚਲਨਾ ॥੧॥
678.e: You claim that your body and wealth are your own; you do not chant the Lord's Name even for an instant. Look and see, that none of your possessions or riches shall go along with you. ||1||

678.g: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ਕਰਮੁ ਭਲਾ, ਤਿਨਿ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੰਤ ਪਲਾ; ਤਿਨ. ਨਾਹੀ ਰੇ ਜਮੁ ਸੰਤਾਵੈ, ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਨਾ ॥
678.e: One who has good karma, grasps the Protection of the hem of the Saint's robe; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Messenger of Death cannot threaten him.

678.g: ਪਾਇਓ ਰੇ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ, ਮਿਟਿਓ ਹੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ; ਏਕੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੦॥
678.e: I have obtained the supreme treasure, and my egotism has been eradicated; Nanak's mind is attached to the One Formless Lord. ||2||2||30||

678.g: ਪਾਧਰੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
678.e: PAADHARI STANZA

678.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਬੀਰ ਬਹੁ ਬੀਰ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ. ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਰੇਨ ਪਗ ਸਾਧਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੭॥
678.e: Nanak begs God for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||3||27||

678.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
678.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

678.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਭੇਜੇ. ਤਿਨਹਿ ਬੁਲਾਏ; ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਉ ॥
678.e: The One who sent you, has now recalled you; return to your home now in peace and pleasure.

678.g: ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ; ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
678.e: In bliss and ecstasy, sing His Glorious Praises; by this celestial tune, you shall acquire your everlasting kingdom. ||1||

678.g: ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
678.e: Come back to your home, O my friend.

678.g: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਦੋਖੀ. ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ; ਅਪਦਾ ਭਈ ਬਿਤੀਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
678.e: The Lord Himself has eliminated your enemies, and your misfortunes are past. ||Pause||

678.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕੀਨੇ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਨੇਹਾਰੇ; ਨਾਸਨ ਭਾਜਨ ਥਾਕੇ ॥
678.e: God, the Creator Lord, has glorified you, and your running and rushing around has ended.

678.g: ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਲ. ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ; ਅਪੁਨੈ ਖਸਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ॥੨॥
678.e: In your home, there is rejoicing; the musical instruments continually play, and your Husband Lord has exalted you. ||2||

678.g: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਰਹਹੁ. ਡੋਲਹੁ ਮਤ ਕਬਹੂ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
678.e: Remain firm and steady, and do not ever waver; take the Guru's Word as your Support.

678.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ; ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
678.e: You shall be applauded and congratulated all over the world, and your face shall be radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

678.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ. ਤਿਨੈ ਹੀ ਫੇਰੇ; ਆਪੇ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
678.e: All beings belong to Him; He Himself transforms them, and He Himself becomes their help and support.

678.g: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੮॥
678.e: The Creator Lord has worked a wondrous miracle; O Nanak, His glorious greatness is true. ||4||4||28||

679.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

679.g: ਦਰਬਵੰਤੁ. ਦਰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਰਬੈ; ਭੂਮਵੰਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
679.e: The rich man gazes upon his riches, and is proud of himself; the landlord takes pride in his lands.

679.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਗਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਹਮਰਾ; ਤਿਉ. ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਟੇਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥
679.e: The king believes that the whole kingdom belongs to him; in the same way, the humble servant of the Lord looks upon the support of his Lord and Master. ||1||
When one considers the Lord to be his only support,

679.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਬਿਤੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤੈ; ਅਪੁਨਾ ਬਲੁ. ਨਹੀ ਹਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
679.e: then the Lord uses His power to help him; this power cannot be defeated. ||1||Pause||

679.g: ਆਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਏ ਇਕ ਆਸਰ; ਸਰਣਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
679.e: Renouncing all others, I have sought the Support of the One Lord; I have come to Him, pleading, "Save me, save me!"

679.g: ਸੰਤ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੪॥
679.e: By the kindness and the Grace of the Saints, my mind has been purified; Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||3||34||
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

679.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗੋ. ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ; ਸੋ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
679.e: He alone is called a warrior, who is attached to the Lord's Love in this age.

679.g: ਆਤਮ ਜਿਣੈ. ਸਗਲ ਵਸਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
679.e: Through the Perfect True Guru, he conquers his own soul, and then everything comes under his control. ||1||
In this way, Parasnath gathered together many brave fighters and kings of various countries far and near

679.g: ਦੇ ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਬਹੁ ਦਿਰਬ ਸਾਜ ॥

679.e: And honoured all of them donating wealth and garments to them.40.
There many canopied and fearless Yogis there
There were seated there unconquerable warriors, experts in arms and weapons, indestructible fighters, many mighty heroes, who had conquered thousand of wars.41.

679.g: ਸਬ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਤ ਰਾਵ ॥

679.e: Parasnath had taken various kinds of measures, had conquered the kings of various countries in wars

679.g: ਕੈ ਸਾਮ ਦਾਮ ਅਰੁ ਦੰਡ ਭੇਦ ॥

679.e: On the strength of Saam Daam, Dand and Bhed, he brought all together and brought them his control.42.
When all the kings were brought together by the great Parasnath and al of them gave him the letter of victory,
Then Parasnath gave unlimited wealth and garments to them and allured them.43.
One day, Parasnath went for the worship of the goddess
He adored her in various ways, whose description here I have composed in Mohani Stanza.44.
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Eighth House, Dho-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

679.g: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਉ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
679.e: Remembering, remembering, remembering Him in meditation, I find peace; with each and every breath, I dwell upon Him.

679.g: ਇਹ ਲੋਕਿ ਪਰਲੋਕਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ; ਜਤ ਕਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
679.e: In this world, and in the world beyond, He is with me, as my help and support; wherever I go, He protects me. ||1||

679.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
679.e: The Guru's Word abides with my soul.

679.g: ਜਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਡੂਬੈ. ਤਸਕਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਲੇਵੈ; ਭਾਹਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜਾਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
679.e: It does not sink in water; thieves cannot steal it, and fire cannot burn it. ||1||Pause||

679.g: ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕਉ ਧਨੁ. ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਉ ਟਿਕ; ਮਾਤ ਦੂਧੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਲੇ ॥
679.e: It is like wealth to the poor, a cane for the blind, and mother's milk for the infant.

679.g: ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਇਓ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਕਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੨॥
679.e: In the ocean of the world, I have found the boat of the Lord; the Merciful Lord has bestowed His Mercy upon Nanak. ||2||1||32||
MOHANI STANZA
“Hail, O Bhairavi, Durga, You are the destroyer of fear, You ferry across the ocean of existence,
the rider of the lion, the destroyer of fear and generous Creator!45.
“You are blemishless, adopter of arms, the fascinator of all the worlds, the Kshatriya goddess
You are Sati Savitri with blood-saturated limbs and the Supremely Immaculate Parmeshwari.46.
“You are the youthful goddess of sweet words
You are the destroyer of worldly sufferings and redeemer of all
You are Rajeshwari full of beauty and wisdom
I hail you, O the attainer of all powers.47.
“O supporter of the world! You are superb for the devotees
Holding the arms and weapons in your hands
You have the revolving maces in your hand and on their strength, You appear to be Supreme.48.
“You are superb amongst Yakshas and Kinnars
The Gandharvas and Siddhas (adepts) remain present at your feet
Your figure is pure like the lightning in clouds.49.
“Holding the sword in your hand, You honour the saints,
The giver of comfort and destroyer of sorrow
You are the destroyer of tyrants, redeemer of the saints
You are invincible and treasure of Virtues.50.
“You are he bliss-giving girija Kumari
You are indestructible, the destroyer of all and the redeemer of all
You are the eternal goddess Kali, but alongwith it,
You are the doe-eyed most beautiful goddess.51.
“You are the wife of Rudra with blood-saturated limbs
You are the chopper of all, but You are also Pure and Bliss-giving goddess
You are the mistress of activity and harmony
You are the alluring deity and the sword-bearing Kali.52.
“You are the Donor of gifts and the destroyer of the world, the goddess Durga!
You sit on the left limb of Rudra, the blood-coloured goddess
You are Parmeshwari and the Piety-adopting Mother.53.
“You are the killer of Mahishasura You are kali,
The destroyer of Chachhasura and also the Sustainer of the earth
You are the pride of he goddesses,
The carrier of sword in the hand and Durga, the Giver of Victory.54.
“You are the brown-eyed immaculate Parvati, Savitri and Gayatri
You are the remover of fear, the mighty goddess Durga
Hail, hail to Thee.55.
You are the mother Durga,
“You are the destroyer of armies in the war, the perisher of the fear of all
The killer of the enemies like Chand and Mund,
Hail, O goddess, the giver of victory.56.
“You are the one who ferries across the ocean of the world
You are the one who roams and crushes everyone
O Durga! you are the cause of the creation of all the worlds
And you are the remover of the suffering of Indrani.57.
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

679.g: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਾ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿੰਚਾਈ ॥
679.e: The Lord of the Universe has become kind and merciful; His Ambrosial Nectar permeates my heart.

679.g: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ; ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਜਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
679.e: The nine treasures, riches and the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas cling to the feet of the Lord's humble servant. ||1||

679.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕਉ; ਅਨਦੁ ਸਗਲ ਹੀ ਜਾਈ ॥
679.e: The Saints are in ecstasy everywhere.

679.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਾ; ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
679.e: Within the home, and outside as well, the Lord and Master of His devotees is totally pervading and permeating everywhere. ||1||Pause||

679.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਗਿ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
679.e: No one can equal one who has the Lord of the Universe on his side.

679.g: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੩॥
679.e: The fear of the Messenger of Death is eradicated, remembering Him in meditation; Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||2||33||
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl, Seventh House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

679.g: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ; ਏਕੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
679.e: Meditate in remembrance on the One Lord; meditate in remembrance on the One Lord; meditate in remembrance on the One Lord, O my Beloved.

679.g: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ; ਮਹਾ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
679.e: He shall save you from strife, suffering, greed, attachment, and the most terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||

679.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ; ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
679.e: With each and every breath, each and every instant, day and night, dwell upon Him.

679.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਸੰਗ; ਮਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
679.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him fearlessly, and enshrine the treasure of His Name in your mind. ||1||

679.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ; ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
679.e: Worship His lotus feet, and contemplate the glorious virtues of the Lord of the Universe.

679.g: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਮੰਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਸਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
679.e: O Nanak, the dust of the feet of the Holy shall bless you with pleasure and peace. ||2||1||31||

680.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

680.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਹੈ ਅਪੁਨੈ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
680.e: My Guru gives the Naam, the Name of the Lord, to those who have such karma written on their foreheads.

680.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਧਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
680.e: He implants the Naam, and inspires us to chant the Naam; this is Dharma, true religion, in this world. ||1||
The Naam is the glory and greatness of the Lord's humble servant.

680.g: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਤਿ. ਨਾਮੋ ਪਤਿ; ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਨੈ. ਜੋ ਜੋ ਹੋਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
680.e: The Naam is his salvation, and the Naam is his honor; he accepts whatever comes to pass. ||1||Pause||

680.g: ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ. ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਲੈ; ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
680.e: That humble servant, who has the Naam as his wealth, is the perfect banker.

680.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਧਾਰਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੩੭॥
680.e: The Naam is his occupation, O Nanak, and his only support; the Naam is the profit he earns. ||2||6||37||
Sing the Praises of the Lord and Master, with the love of your soul.

680.g: ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਵਨ. ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਵਨ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਨ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
680.e: Those who seek His Sanctuary, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are blended with the Lord in celestial peace. ||1||Pause||

680.g: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ. ਵਸਹਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ; ਸੰਗਿ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
680.e: The feet of the Lord's humble servant abide in my heart; with them, my body is made pure.

680.g: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਏਹੀ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੫॥
680.e: O treasure of mercy, please bless Nanak with the dust of the feet of Your humble servants; this alone brings peace. ||2||4||35||
“You have the portrait like beautiful limbs and your plays are extensive
You are the store of wisdom and the well of glory
O mother! You are modest and blemishless.59
“Hanuman and Bairava jump and wander with your strength
O mother! you are the Donor of Victory
You are the mistress of al the worlds and You are Durga, who ferries across the cycle of existence.60.
“O goddess! You have engrossed all the world in sleep, hunger and thirst
O KAL! You are the goddess like Ratri and Indrani and the redeemer of the devotees.61.
“O Mother! the Vedas have also sung the Praises of your victory
You are Indiscriminate and Indestructible
You are the remover of the fear of the saints, the giver of victory and sword-wielder.”62.
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

680.g: ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਏ. ਦਰਸ ਪੇਖੇ; ਮਾਥੈ ਪਰਉ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
680.e: My eyes have been purified, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, and touching my forehead to the dust of His feet.

680.g: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ; ਮੋਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
680.e: With joy and happiness, I sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord and Master; the Lord of the World abides within my heart. ||1||
You are my Merciful Protector, Lord.

680.g: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਹੋਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
680.e: O beautiful, wise, infinite Father God, be Merciful to me, God. ||1||Pause||

680.g: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰੂਪ; ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਰਸਾਲ ॥
680.e: O Lord of supreme ecstasy and blissful form, Your Word is so beautiful, so drenched with Nectar.

680.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਚਰਣ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਾਂਧਿਓ ਪਾਲ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੮॥
680.e: With the Lord's lotus feet enshrined in his heart, Nanak has tied the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, to the hem of his robe. ||2||7||38||
ACHKARA STANZA BY THY GRACE
“O Goddess! You are Ambika and Shitala being intoxicated, you may falter
You are influential like the ocean You are also Dakini
“You are the performer of Sambhavi Mudra (a kind of osture) and the remover of suffering
You are absorbed in all, doer of good to all, greatly glorious and the destroyer of all.63.
“You manifest yourself in accordance with everyone’s emotion  You are the fear-remover of the world
You are the chopper of everyone and associated with them, you are profound and serene like the sea
“You are the double-edged sword and double-faced Durga  you are invincible
You are Hinglaj, the remover of the fear of all and all remember Thy Name.64.
You are the rider of lion; you have charming eyes;
You are Hinglaj, Pinglaj, a Gandharva woman and a Yaksha woman;
“You are the destroyer of armours
You are the sword-wielder and thundering goddess and you are the lance like a female serpent.65.
“You are renowned for your large body
You are Hinglaj and the goddess Kartikeyi You are glorious and indestructible and the base of all deaths
“Your various names are Ginglaj, Hinglaj, Thinglaj, Pinglaj
You are Chamunda of tricky speed.66.
“O Goddess! You are invincible, indiscriminate, non-white and base of all
You are unchopable and beyond all splendours
“You are also Anjani, the mother of Hanuman  you are Ambika, who holds the weapons
You are imperishable, support of all and the redeemer of the world.67.
“You are Anjani, you are Shitala, the destroyer of all
You are serene like the sea and always remain absorbed
“You are alert, serene  you are large and invincible like the sky
You have enwrapped all the world within yourself and you yourself are ineffaceable and destroyer of all.68.
“O Goddess! you are Bhairavi, the remover of fear and the mover in the world in the world
You are the Trikuti, Yogini, Chamunda and Manavi in practice
“You are youthful, the killer of the demon Jambh
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

680.g: ਅਪਨੀ ਉਕਤਿ ਖਲਾਵੈ ਭੋਜਨ; ਅਪਨੀ ਉਕਤਿ ਖੇਲਾਵੈ ॥
680.e: In His own way, He provides us with our food; in His own way, He plays with us.

680.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਦੇਵੈ; ਮਨ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
680.e: He blesses us with all comforts, enjoyments and delicacies, and he permeates our minds. ||1||
Our Father is the Lord of the World, the Merciful Lord.

680.g: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਉ; ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
680.e: Just as the mother protects her children, God nurtures and cares for us. ||1||Pause||

680.g: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਇਕ; ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
680.e: You are my friend and companion, the Master of all excellences, O eternal and permanent Divine Lord.

680.g: ਈਤ ਊਤ. ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤਤ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ; ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੨॥੮॥੩੯॥
680.e: Here, there and everywhere, You are pervading; please, bless Nanak to serve the Saints. ||2||8||39||
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

680.g: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਮੋਦਰ; ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
680.e: The Saints are kind and compassionate; they burn away their sexual desire, anger and corruption.

680.g: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ; ਇਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਲੈ ਬਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
680.e: My power, wealth, youth, body and soul are a sacrifice to them. ||1||
With my mind and body, I love the Lord's Name.

680.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਹਿਤ; ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
680.e: With peace, poise, pleasure and joy, He has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

680.g: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ. ਮਾਨੁਖ ਡਹਕਾਵੈ; ਓਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
680.e: People try to deceive others, but the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything.

680.g: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਕਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ; ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
680.e: They commit sins, and then deny them, while they pretend to be in Nirvaanaa. ||1||
They believe that You are far away, but You, O God, are near at hand.

680.g: ਉਤ ਤਾਕੈ. ਉਤ ਤੇ ਉਤ ਪੇਖੈ; ਆਵੈ ਲੋਭੀ ਫੇਰਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
